records.source_text: Please rotate your device for the best view of the activities.
records.target_text: Bitte drehen Sie Ihr Gerät, damit Sie die Aktivitäten optimal sehen können.
records.back_translation: Please rotate your device so that you can optimally see the activities.

records.source_text: Please use a tablet in landscape mode, a desktop computer, or a laptop to complete the activities.
records.target_text: Bitte verwenden Sie ein Tablet im Querformat, einen Desktop-Computer oder einen Laptop, um die Aufgaben zu lösen.
records.back_translation: Please use a tablet in landscape mode, a desktop computer, or a laptop to solve the tasks.

records.source_text: Hi! We are excited to have you play some games with us today!
records.target_text: Hallo! Wir freuen uns, dass du heute ein paar Spiele mit uns spielst!
records.back_translation: Hello! We're glad you're playing some games with us today!

records.source_text: First, you get to choose a buddy to play along with you. As you complete the different games, you will get to pick an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your buddy.
records.target_text: Zuerst kannst du einen Spielpartner auswählen, der die Spiele zusammen mit dir spielt. Nach jedem Spiel darfst du dir eine Sache aussuchen, zum Beispiel einen Hut oder eine Brille, die dein Spielpartner dann aufsetzen oder anziehen kann.
records.back_translation: First, you can choose a playmate who will play the games together with you. After each game, you may choose one thing, for example, a hat or glasses, which your playmate can then put on or wear.

records.source_text: Pick a buddy to play with!
records.target_text: Du kannst dir jetzt aussuchen, wer mit dir spielen soll!
records.back_translation: You can now choose who should play with you!

records.source_text: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.
records.target_text: Super, jetzt hast du deinen Spielpartner! Jetzt wollen wir dir erklären, wie die Spiele funktionieren.
records.back_translation: Great, now you have your playmate! Now we want to explain to you how the games work.

records.source_text: During the games you will need to listen to instructions so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is the way you like it. If you need to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button up in the corner of your screen.
records.target_text: Während der Spiele wirst du Anweisungen hören. Achte also darauf, dass deine Lautsprecher eingeschaltet sind und die Lautstärke für dich angenehm ist. Wenn du die Anweisungen noch einmal hören möchtest, kannst du auf die Lautsprechertaste oben in der Ecke deines Bildschirms klicken.
records.back_translation: During the games, you will hear instructions. So make sure your speakers are turned on and the volume is comfortable for you. If you want to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button in the top corner of your screen.

records.source_text:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can pick the way that works best for you.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, please ask the adult who is nearby to help you.
records.target_text:
Je nach Art des Tablets oder Computers, den du verwendest, kannst du deine Antworten auf unterschiedliche Weise auswählen. Du kannst eine Maus oder ein Touchpad benutzen, um etwas anzuklicken, du kannst die Pfeiltasten auf deiner Tastatur benutzen oder du kannst deinen Bildschirm berühren, wenn du ein Tablet benutzt. Du kannst die Methode wählen, die für dich am besten geeignet ist.

Wenn du Fragen hast oder zum Starten Hilfe brauchst, bitte einen Erwachsenen in deiner Nähe, dir zu helfen.
records.back_translation:
Depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using, you can select your answers in different ways. You can use a mouse or a touchpad to click something, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can choose the method that is best suited for you.

If you have questions or need help getting started, please ask an adult near you to help you.

records.source_text: Nice job with the practice! Let's try some more on your own.
records.target_text: Das Üben hat schonmal super geklappt! Jetzt kannst du es nochmal alleine versuchen.
records.back_translation: The practice went great! Now you can try it again by yourself.

records.source_text: We’re going to show you a puzzle, and your job is to pick the best piece to complete the puzzle. Let's get started!
records.target_text: Wir zeigen dir ein Puzzle, und deine Aufgabe ist es, das beste Teil zu finden, um das Puzzle zu vervollständigen. Los geht's!
records.back_translation: We'll show you a puzzle, and your task is to find the best piece to complete the puzzle. Let's go!

records.source_text: See this big puzzle? It's missing a piece! Which piece goes in the puzzle?

records.back_translation: Do you see this big puzzle? A piece is missing! Which piece belongs in the puzzle?

records.source_text: Choose the best piece to complete the puzzle.
records.target_text: Wähle das beste Muster, um die Lücke zu füllen.
records.back_translation: Choose the best pattern to fill the gap.

records.source_text: Do you see these two outlines? One goes with this shape. Let’s see which one goes with the shape.
records.target_text: Siehst du diese beiden Schatten? Einer passt zu der Form. Lass uns schauen, welcher zur Form passt.
records.back_translation: Do you see these two shadows? One fits the shape. Let's see which one fits the shape.

records.source_text: Let's see if this shape goes with the outline. This shape doesn’t go with the outline.
records.target_text: Mal sehen, ob diese Form zu dem Schatten passt. Diese Form passt nicht zum Schatten.
records.back_translation: Let's see if this shape fits the shadow. This shape does not fit the shadow.

records.source_text: Let's see if this shape goes with the outline. This shape does go with the outline.
records.target_text: Mal sehen, ob diese Form zu dem Schatten passt. Diese Form passt zu dem Schatten.
records.back_translation: Let's see if this shape fits the shadow. This shape fits the shadow.

records.source_text: Now you try! Can you find the shape that goes with the outline?
records.target_text: Jetzt bist du dran! Kannst du die Form finden, die zum Schatten passt?
records.explanation: The translation uses 'Schatten' (shadow) and 'passt' (fits), which together imply a direct, non-rotated fit rather than a rotational match. This ambiguity is critical for a mental rotation task.
records.suggested_fix: Jetzt bist du dran! Kannst du die Form finden, die in die Umrisse passt, wenn du sie drehst?
records.back_translation: Now it's your turn! Can you find the shape that matches the shadow?

records.source_text: Now you will see pictures that show blocks with three sides. Your task is to choose the matching picture.

records.back_translation: Now you see pictures that show blocks with three sides. Your task is to select the matching picture.

records.source_text: Choose the picture that matches this one.
records.target_text: Wähle das Bild aus, das hierzu passt.
records.explanation: The German translation 'hierzu passt' is too general for a mental rotation task. It doesn't specify that the child needs to find a rotated match, potentially leading to misinterpretation of the task.
records.suggested_fix: Wähle das Bild aus, das diesem entspricht, wenn es gedreht wird.
records.back_translation: Choose the picture that fits this.

records.source_text: Choose the matching picture.
records.target_text: Wähle das passende Bild aus.
records.back_translation: Choose the appropriate image.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. 

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
In diesem Spiel wirst du einige mathematische Aufgaben lösen. Einige sind wie die, die du in der Schule machst, und einige sind etwas anders als die, die du in der Schule machst. 

Einige Fragen könnten leicht für dich sein und einige könnten schwer sein. Das ist nicht schlimm! Bitte gib dein Bestes und nimm dir Zeit. Bei den meisten Fragen gibt es vier Auswahlmöglichkeiten. Du wählst die aus, die du für richtig hältst. Los geht's!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you will solve some mathematical problems. Some are like those you do in school, and some are a little different from those you do in school.

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That's okay! Please do your best and take your time. For most questions, there are four choices. You choose the one you think is correct. Let's go!

records.back_translation: Here comes the first part. At the beginning, we'll just practice for now.

records.source_text: Here is another section. The first few are for practice.

records.back_translation: Now comes the next part. The first few are again for practice.

records.source_text: In this section sometimes you will add and sometimes you will subtract. Be sure to look carefully for the plus or minus sign. The first few are for practice.
records.target_text: In diesem Teil musst du manchmal addieren und manchmal subtrahieren. Schau also genau, ob da ein Plus oder ein Minus steht. Die ersten paar sind wieder zum Üben.
records.back_translation: In this part, you sometimes have to add and sometimes subtract. So look closely to see if there's a plus or a minus. The first few are for practice again.

records.source_text: This is the Stories Game. In this game, you will listen to some stories. Then you will answer questions about the stories.
records.target_text: Das ist das Geschichten-Spiel. In diesem Spiel wirst du Geschichten hören und dann kannst du ein paar Fragen dazu beantworten.
records.back_translation: This is the story game. In this game, you will hear stories and then you can answer a few questions about them.

records.source_text: Nice work! Here is a new story.
records.target_text: Sehr gut! Hier ist eine neue Geschichte.
records.back_translation: Very good! Here is a new story.

records.source_text: Here is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Das ist Laura. Heute Morgen hat Laura ihr Buch hinter den Stuhl gelegt, weil sie nicht wollte, dass es jemand findet.
records.back_translation: This is Laura. This morning, Laura put her book behind the chair because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But when Madison was outside playing, someone did find it! And hid it under the rug.
records.target_text: Aber als Laura draußen gespielt hat, hat es jemand gefunden und unter dem Teppich versteckt.
records.back_translation: But when Laura was playing outside, someone found it and hid it under the rug.

records.source_text: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
records.target_text: Jetzt möchte Laura aber gern ihr Buch weiterlesen.
records.back_translation: But now Laura would like to continue reading her book.

records.source_text: Where will Madison look first for her book?
records.target_text: Wo wird Laura zuerst nach ihrem Buch suchen?
records.back_translation: Where will Laura look for her book first?

records.source_text: Behind the chair
records.target_text: Hinter dem Stuhl
records.back_translation: Behind the chair

records.source_text: Under the rug
records.target_text: Unter dem Teppich
records.back_translation: Under the carpet

records.source_text: And where is her book really?
records.target_text: Und wo ist ihr Buch wirklich?
records.back_translation: And where is her book, really?

records.source_text: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
records.target_text: Heute Morgen, als er in die Schule kam, hat Justus sein Buch auf die Garderobe über den Mänteln gelegt. Das Buch von Justus ist blau!
records.back_translation: This morning, when he came to school, Justus put his book on the coat rack above the coats. Justus's book is blue!

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
records.target_text: Und dann ist er nach draußen gegangen, um zu spielen, siehst du? Hier ist Justus beim Spielen draußen. Und während er draußen spielte, fiel das Buch von Justus von der Garderobe auf den Boden unter die Mäntel, siehst du?
records.back_translation: And then he went outside to play, you see? Here's Justus playing outside. And while he was playing outside, Justus's book fell from the coat rack to the floor under the coats, you see?

records.source_text: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
records.target_text: Dann kommt Hannah herein und legt ihr Buch auf die Garderobe über den Mänteln. Hannahs Buch ist auch blau! Justus ist noch draußen und spielt, deshalb hat er nicht gesehen, was Hannah gemacht hat.
records.back_translation: Then Hannah comes in and puts her book on the coat rack above the coats. Hannah's book is also blue! Justus is still outside playing, so he hasn't seen what Hannah did.

records.source_text: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
records.target_text: Wenn Justus nun von draußen hereinkommt, wo wird er zuerst nach seinem Buch suchen?
records.back_translation: When Justus now comes in from outside, where will he first look for his book?

records.source_text: On the shelf
records.target_text: Oben im Regal
records.back_translation: Up on the shelf

records.source_text: Under the coats
records.target_text: Unter den Mänteln
records.back_translation: Among the coats

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
records.target_text: Mal sehen, was er macht. Oh, sieh mal, da ist Justus. Er greift nach dem Buch oben im Regal. Und jetzt sieht Hannah, wie Justus nach dem Buch greift... dem Buch, das Hannah gehört!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh, look, there's Justus. He's reaching for the book on the top shelf. And now Hannah sees Justus reaching for the book... the book that belongs to Hannah!

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
records.target_text: Was glaubst du, was Hannah davon hält, dass Justus nach dem Buch greift?
records.back_translation: What do you think Hannah thinks about Justus reaching for the book?

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Hannah wohl fühlen, wenn sie nicht gesehen hätte, wie Justus nach dem Buch greift?
records.back_translation: How would Hannah feel if she hadn't seen Justus reach for the book?

records.source_text: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Ist es gemein und frech von Justus, dass er Hannahs Buch genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Is it mean and cheeky of Justus that he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Sollte Justus Ärger mit der Lehrerin bekommen, weil er Hannahs Buch genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Should Justus get in trouble with the teacher because he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kannst du Hannah helfen, ihr Buch zu finden? Ist es auf dem Regal oder unter den Mänteln?
records.back_translation: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kannst du Justus helfen, sein Buch zu finden? Ist es auf dem Regal oder unter den Mänteln?
records.back_translation: Can you help Justus find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Johann, Lisa und Max spielen ein Spiel. Das Spiel geht so: Ein Kind versteckt sich, malt aber einen Hinweis in den Sandkasten, damit die anderen Kinder es finden können.
records.back_translation: Johann, Lisa, and Max are playing a game. The game goes like this: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so that the other children can find them.

records.source_text: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
records.target_text: Max fängt an. Er malt einen Hinweis in den Sandkasten und versteckt sich dann.
records.back_translation: Max starts. He paints a clue in the sandbox and then hides.

records.source_text: Now it's Joshua's turn to leave a clue, and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.
records.target_text: Jetzt ist Johann an der Reihe, einen Hinweis zu hinterlassen und sich zu verstecken. Lisa und Max werden dann versuchen, den Hinweis zu nutzen, um ihn zu finden.
records.back_translation: Now it's Johann's turn to leave a clue and hide. Lisa and Max will then try to use the clue to find him.

records.source_text: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Joshua goes and hides behind the fountain.
records.target_text: Johann beschließt, sich hinter dem Springbrunnen zu verstecken. Er zeichnet einen Hinweis in den Sand. Er versucht, den Springbrunnen zu zeichnen, mit dem unteren Teil und dem Wasser, das aus ihm herauskommt. Aber die Zeichnung sieht stattdessen wie ein Baum aus! Dann versteckt sich Johann hinter dem Springbrunnen.
records.back_translation: Johann decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the lower part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Johann hides behind the fountain.

records.source_text: What did Joshua mean to draw?
records.target_text: Was wollte Johann zeichnen?
records.back_translation: What did Johann want to draw?

records.source_text: A fountain
records.target_text: Einen Springbrunnen
records.back_translation: A fountain

records.source_text: A tree
records.target_text: Einen Baum
records.back_translation: A tree

records.source_text: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look first for Joshua?
records.target_text: Sobald Lisa und Max diesen Hinweis sehen, wo werden sie zuerst nach Johann suchen?
records.back_translation: As soon as Lisa and Max see this clue, where will they first look for Johann?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?
records.target_text: Kannst du ihnen helfen, herauszufinden, wo Johann wirklich ist?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find out where Johann really is?

records.source_text: Behind the fountain
records.target_text: Hinter dem Springbrunnen
records.back_translation: Behind the fountain

records.source_text: Behind the tree
records.target_text: Hinter dem Baum
records.back_translation: Behind the tree

records.source_text: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua, and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?
records.target_text: Schau, Lisa und Max haben Johann gefunden und das Spiel gewonnen! Was glaubst du, wie Lisa sich fühlt, weil sie das Spiel gewonnen hat?
records.back_translation: Look, Lisa and Max found Johann and won the game! How do you think Lisa feels because she won the game?

records.source_text: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
records.target_text: Jetzt sind die Spiele vorbei, und es ist Zeit, nach Hause zu gehen. Die Mutter sagt den Kindern, sie sollen alle ihre Spielsachen einsammeln.
records.back_translation: Now the games are over, and it's time to go home. The mother tells the children to collect all their toys.

records.source_text: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
records.target_text: Johann hat seinen Spielzeuglaster mit in den Park genommen, aber jetzt kann er ihn nicht mehr finden. Er sucht überall, aber er kann ihn nicht finden.
records.back_translation: Johann took his toy truck to the park, but now he can't find it anymore. He's looking everywhere, but he can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Joshua feel about losing his truck?
records.target_text: Was denkt Johann über den Verlust seines Lastwagens?
records.back_translation: What does Johann think about the loss of his truck?

records.source_text: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Johann fühlen, wenn er seinen Lastwagen finden würde?
records.back_translation: How would Johann feel if he were to find his truck?

records.source_text: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
records.target_text: Johann kann seinen Lastwagen nicht finden, weil Lisa vorhin, als niemand hinsah, den Spielzeuglastwagen genommen und im Sandkasten vergraben hat.
records.back_translation: Johann cannot find his truck because Lisa took the toy truck earlier, when no one was looking, and buried it in the sandbox.

records.source_text: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
records.target_text: Johann sucht also überall, aber er kann seinen Spielzeug-LKW nicht finden. Seine Mutter wird wütend auf Johann, weil er seinen Laster verloren hat.
records.back_translation: So Johann searches everywhere, but he cannot find his toy truck. His mother gets angry at Johann because he lost his truck.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
records.target_text: Ist es fair, dass Mutter böse auf Johann ist, weil er seinen Spielzeuglaster verloren hat?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Mother is angry at Johann because he lost his toy truck?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter böse auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Lisa?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Ist Johann böse auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Johann mad at Lisa?

records.source_text: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
records.target_text: Als Lisa sieht, dass Mutter böse auf Johann ist, geht sie zum Sandkasten, gräbt den Spielzeuglaster aus und gibt ihn Johann zurück.
records.back_translation: When Lisa sees that Mother is angry with Johann, she goes to the sandbox, digs out the toy truck, and gives it back to Johann.

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter jetzt böse auf Johann?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Johann now?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter jetzt böse auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Lisa now?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Ist Johann jetzt böse auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Johann mad at Lisa now?

records.source_text: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
records.target_text: Lisa sagt Johann, dass es ihr sehr leid tut, und sie gibt ihm eine große Umarmung. Johann erwidert die Umarmung, und auch Mutter schließt sich ihr an.
records.back_translation: Lisa tells Johann that she is very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Johann returns the hug, and Mother also joins in.

records.source_text: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
records.target_text: Sam und Maria spielen zusammen. Sie schauen nach draußen und sehen ein neues Geschäft auf der anderen Straßenseite. Maria sagt zu Sam: "Ich werde dort neue T-shirts für uns kaufen", und sie geht weg.
records.back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new store across the street. Maria says to Sam: "I will buy new T-shirts for us there," and she walks away.

records.source_text: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
records.target_text: Mama kommt nach Hause und erzählt Sam, dass sie gerade an dem Laden vorbeigelaufen ist. "Verkaufen sie T-shirts?" fragt Sam. "Nein", sagt Mama, "sie verkaufen nur Schuhe". "Maria wird jetzt wahrscheinlich Schuhe im Laden kaufen", sagt Sam.
records.back_translation: Mom comes home and tells Sam that she just walked past the store. "Do they sell T-shirts?" asks Sam. "No," says Mom, "they only sell shoes." "Maria will probably buy shoes at the store now," says Sam.

records.source_text: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
records.target_text: Weiß Maria, dass in dem Laden Schuhe verkauft werden?
records.back_translation: Does Maria know that shoes are sold in the store?

records.source_text: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
records.target_text: Maria ist im Laden angekommen. "Ich möchte gerne T-shirts kaufen", sagt sie. "Wir haben nur noch Socken", sagt der Ladenbesitzer. Da Maria auch Socken braucht, beschließt sie, Socken zu kaufen.
records.back_translation: Maria has arrived at the store. "I would like to buy T-shirts," she says. "We only have socks left," says the store owner. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to buy socks.

records.source_text: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
records.target_text: Weiß Sam, dass Maria ein paar Socken gekauft hat?
records.back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria bought a pair of socks?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Sam, was sie in dem Laden verkaufen?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?

records.source_text: Shoes
records.target_text: Schuhe
records.back_translation: Shoes

records.source_text: Socks
records.target_text: Socken
records.back_translation: Socks

records.source_text: Shirts
records.target_text: T-Shirts
records.back_translation: T-shirts

records.source_text:
On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”
“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
records.target_text:
Auf dem Rückweg trifft Maria ihren Vater. Sie erzählt ihrem Vater: "Ich habe gerade ein paar Socken gekauft. Ich werde sie mit meinem Bruder Sam teilen. Es ist eine Überraschung."
"Das ist nett von dir", sagt Papa. Dann fragt er Maria: "Weiß Sam, was du ihm gekauft hast?"
records.back_translation:
On the way back, Maria meets her father. She tells her father: "I just bought some socks. I'm going to share them with my brother Sam. It's a surprise."
"That's nice of you," says Dad. Then he asks Maria: "Does Sam know what you bought him?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Was sagt Maria zu Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Papa?

records.source_text: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
records.target_text: Dann fragt Papa: "Was glaubt Sam, was sie in dem Laden verkaufen?"
records.back_translation: Then Dad asks: "What does Sam think they sell in that store?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Was sagt Maria zu Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Papa?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Sam, was sie in dem Laden verkaufen?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?

records.source_text: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
records.target_text: Sam freut sich sehr über seine neuen Socken.
records.back_translation: Sam is very happy about his new socks.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
records.target_text: Stell dir vor, du gehst zur Schule und trägst deine neuen Schuhe. Du magst deine neuen Schuhe sehr und heute ist der erste Tag, an dem du sie trägst.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're going to school wearing your new shoes. You like your new shoes very much and today is the first day you're wearing them.

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
records.target_text: Plötzlich wirst du von einem Jungen von hinten angerempelt. Du stolperst und fällst in eine Schlammpfütze und deine neuen Schuhe sind schlammig.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle, and your new shoes are muddy.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Glaubst du, dass der Junge dich absichtlich oder aus Versehen angerempelt hat?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy bumped into you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Was würdest du tun? Wähle eine der drei Möglichkeiten aus.
records.back_translation: What would you do? Choose one of the three options.

records.target_text: meine Schuhe sauber machen
records.back_translation: clean my shoes

records.source_text: walk away from the boy
records.target_text: sich von dem Jungen entfernen
records.back_translation: to move away from the boy

records.source_text: push the boy in the mud

records.back_translation: to push the boy into the mud

records.source_text: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
records.target_text: Stell dir vor, du bist auf einem Spielplatz. Du und einige andere Kinder rennen um die Wette. Ein Junge steht am Rand und spielt mit einem Basketball.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are on a playground. You and some other children are racing. A boy is standing on the sidelines playing with a basketball.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
records.target_text: Dann rollt der Ball von dem Jungen unter deine Füße und du fällst hin. Du schürfst dir das Knie auf und ein anderer gewinnt das Rennen.
records.back_translation: Then the ball rolls from the boy under your feet and you fall down. You scrape your knee and someone else wins the race.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?

records.back_translation: Do you think the boy pushed you to the ground on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Was würdest du tun? Wähle eine der drei Möglichkeiten aus.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.
records.target_text: Stell dir vor, du arbeitest an deinem Schreibtisch an einer Aufgabe.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are working on a task at your desk.

records.source_text: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.
records.target_text: Du gehst deinen Bleistift anspitzen, und als du zu deinem Schreibtisch zurückgehst, läuft ein Junge direkt vor dir. Der Junge geht an deinem Schreibtisch vorbei, bevor du selbst dort bist.
records.back_translation: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk, a boy walks directly in front of you. The boy walks past your desk before you yourself are there.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
records.target_text: Das nächste ist, dass der Junge alle deine Papiere von deinem Schreibtisch geworfen hat und sie überall auf dem Boden liegen.
records.back_translation: The next thing is that the boy threw all your papers off your desk and they are lying all over the floor.

records.back_translation: Do you think the boy threw your papers on the floor intentionally or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:

records.explanation: The translation 'ihn beleidigen' (to insult him) is too strong and specific. 'Call him a name' has a broader range of connotations, from mild teasing to outright insult, which is crucial for measuring hostile attribution bias. 'Beleidigen' resolves this ambiguity towards a more intentional and severe action.

records.source_text: Watch carefully! Try to remember the order.
records.target_text: Pass gut auf! Versuche, dir die Reihenfolge zu merken.
records.back_translation: Pay close attention! Try to remember the sequence.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Wähle die Quadrate in der gleichen Reihenfolge.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Das stimmt nicht ganz. Versuch es noch einmal! Wähle die Quadrate in der gleichen Reihenfolge.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again! Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This time the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Dieses Mal wird dir das Spiel nicht sagen, ob du richtig oder falsch liegst. Los geht's mit dem Memory-Spiel!
records.back_translation: This time the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let's go with the memory game!

records.source_text: Now let's play the memory game backwards!
records.target_text: Jetzt spielen wir das Memory-Spiel umgekehrt!
records.back_translation: Now we're playing the Memory game in reverse!

records.source_text: Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Los geht's mit dem Memory-Spiel!
records.back_translation: Let's go with the Memory game!

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Wähle die Quadrate in der umgekehrten Reihenfolge.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Das stimmt nicht ganz. Versuch es noch einmal! Wähle die Quadrate in der umgekehrten Reihenfolge.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again! Select the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: This is the heart game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Das ist das Herzspiel. Ich erkläre dir jetzt wie das Herzspiel funktioniert.
records.back_translation: This is the heart game. I will now explain to you how the heart game works.

records.source_text: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.
records.target_text: Wenn du ein Herz siehst, drücke den Knopf auf der gleichen Seite.
records.back_translation: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again.
records.target_text: Das stimmt nicht ganz. Versuch es noch einmal!
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again!

records.source_text: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: Das Herz befindet sich auf der rechten Seite. Drücke die rechte Taste.
records.back_translation: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.

records.source_text: Time to practice!
records.target_text: Jetzt kannst du üben!
records.back_translation: Now you can practice!

records.source_text: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
records.target_text: Nicht vergessen! Wenn du ein HERZ siehst, drücke den Knopf auf der GLEICHEN Seite.
records.back_translation: Don't forget! If you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.

records.source_text: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Jetzt spielen wir das Spiel schneller. Dir wird nicht gesagt, ob du richtig oder falsch liegst. Versuch hinterherzukommen!
records.back_translation: Now we're playing the game faster. You won't be told if you're right or wrong. Try to keep up!

records.source_text: Try to answer as fast as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Versuche, so schnell wie möglich zu antworten, ohne Fehler zu machen. Wenn du einen Fehler machst, mach einfach weiter!
records.back_translation: Try to answer as quickly as possible without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Time to play!
records.target_text: Jetzt geht das Spiel richtig los!
records.back_translation: Now the game really begins!

records.source_text: This is the flower game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Das ist das Blumenspiel. Ich erkläre dir jetzt wie das Blumenspiel funktioniert.
records.back_translation: This is the flower game. I will now explain to you how the flower game works.

records.source_text: When you see a flower, press the button on the other side.
records.target_text: Wenn du eine Blume siehst, drückst du den Knopf auf der GEGENÜBERLIEGENDEN Seite.
records.back_translation: When you see a flower, you press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

records.source_text: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: Die Blume ist auf der linken Seite. Drücke den rechten Knopf.
records.back_translation: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.

records.source_text: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OTHER side.
records.target_text: Wenn du eine Blume siehst, drücke den Knopf auf der GEGENÜBERLIEGENDEN Seite.
records.back_translation: When you see a flower, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

records.source_text: Now, we're going to play a game with hearts and flowers.
records.target_text: Jetzt werden wir ein Spiel mit Herzen und Blumen spielen.
records.back_translation: Now we will play a game with hearts and flowers.

records.source_text: Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Versuch hinterherzukommen!
records.back_translation: Try to keep up!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Wenn du einen Fehler machst, mach einfach weiter!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Great job! You completed the game!
records.target_text: Gut gemacht! Dieses Spiel ist jetzt zu Ende.
records.back_translation: Well done! This game is now over.
