records.target_text: überrascht
records.back_translation: surprised

records.source_text: This is the Stories Game. In this game, you will listen to some stories. Then you will answer questions about the stories.
records.target_text: Das ist das Geschichten-Spiel. In diesem Spiel wirst du Geschichten hören und dann kannst du ein paar Fragen dazu beantworten.
records.back_translation: This is the story game. In this game, you will hear stories and then you can answer a few questions about them.

records.source_text: Nice work! Here is a new story.
records.target_text: Sehr gut! Hier ist eine neue Geschichte.
records.back_translation: Very good! Here is a new story.

records.source_text: Here is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Das ist Laura. Heute Morgen hat Laura ihr Buch hinter den Stuhl gelegt, weil sie nicht wollte, dass es jemand findet.
records.back_translation: This is Laura. This morning Laura put her book behind the chair because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But when Madison was outside playing, someone did find it! And hid it under the rug.
records.target_text: Aber als Laura draußen gespielt hat, hat es jemand gefunden und unter dem Teppich versteckt.
records.back_translation: But when Laura was playing outside, someone found it and hid it under the carpet.

records.source_text: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
records.target_text: Jetzt möchte Laura aber gern ihr Buch weiterlesen.
records.back_translation: Now Laura would like to continue reading her book.

records.source_text: Where will Madison look first for her book?
records.target_text: Wo wird Laura zuerst nach ihrem Buch suchen?
records.back_translation: Where will Laura first look for her book?

records.source_text: Behind the chair
records.target_text: Hinter dem Stuhl
records.back_translation: Behind the chair

records.source_text: Under the rug
records.target_text: Unter dem Teppich
records.back_translation: Under the carpet

records.source_text: And where is her book really?
records.target_text: Und wo ist ihr Buch wirklich?
records.back_translation: And where is her book really?

records.source_text: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
records.target_text: Heute Morgen, als er in die Schule kam, hat Justus sein Buch auf die Garderobe über den Mänteln gelegt. Das Buch von Justus ist blau!
records.back_translation: This morning, when he came to school, Justus put his book on the cloakroom rack above the coats. Justus's book is blue!

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
records.target_text: Und dann ist er nach draußen gegangen, um zu spielen, siehst du? Hier ist Justus beim Spielen draußen. Und während er draußen spielte, fiel das Buch von Justus von der Garderobe auf den Boden unter die Mäntel, siehst du?
records.back_translation: And then he went outside to play, you see? Here is Justus playing outside. And while he was playing outside, Justus's book fell from the coat rack to the floor under the coats, you see?

records.source_text: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
records.target_text: Dann kommt Hannah herein und legt ihr Buch oben über die Garderobenhaken. Hannahs Buch ist auch blau! Ethan ist immer noch draussen und spielt, daher hat er nicht gesehen, was Hannah gemacht hat.
records.back_translation: Then Hannah comes in and places her book on top of the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he hasn't seen what Hannah did.

records.source_text: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
records.target_text: Wenn Ethan jetzt von draussen hereinkommt, wo wird er zuerst nach seinem Buch suchen?
records.back_translation: If Ethan comes in from outside now, where will he look for his book first?

records.source_text: On the shelf
records.target_text: Oben im Regal
records.back_translation: Up on the shelf

records.source_text: Under the coats
records.target_text: Unter den Mänteln
records.back_translation: Under the coats

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
records.target_text: Mal sehen, was er macht. Oh, sieh mal, da ist Ethan, der nach diesem Buch oben im Regal greift. Und jetzt sieht Hannah, wie Ethan nach diesem Buch greift... dem Buch, das Hannah gehört!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh, look, there's Ethan reaching for that book on the top shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that belongs to Hannah!

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
records.target_text: Was denkst du, wie Hannah sich fühlt, weil Ethan nach diesem Buch greift?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how does Hannah feel because Ethan is reaching for this book?

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Hannah fühlen, wenn sie nicht gesehen hätte, wie Ethan nach dem Buch greift?
records.back_translation: How would Hannah feel if she hadn't seen Ethan reach for the book?

records.source_text: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Ist Ethan gemein und frech, weil er Hannahs Buch genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Is Ethan mean and cheeky because he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Sollte Ethan Ärger mit der Lehrerin bekommen, weil er Hannahs Buch genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Should Ethan get into trouble with the teacher because he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kannst du Hannah helfen, ihr Buch zu finden? Ist es auf dem Regal oder unter den Mänteln?
records.back_translation: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kannst du Ethan helfen, sein Buch zu finden? Ist es auf dem Regal oder unter den Mänteln?
records.back_translation: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Johann, Lisa und Max spielen ein Spiel. So geht das Spiel: Ein Kind versteckt sich, malt aber einen Hinweis in den Sandkasten, damit die anderen Kinder es finden können.
records.back_translation: Johann, Lisa, and Max are playing a game. This is how the game works: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so that the other children can find them.

records.source_text: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
records.target_text: Max fängt an. Er malt diesen Hinweis in den Sandkasten und geht dann, um sich zu verstecken.
records.explanation: The proper name 'Ivan' was changed to 'Max' in the German translation. Proper names should be localized, not changed to a different name.
records.suggested_fix: Ivan fängt an. Er malt diesen Hinweis in den Sandkasten und geht dann, um sich zu verstecken.
records.back_translation: Max starts. He paints this note in the sandbox and then goes to hide.

records.source_text: Now it's Joshua's turn to leave a clue, and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.
records.target_text: Jetzt ist Johann an der Reihe, einen Hinweis zu hinterlassen, und sich zu verstecken. Lisa und Max werden dann versuchen, den Hinweis zu nutzen, um ihn zu finden.
records.back_translation: Now it's Johann's turn to leave a clue and hide. Lisa and Max will then try to use the clue to find him.

records.source_text: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Joshua goes and hides behind the fountain.
records.target_text: Johann beschliesst, sich hinter dem Springbrunnen zu verstecken. Er zeichnet einen Hinweis in den Sand. Er versucht, den Springbrunnen zu zeichnen, mit dem unteren Teil und dem Wasser, das aus ihm herauskommt. Aber die Zeichnung sieht stattdessen wie ein Baum aus! Dann versteckt sich Johann hinter dem Springbrunnen.
records.back_translation: Johann decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the lower part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Johann hides behind the fountain.

records.source_text: What did Joshua mean to draw?
records.target_text: Was wollte Johann zeichnen?
records.back_translation: What did Johann want to draw?

records.source_text: A fountain
records.target_text: Ein Springbrunnen
records.back_translation: A fountain

records.source_text: A tree
records.target_text: Ein Baum
records.back_translation: A tree

records.source_text: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look first for Joshua?
records.target_text: Wenn Lisa und Max diesen Hinweis sehen, wo werden sie zuerst nach Johann suchen?
records.back_translation: If Lisa and Max see this clue, where will they first look for Johann?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?
records.target_text: Kannst du ihnen helfen, herauszufinden, wo Johann wirklich ist?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find out where Johann really is?

records.source_text: Behind the fountain
records.target_text: Hinter dem Springbrunnen
records.back_translation: Behind the fountain

records.source_text: Behind the tree
records.target_text: Hinter dem Baum
records.back_translation: Behind the tree

records.source_text: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua, and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?
records.target_text: Schau, Lisa und Max haben Johann gefunden und das Spiel gewonnen! Was glaubst du, wie sich Lisa fühlt, weil sie das Spiel gewonnen hat?
records.back_translation: Look, Lisa and Max found Johann and won the game! How do you think Lisa feels because she won the game?

records.source_text: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
records.target_text: Jetzt sind die Spiele vorbei, und es ist fast Zeit, nach Hause zu gehen. Die Mutter sagt den Kindern, sie sollen alle ihre Spielsachen finden.
records.back_translation: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. The mother tells the children to find all their toys.

records.source_text: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
records.target_text: Johann hat seinen Spielzeuglaster mit in den Park genommen, aber jetzt kann er ihn nicht finden. Er sucht überall, aber er kann ihn nicht finden.
records.back_translation: Johann took his toy truck to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere, but he can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Joshua feel about losing his truck?
records.target_text: Was denkt Johann über den Verlust seines Lastwagens?
records.back_translation: What does Johann think about the loss of his truck?

records.source_text: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Johann fühlen, wenn er seinen Lastwagen finden würde?
records.back_translation: How would Johann feel if he were to find his truck?

records.source_text: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
records.target_text: Johann kann seinen Lastwagen nicht finden, weil Lisa früher am Tag, als niemand hinsah, den Spielzeuglastwagen genommen und im Sandkasten vergraben hat.
records.back_translation: Johann cannot find his truck because Lisa took the toy truck earlier in the day when no one was looking and buried it in the sandbox.

records.source_text: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
records.target_text: Johann sucht also überall, aber er kann seinen Spielzeug-LKW nicht finden. Seine Mutter wird wütend auf Johann, weil er seinen Laster verloren hat.
records.back_translation: So Johann searches everywhere, but he cannot find his toy truck. His mother gets angry at Johann because he lost his truck.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
records.target_text: Ist es fair, dass Mutter wütend auf Johann ist, weil er seinen Spielzeuglaster verloren hat?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Mother is angry with Johann because he lost his toy truck?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter wütend auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Lisa?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Ist Johann wütend auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Johann angry at Lisa?

records.source_text: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
records.target_text: Als Lisa sieht, dass Mutter wütend auf Johann ist, geht sie zum Sandkasten, gräbt den Spielzeuglaster aus und gibt ihn Johann zurück.
records.back_translation: When Lisa sees that Mother is angry at Johann, she goes to the sandbox, digs out the toy truck, and gives it back to Johann.

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter jetzt wütend auf Johann?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Johann now?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Ist Mutter jetzt wütend auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Mother angry at Lisa now?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Ist Johann jetzt wütend auf Lisa?
records.back_translation: Is Johann angry at Lisa now?

records.source_text: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
records.target_text: Lisa sagt Johann, dass es ihr sehr leid tut, und sie gibt ihm eine grosse Umarmung. Johann erwidert die Umarmung, und auch Mutter schliesst sich ihr an.
records.back_translation: Lisa tells Johann that she is very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Johann returns the hug, and Mother also joins in.

records.source_text: This is Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house, while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium sized cup on the table, and a big cup that she put away up high, on the shelf.
records.target_text: Das ist Katie. Heute früh hat Katies Mama das Haus geputzt, während Katie zuschaute. Mama liess drei Tassen in der Küche stehen. Da ist eine kleine Tasse auf dem Tresen, eine mittelgrosse Tasse auf dem Tisch und eine grosse Tasse, die sie oben, auf das Regal gestellt hat.
records.back_translation: This is Katie. Early this morning, Katie's mom cleaned the house while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There's a small cup on the counter, a medium-sized cup on the table, and a large cup that she placed up on the shelf.

records.source_text: Katie and Dad just walked in and Katie asks her dad to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad, “I want the big cup!”
records.target_text: Katie und Vater kommen gerade herein und Katie bittet ihren Vater, ihr eine Tasse zu geben. Katie sagt zu ihrem Vater: "Ich möchte die grosse Tasse!"
records.back_translation: Katie and Father are just coming in and Katie asks her father to give her a cup. Katie says to her father: "I want the big cup!"

records.source_text: Which cup will Dad give Katie?
records.target_text: Welche Tasse wird Papa Katie geben?
records.back_translation: Which cup will Dad give Katie?

records.source_text: Which cup does Katie want?
records.target_text: Welche Tasse möchte Katie haben?
records.back_translation: Which cup does Katie want to have?

records.source_text: The small cup
records.target_text: Die kleine Tasse
records.back_translation: The small cup

records.source_text: The medium sized cup
records.target_text: Die mittelgrosse Tasse
records.back_translation: The medium-sized cup

records.source_text: The big cup
records.target_text: Die grosse Tasse
records.back_translation: The big cup

records.source_text: How does Katie feel about not getting the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Wie fühlt sich Katie, wenn sie nicht die Tasse bekommt, die sie wollte?
records.back_translation: How does Katie feel when she doesn't get the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: How would Katie feel if she had received the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Katie fühlen, wenn sie die Tasse bekommen hätte, die sie sich gewünscht hat?
records.back_translation: How would Katie feel if she had gotten the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
records.target_text: Sam und Maria spielen zusammen. Sie schauen nach draussen und sehen ein neues Geschäft auf der anderen Strassenseite. Maria sagt zu Sam: "Ich werde dort neue T-shirts für uns kaufen," und sie geht weg.
records.back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop on the other side of the street. Maria says to Sam: "I will buy new T-shirts for us there," and she walks away.

records.source_text: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
records.target_text: Mama kommt nach Hause und erzählt Sam, dass sie gerade an dem Laden vorbeigelaufen ist. "Verkaufen sie T-shirts?" fragt Sam. "Nein", sagt Mama, "sie verkaufen nur Schuhe". "Maria wird jetzt wahrscheinlich Schuhe im Laden kaufen", sagt Sam.
records.back_translation: Mom comes home and tells Sam that she just walked past the store. "Do they sell T-shirts?" asks Sam. "No," says Mom, "they only sell shoes." "Maria will probably buy shoes at the store now," says Sam.

records.source_text: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
records.target_text: Weiss Maria, dass in dem Laden Schuhe verkauft werden?
records.back_translation: Does Maria know that shoes are sold in the store?

records.source_text: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
records.target_text: Maria ist im Laden angekommen. "Ich möchte gerne T-shirts kaufen," sagt sie. "Wir haben nur noch Socken," sagt der Ladenbesitzer. Da Maria auch Socken braucht, beschliesst sie, Socken zu kaufen.
records.back_translation: Maria has arrived at the store. "I would like to buy T-shirts," she says. "We only have socks left," says the store owner. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to buy socks.

records.source_text: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
records.target_text: Weiss Sam, dass Maria ein paar Socken gekauft hat?
records.back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria bought a pair of socks?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Sam, was in dem Laden verkauft wird?
records.back_translation: What does Sam believe is sold in the store?

records.source_text: Shoes
records.target_text: Schuhe
records.back_translation: Shoes

records.source_text: Socks
records.target_text: Socken
records.back_translation: Socks

records.source_text: Shirts
records.target_text: T-Shirts
records.explanation: The translation 'T-Shirts' is too specific. The original 'Shirts' refers to a broader category of upper body garments, not exclusively t-shirts. This could lead to misinterpretation or confusion for the child.
records.suggested_fix: Hemden
records.back_translation: T-shirts

records.source_text:
On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”
“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
records.target_text:
Auf dem Rückweg trifft Maria ihren Vater. Sie erzählt ihrem Vater: "Ich habe gerade ein paar Socken gekauft. Ich werde sie mit meinem Bruder Sam teilen. Es ist eine Überraschung."
"Das ist nett von dir", sagt Papa. Dann fragt er Maria: "Weiss Sam, was du ihm gekauft hast?"
records.back_translation:
On the way back, Maria meets her father. She tells her father: "I just bought a pair of socks. I will share them with my brother Sam. It's a surprise."
"That's nice of you," says Dad. Then he asks Maria: "Does Sam know what you bought him?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Was sagt Maria zu Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Papa?

records.source_text: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
records.target_text: Dann fragt Papa: "Was glaubt Sam, was sie in dem Laden verkaufen?"
records.back_translation: Then Dad asks: "What does Sam think they sell in that shop?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Was sagt Maria zu Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Papa?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Sam, was in dem Laden verkauft wird?
records.back_translation: What does Sam believe is sold in the store?

records.source_text: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
records.target_text: Sam freut sich sehr über seine neuen Socken.
records.back_translation: Sam is very happy about his new socks.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
records.target_text: Stell dir vor, du gehst zur Schule und trägst deine neuen Schuhe. Du magst deine neuen Schuhe sehr und heute ist der erste Tag, an dem du sie trägst.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're going to school wearing your new shoes. You like your new shoes very much and today is the first day you're wearing them.

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
records.target_text: Plötzlich wirst du von einem Jungen von hinten angerempelt. Du stolperst und fällst in eine Schlammpfütze und deine neuen Schuhe sind schlammig.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle, and your new shoes are muddy.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Glaubst du, dass der Junge dich absichtlich oder aus Versehen angerempelt hat?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy bumped into you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Was würdest du tun? Wähle eine der drei Möglichkeiten aus.
records.back_translation: What would you do? Choose one of the three options.

records.source_text: clean up my shoes
records.target_text: meine Schuhe sauber machen
records.back_translation: clean my shoes

records.source_text: walk away from the boy
records.target_text: sich von dem Jungen entfernen
records.back_translation: to move away from the boy

records.source_text: push the boy in the mud
records.target_text: den Jungen in den Schlamm stossen
records.back_translation: push the boy into the mud

records.source_text: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
records.target_text: Stell dir vor, du bist auf dem Spielplatz. Du und einige andere Kinder rennen um die Wette. Ein Junge steht am Rand und spielt mit einem Basketball.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are on the playground. You and some other children are racing. A boy is standing on the side and playing with a basketball.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
records.target_text: Dann rollt der Ball von dem Jungen unter deine Füße und du fällst hin. Du schürfst dir das Knie auf und ein anderer gewinnt das Rennen.
records.back_translation: Then the ball rolls from the boy under your feet and you fall down. You scrape your knee and someone else wins the race.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Glaubst du, dass der Junge dich mit Absicht oder aus Versehen zu Boden gestossen hat?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy pushed you to the ground on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Was würdest du tun? Wähle eine der drei Möglichkeiten aus.
records.back_translation: What would you do? Choose one of the three options.

records.source_text: go to another area of the playground
records.target_text: in einen anderen Bereich des Spielplatzes gehen
records.back_translation: go to another area of the playground

records.source_text: say something mean to him
records.target_text: etwas Gemeines zu ihm sagen
records.back_translation: to say something mean to him

records.source_text: take care of my knee
records.target_text: Mein Knie verarzten.
records.back_translation: Treat my knee.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.

records.source_text: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
records.target_text: Das nächste ist, dass der Junge alle deine Papiere von deinem Schreibtisch geworfen hat und sie überall auf dem Boden liegen.
records.back_translation: The next thing is that the boy threw all your papers off your desk and they are lying all over the floor.

records.source_text: In this game, you are going to listen to words and look at different pictures. Your job is to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: In diesem Spiel hörst du Wörter und siehst dir verschiedene Bilder an. Deine Aufgabe ist es, das Bild auszuwählen, das zum Wort passt!
records.back_translation: In this game, you will hear words and look at different pictures. Your task is to select the picture that matches the word!

records.source_text: You are going to see some different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then, you'll hear a word for one of the pictures. Make sure to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: Du wirst einige verschiedene Bilder sehen. Zum Beispiel ein Bild von einem Apfel und ein Bild von einer Karotte. Dann hörst du ein Wort zu einem der Bilder. Achte darauf, dass du das Bild auswählst, das zum Wort passt!
records.back_translation: You will see several different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then you will hear a word corresponding to one of the pictures. Make sure you select the picture that matches the word!

records.source_text: Some words are hard, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just give your best guess!
records.target_text: Manche Wörter sind schwer, und das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du dir nicht sicher bist, gib einfach dein Bestes!
records.back_translation: Some words are difficult, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just do your best!

records.source_text: If you need to hear the word again, press the speaker button.
records.target_text: Wenn du das Wort noch einmal hören möchtest, drücke die Lautsprechertaste.
records.back_translation: If you want to hear the word again, press the loudspeaker button.

records.source_text: You can tap on a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Try it now.
records.target_text: Für diese Aktivität kannst du einen Touchscreen, ein Touchpad oder die Pfeiltasten verwenden. Probier es jetzt aus.
records.back_translation: For this activity, you can use a touchscreen, a touchpad, or the arrow keys. Try it out now.

records.source_text: To use an arrow key to choose a picture, press the key that points the same direction as the arrow below the picture.
records.target_text: Um eine Pfeiltaste zu verwenden, um ein Bild auszuwählen, drücke die Taste, die in die gleiche Richtung zeigt wie der Pfeil unter dem Bild.
records.back_translation: To use an arrow key to select an image, press the key that points in the same direction as the arrow below the image.

records.source_text: You can press the replay button to hear things again. Try it now.
records.target_text: Du kannst die Wiedergabetaste drücken, um Dinge noch einmal zu hören. Probier es jetzt aus.
records.back_translation: You can press the playback button to hear things again. Try it now.

records.source_text: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look at the pictures carefully. Choose the picture that goes with the words you hear.
records.target_text: Dies ist eine Zuordnungsaktivität. Hör zu, was ich sage, und schau dir dann die Bilder genau an. Wähle das Bild aus, das zu den Wörtern passt, die du hörst.
records.back_translation: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, and then look closely at the pictures. Select the picture that matches the words you hear.

records.source_text: These questions ask you about how you feel at school and some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time. The first two are for practice.
records.target_text: In diesen Fragen geht es darum, wie du dich in der Schule fühlst und was du in der Schule machst. Es gibt keine richtigen oder falschen Antworten. Wähle die Antwort, die am besten beschreibt, was du denkst. Nein, nie; Ja, manchmal; Ja, meistens; Ja, immer. Die ersten beiden Fragen sind zum Üben.
records.back_translation: These questions are about how you feel at school and what you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, mostly; Yes, always. The first two questions are for practice.

records.source_text: Do you like to read comic books?
records.target_text: Liest du gerne Comics?
records.back_translation: Do you like reading comics?

records.source_text: Are you neat and tidy at school?
records.target_text: Bist du in der Schule ordentlich?
records.back_translation: Are you tidy at school?

records.source_text: Is your teacher nice to you?
records.target_text: Ist dein Lehrer nett zu dir?
records.back_translation: Is your teacher nice to you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher like you?
records.target_text: Mag dich dein Lehrer?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher like you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher listen to you?
records.target_text: Hört dein Lehrer dir zu?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher listen to you?

records.source_text: Is school fun?

records.back_translation: Is school fun?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy school?

records.back_translation: Do you like going to school?

records.source_text: Are you happy at school?
records.target_text: Bist du glücklich in der Schule?
records.back_translation: Are you happy at school?

records.source_text: Do you feel safe at school?
records.target_text: Fühlst du dich in der Schule sicher?
records.back_translation: Do you feel safe at school?

records.source_text: Do you have friends in your class?

records.back_translation: Do you have friends in your class?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class help you when you need it?

records.back_translation: Do the children in your class help you when you need help?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class play with you?

records.back_translation: Do the children in your class play with you?

records.source_text: Are the kids in your class nice to you?
records.target_text: Sind die Kinder in deiner Klasse nett zu dir?
records.back_translation: Are the children in your class nice to you?

records.source_text: Do you feel lonely at school?
records.target_text: Fühlst du dich in der Schule einsam?
records.back_translation: Do you feel lonely at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at learning things in school?
records.target_text: Bist du gut darin, in der Schule etwas zu lernen?
records.back_translation: Are you good at learning things in school?

records.source_text: When schoolwork is hard, do you give up right away?
records.target_text: Gibst du sofort auf, wenn dir die Schularbeit schwer fällt?
records.back_translation: Do you give up immediately if you find schoolwork difficult?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing reading activities at school?
records.target_text: Macht es dir Spaß in der Schule zu lesen?
records.back_translation: Do you enjoy reading at school?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing math activities at school?

records.back_translation: Do you enjoy math?

records.source_text: Are you good at reading?

records.back_translation: Are you good at reading?

records.source_text: Are you good at math?
records.target_text: Bist du gut in Mathe?
records.back_translation: Are you good at math?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get smarter if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get smarter if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Manche Kinder glauben, dass sie schlauer werden können, wenn sie sich anstrengen. Bist du auch der Meinung, dass du schlauer werden kannst, wenn du dich anstrengst?
records.back_translation: Some children believe they can become smarter if they make an effort. Do you also think you can become smarter if you make an effort?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at reading if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at reading if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Manche Kinder glauben, dass sie besser lesen können, wenn sie sich richtig anstrengen. Bist du auch der Meinung, dass du besser lesen kannst, wenn du dich richtig anstrengst?
records.back_translation: Some children believe that they can read better if they really try hard. Do you also think that you can read better if you really try hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at math if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at math if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Manche Kinder glauben, dass sie in Mathematik besser werden können, wenn sie sich richtig anstrengen. Bist du auch der Meinung, dass man in Mathe besser wird, wenn man sich richtig anstrengt?
records.back_translation: Some children believe that they can improve in mathematics if they really try hard. Do you also think that you get better at math if you really try hard?

records.source_text: No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time
records.target_text: Nein, nie; Ja, manchmal; Ja, meistens; Ja, immer
records.back_translation: No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, mostly; Yes, always

records.source_text: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Das ist Diana. Als sie heute Morgen in die Schule kam, hat Diana ihr Spielzeug in diese Schublade gelegt, weil sie nicht wollte, dass es jemand findet.
records.back_translation: This is Diana. When she came to school this morning, Diana put her toy in this drawer because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But while Diana was outside, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer, to inside the desk.
records.target_text: Aber während Diana draußen war, hat es jemand gefunden und aus der Schublade in den Schreibtisch gelegt.
records.back_translation: But while Diana was outside, someone found it and put it from the drawer into the desk.

records.source_text: So now it’s playtime and Diana wants her toy.
records.target_text: Nun haben die Kinder Zeit zum Spielen und Diana möchte ihr Spielzeug holen.
records.back_translation: Now the children have time to play and Diana wants to get her toy.

records.source_text: Where will Diana look for her toy?
records.target_text: Wo wird Diana nach ihrem Spielzeug suchen?
records.back_translation: Where will Diana look for her toy?

records.source_text: And where is her toy really?
records.target_text: Und wo ist ihr Spielzeug wirklich?
records.back_translation: And where is her toy really?

records.source_text: In the desk
records.target_text: Im Schreibtisch
records.back_translation: In the desk

records.source_text: In the drawer
records.target_text: In der Schublade
records.back_translation: In the drawer

records.source_text: This morning when she came to school, Allie put her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.
records.target_text: Heute Morgen, als sie in die Schule kam, legte Linda ihren gelben Bleistift auf das Regal über dem Rucksackregal.
records.back_translation: This morning, when she came to school, Linda put her yellow pencil on the shelf above the backpack shelf.

records.source_text: And then she went outside to play, see? Here’s Allie playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Allie’s yellow pencil fell down from on top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, see?
records.target_text: Und dann ist sie zum spielen nach draußen gegangen, siehst du? Und während sie draußen spielte, fiel Lindas gelber Bleistift von oben runter und hinter das Rucksackregal, siehst du?
records.back_translation: And then she went outside to play, you see? And while she was playing outside, Linda's yellow pencil fell down from above and behind the backpack shelf, you see?

records.source_text: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike’s pencil is also yellow! But Allie is still outside playing, so she didn’t see what Mike was doing.
records.target_text: Dann kommt Tim herein, und Tim legt seinen Bleistift auf das Regal über dem Rucksackregal. Tims Bleistift ist auch gelb! Aber Linda ist noch draußen und spielt, deshalb hat sie nicht gesehen, was Tim gemacht hat.
records.back_translation: Then Tim comes in, and Tim puts his pencil on the shelf above the backpack shelf. Tim's pencil is also yellow! But Linda is still outside playing, so she hasn't seen what Tim did.

records.source_text: Now, when Allie comes in from outside, where will she look first for her pencil?
records.target_text: Wenn Linda jetzt von draußen reinkommt, wo wird sie zuerst nach ihrem Bleistift suchen?
records.back_translation: If Linda comes in from outside now, where will she first look for her pencil?

records.source_text: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Oben auf dem Regal über dem Rucksackregal.
records.back_translation: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf.

records.source_text: Behind the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Hinter dem Rucksackregal
records.back_translation: Behind the backpack shelf

records.source_text: Let’s see what she does. Oh look, here is Allie reaching for this pencil up on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie reaching for that pencil... the pencil that is Mike's!
records.target_text: Schauen wir mal, was sie macht. Oh, sieh mal, hier greift Linda nach dem Bleistift oben auf dem Regal. Und jetzt sieht Tim, wie Linda nach dem Bleistift greift... dem Bleistift, der Tim gehört!
records.back_translation: Let's see what she's doing. Oh, look, here Linda is reaching for the pencil on top of the shelf. And now Tim sees Linda reaching for the pencil... the pencil that belongs to Tim!

records.source_text: How do you think Mike feels about Allie reaching for that pencil?
records.target_text: Was glaubst du, wie Tim sich fühlt, wenn Linda nach dem Bleistift greift?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how does Tim feel when Linda reaches for the pencil?

records.source_text: How do you think Mike would feel if he had not seen Allie reaching for the pencil?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Tim wohl fühlen, wenn er nicht gesehen hätte, wie Linda nach dem Bleistift greift?
records.back_translation: How would Tim feel if he hadn't seen Linda reach for the pencil?

records.source_text: Is Allie being mean and naughty for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Ist es gemein und frech von Linda, dass sie Tims Bleistift genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Is it mean and cheeky of Linda that she took Tim's pencil?

records.source_text: Should Allie get in trouble with the teacher for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Sollte Linda Ärger mit der Lehrerin bekommen, weil sie Tims Bleistift genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Should Linda get in trouble with the teacher because she took Tim's pencil?

records.source_text: Can you help Mike find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Kannst du Tim helfen, seinen Bleistift zu finden? Liegt er oben auf dem Regal oder hinter dem Rucksackregal?
records.back_translation: Can you help Tim find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Kannst du Linda helfen, ihren Bleistift zu finden? Liegt er oben auf dem Regal oder hinter dem Rucksackregal?
records.back_translation: Can you help Linda find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.
records.target_text: Das ist Mark. Mark spielt heute ein wirklich albernes Spiel und sagt den ganzen Tag lang kein einziges Wort. Stattdessen malt Mark Bilder. Mark ist in der Bibliothek und überlegt, welches Buch er gerne lesen möchte. Mama zeigt Mark zwei Bücher, ein Buch über Tassen und ein Buch über Hügel.
records.back_translation: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and isn't saying a single word all day long. Instead, Mark is painting pictures. Mark is in the library and is thinking about which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.

records.source_text: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside-down, so that it looks like a cup!
records.target_text: Mark malt ein Bild von einem Hügel, um Mama zu sagen, dass er das Buch über Hügel lesen möchte. Aber als Mark Mama das Bild gibt, hält sie es verkehrt herum so dass es wie eine Tasse aussieht!
records.back_translation: Mark paints a picture of a hill to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside down so that it looks like a cup!

records.source_text: What did Mark mean to draw?
records.target_text: Was wollte Mark eigentlich zeichnen?
records.back_translation: What did Mark actually want to draw?

records.source_text: A hill
records.target_text: Einen Hügel
records.back_translation: A hill

records.source_text: A cup
records.target_text: Eine Tasse
records.back_translation: A cup

records.source_text: When Mom sees the picture, what book will she give Mark?
records.target_text: Wenn Mama das Bild sieht, welches Buch wird sie Mark geben?
records.back_translation: When Mom sees the picture, which book will she give Mark?

records.source_text: What book does Mark really want?
records.target_text: Welches Buch will Mark wirklich?
records.back_translation: Which book does Mark really want?

records.source_text: The book about hills
records.target_text: Das Buch über Hügel
records.back_translation: The book about hills

records.source_text: The book about cups
records.target_text: Das Buch über Tassen
records.back_translation: The book about cups

records.source_text: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?
records.target_text: Sieh mal, Mama hat den Fehler erkannt und Mark das Buch gegeben, das er wirklich wollte! Was glaubst du, wie sich Mark fühlt, weil er das Buch bekommen hat, das er wollte?
records.back_translation: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah tells all of the kids to take one storybook from the bag that she brought. There is one storybook for every kid.
records.target_text: Lehrerin Sarah bittet alle Kinder, sich ein Bilderbuch aus der Tasche zu nehmen, die sie mitgebracht hat. Für jedes Kind gibt es ein Bilderbuch.
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks all the children to take a picture book from the bag she brought. There is a picture book for each child.

records.source_text: Now there are two storybooks left, and Brian and Megan are the last two kids without storybooks. But when Brian goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows that Megan doesn’t have a storybook yet, and that everyone is only supposed to have one. Brian hides the extra storybook in his desk.
records.target_text: Jetzt sind noch zwei Märchenbücher übrig, und Alexander und Tina sind die letzten beiden Kinder ohne Märchenbuch. Aber als Alexander sein Bilderbuch holen geht, beschließt er, beide Bilderbücher zu nehmen, obwohl er weiß, dass Tina noch kein Bilderbuch hat und dass jedes Kind nur eins haben darf. Alexander versteckt das zusätzliche Märchenbuch in seinem Schreibtisch.
records.back_translation: Now there are two fairy tale books left, and Alexander and Tina are the last two children without a fairy tale book. But when Alexander goes to get his picture book, he decides to take both picture books, even though he knows that Tina doesn't have a picture book yet and that each child is only allowed to have one. Alexander hides the extra fairy tale book in his desk.

records.source_text: How does Megan feel about being the only child without a storybook?
records.target_text: Wie fühlt sich Tina, weil sie das einzige Kind ohne ein Märchenbuch ist?
records.back_translation: How does Tina feel because she is the only child without a fairy tale book?

records.source_text: How would Megan feel if she received a book?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Tina fühlen, wenn sie ein Buch bekommen würde?
records.back_translation: How would Tina feel if she received a book?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah asks Brian, “Is there a storybook leftover, so Megan can have one?” Brian tells Teacher Sarah, “No, there is no storybook left. They are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Lehrerin Sarah fragt Alexander: „Ist noch ein Märchenbuch übrig, damit Tina eins haben kann?“  Alexander sagt zu Lehrerin Sarah: „Nein, es ist kein Märchenbuch übrig. Sie werden gerade alle benutzt.“
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks Alexander: "Is there a fairy tale book left so Tina can have one?" Alexander says to Teacher Sarah: "No, there is no fairy tale book left. They are all being used right now."

records.source_text: Is Brian lying?
records.target_text: Lügt Alexander?
records.back_translation: Is Alexander lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Ist noch ein Märchenbuch übrig, das gerade nicht benutzt wird?
records.back_translation: Is there a fairy tale book left that is not currently being used?

records.source_text: Megan is sad that she doesn’t have a storybook, and asks Teacher Sarah, "is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says, “I’m so sorry Megan, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Tina ist traurig, dass sie kein Märchenbuch hat, und fragt Lehrerin Sarah: „Gibt es ein zusätzliches Märchenbuch für mich?" Lehrerin Sarah sagt: „Es tut mir so leid, Tina, aber es gibt keine Märchenbücher mehr, sie werden gerade alle benutzt.“
records.back_translation: Tina is sad that she doesn't have a fairy tale book and asks teacher Sarah: "Is there an extra fairy tale book for me?" Teacher Sarah says: "I'm so sorry, Tina, but there are no more fairy tale books; they are all currently in use."

records.source_text: Is Teacher Sarah lying?
records.target_text: Lügt Lehrerin Sarah?
records.back_translation: Is teacher Sarah lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Ist noch ein Märchenbuch übrig, das gerade nicht benutzt wird?
records.back_translation: Is there a fairy tale book left that is not currently being used?

records.source_text: This is Josh. Earlier today, Josh was tidying his room. Josh put his big basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball down on the bottom shelf.
records.target_text: Das ist Karl. Heute früh hat Karl sein Zimmer aufgeräumt. Karl hat seinen großen Basketball auf den Schreibtisch gelegt, seinen mittelgroßen Fußball auf den Tisch und seinen kleinen Baseball auf das unterste Regal.
records.back_translation: This is Karl. Early this morning, Karl tidied his room. Karl put his large basketball on the desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on the table, and his small baseball on the bottom shelf.

records.source_text: Josh’s mom just walked in and Josh asks his mom to get one of the toys. Josh tells his mom, “I want the small ball!”
records.target_text: Karls Mutter kam gerade herein und Karl bat seine Mutter, eines der Spielzeuge zu holen. Karl sagt zu seiner Mutter: „Ich will den kleinen Ball!“
records.back_translation: Karl's mother just came in and Karl asked his mother to get one of the toys. Karl says to his mother: "I want the little ball!"

records.source_text: Which ball will mom get for Josh?
records.target_text: Welchen Ball wird Mama für Karl holen?
records.back_translation: Which ball will Mom get for Karl?

records.source_text: Which ball does Josh want?
records.target_text: Welchen Ball will Karl?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Karl want?

records.source_text: The small baseball
records.target_text: Den kleinen Baseball
records.back_translation: The small baseball

records.source_text: The medium sized soccer ball
records.target_text: Den mittelgroßen Fußball
records.back_translation: The medium-sized football

records.source_text: The big basketball
records.target_text: Den großen Basketball
records.back_translation: The big basketball

records.source_text: Josh wanted the baseball but mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Josh feels about receiving the wrong toy?
records.target_text: Karl wollte den Baseball, aber Mama gab ihm den Fußball! Was denkst du, wie sich Karl fühlt, wenn er das falsche Spielzeug bekommt?
records.back_translation: Karl wanted the baseball, but Mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Karl feels when he gets the wrong toy?

records.source_text: How do you think Josh would feel if he had received the correct toy?
records.target_text: Was denkst du, wie er sich fühlen würde, wenn er das richtige Spielzeug bekommen hätte?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how would he feel if he had gotten the right toy?

records.source_text: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she would like to take to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball at recess.
records.target_text: Heute Morgen fragte Papa Emma, welches Spielzeug sie gerne mit in die Schule nehmen würde, und Emma sagte ihm, dass sie in der Pause gerne mit ihrem gelben Ball spielen würde.
records.back_translation: This morning, Dad asked Emma which toy she would like to take to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball during the break.

records.source_text: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind, so she yelled to her dad, “Actually, may I please have my red ball instead?” and kept getting ready for school. But Dad did not hear Emma ask for her red ball.
records.target_text: Dann ging Emma in ihr Zimmer, um sich für die Schule fertig zu machen. Während sie sich fertig machte, änderte sie ihre Meinung und rief ihrem Vater zu: „Darf ich stattdessen meinen roten Ball haben?“ und machte sich weiter fertig für die Schule. Aber Papa hörte nicht, wie Emma nach ihrem roten Ball fragte.
records.back_translation: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind and called out to her father: "May I have my red ball instead?" and continued getting ready for school. But Dad didn't hear Emma ask for her red ball.

records.source_text: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Papa, welches Spielzeug Emma mit in die Schule nehmen möchte?
records.back_translation: What does Dad think, which toy does Emma want to take to school?

records.source_text: Dad didn’t hear Emma say she wants her red ball. So dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad goes to pack Emma’s bag, but can’t find her yellow ball in the toy box! But dad finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.
records.target_text: Papa hat Emma nicht sagen hören, dass sie ihren roten Ball haben möchte. Deshalb denkt Papa, dass Emma ihren gelben Ball haben möchte. Papa geht los, um Emmas Tasche zu packen, kann aber ihren gelben Ball in der Spielzeugkiste nicht finden! Aber Papa findet einen blauen Ball in der Spielzeugkiste, also packt er stattdessen den blauen Ball für Emma ein.
records.back_translation: Papa didn't hear Emma say that she wants her red ball. That's why Papa thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Papa goes to pack Emma's bag but can't find her yellow ball in the toy box! But Papa finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.

records.source_text: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?
records.target_text: Weiß Emma, dass Papa den blauen Ball eingepackt hat?
records.back_translation: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?

records.source_text: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?
records.target_text: Welchen Ball, glaubt Emma, hat Papa eingepackt?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?

records.source_text: The yellow ball
records.target_text: Der gelbe Ball
records.back_translation: The yellow ball

records.source_text: The red ball
records.target_text: Den roten Ball
records.back_translation: The red ball

records.source_text: The blue ball
records.target_text: Der blaue Ball
records.back_translation: The blue ball

records.source_text: On the way to school, Dad tells Emma, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t pack the toy that you wanted because I couldn’t find it”.
records.target_text: Auf dem Weg zur Schule sagt Papa zu Emma: „Es tut mir so leid, ich konnte das Spielzeug, das du dir gewünscht hast, nicht einpacken, weil ich es nicht finden konnte“.
records.back_translation: On the way to school, Dad says to Emma: "I'm so sorry, I couldn't pack the toy you wanted because I couldn't find it."

records.source_text: What toy does Emma want?
records.target_text: Welches Spielzeug wünscht sich Emma?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Emma want?

records.source_text: What toy did Dad pack for Emma?
records.target_text: Welches Spielzeug hat Papa für Emma eingepackt?
records.back_translation: Which toy did Dad pack for Emma?

records.source_text: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.
records.target_text: Emma ist sehr glücklich, mit ihrem Ball zu spielen.
records.back_translation: Emma is very happy playing with her ball.

records.source_text: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil box.
records.target_text: Das ist Gabriel. Heute Nachmittag in der Schule hat Gabriel seinen Bleistift in seine Federtasche gelegt.
records.back_translation: This is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil case.

records.source_text: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel’s pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.
records.target_text: Aber während Gabriel draußen war, hat jemand seinen Bleistift benutzt! Nachdem die Person Gabriels Bleistift benutzt hatte, legte sie ihn in einen Becher.
records.back_translation: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After the person used Gabriel's pencil, they put it in a cup.

records.source_text: So now it’s time for class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.
records.target_text: Jetzt ist es Zeit für den Unterricht, und Gabriel sucht seinen Bleistift.
records.back_translation: Now it's time for class, and Gabriel is looking for his pencil.

records.source_text: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?
records.target_text: Wo wird Gabriel nach seinem Bleistift suchen?
records.back_translation: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?

records.source_text: In the box
records.target_text: In der Federtasche
records.explanation: The translation 'In der Federtasche' means 'In the pencil case'. This is a mistranslation of 'In the box', which should refer to a generic box, not a specific school supply.
records.suggested_fix: In der Schachtel
records.back_translation: In the pencil case

records.source_text: In the basket
records.target_text: Im Becher
records.back_translation: In the cup

records.source_text: And where is his pencil really?
records.target_text: Und wo ist sein Bleistift wirklich?
records.back_translation: And where is his pencil really?

records.source_text: This afternoon when he came home, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.
records.target_text: Als er heute Nachmittag nach Hause kam, hat Bobby seinen Fußball auf den Tisch gelegt.
records.back_translation: When he came home this afternoon, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Bobby playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Bobby’s soccer ball fell off the table and onto the floor.
records.target_text: Und dann ging er nach draußen, um zu spielen, siehst du? Hier ist Bobby beim Spielen im Freien. Und während er draußen spielte, fiel Bobbys Fußball vom Tisch auf den Boden.
records.back_translation: And then he went outside to play, you see? Here's Bobby playing outdoors. And while he was playing outside, Bobby's soccer ball fell from the table to the floor.

records.source_text: Then Bobby’s sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn’t see what Anna was doing.
records.target_text: Dann kommt Bobbys Schwester Anna herein. Anna hat auch einen Fußball! Anna legt ihren Fußball auf den Tisch. Bobby ist immer noch draußen und spielt, deshalb hat er nicht gesehen, was Anna gemacht hat.
records.back_translation: Then Bobby's sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Anna did.

records.source_text: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look first for his soccer ball?
records.target_text: Wenn Bobby jetzt von draußen reinkommt, wo wird er zuerst nach seinem Fußball suchen?
records.back_translation: If Bobby comes in from outside now, where will he first look for his soccer ball?

records.source_text: On the table
records.target_text: Auf dem Tisch
records.back_translation: On the table

records.source_text: On the floor
records.target_text: Auf dem Boden
records.back_translation: On the floor

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for that soccer ball... the soccer ball that is Anna's!
records.target_text: Schauen wir mal, was er macht. Oh, sieh mal, hier ist Bobby, der nach dem Fußball auf dem Tisch greift. Und jetzt sieht Anna, wie Bobby nach dem Fußball greift ... dem Fußball, der Anna gehört!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh, look, here's Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for the soccer ball... the soccer ball that belongs to Anna!

records.source_text: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby reaching for that soccer ball?
records.target_text: Was denkst du, wie Anna sich fühlt, wenn Bobby nach dem Fußball greift?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how does Anna feel when Bobby grabs the soccer ball?

records.source_text: How do you think Anna would feel if she had not seen Bobby reaching for the soccer ball?
records.target_text: Was denkst du, wie Anna sich fühlen würde, wenn sie nicht gesehen hätte, wie Bobby nach dem Fußball gegriffen hat?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how would Anna feel if she hadn't seen how Bobby grabbed the soccer ball?

records.source_text: Is Bobby being mean and naughty for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Ist Bobby gemein und frech, weil er Annas Fußball genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Is Bobby mean and cheeky because he took Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Should Bobby get in trouble with their mom for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Sollte Bobby Ärger mit seiner Mutter bekommen, weil er Annas Fußball genommen hat?
records.back_translation: Should Bobby get in trouble with his mother because he took Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Kannst du Anna helfen, ihren Fußball zu finden? Liegt er auf dem Tisch oder auf dem Boden?
records.back_translation: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Kannst du Bobby helfen, seinen Fußball zu finden? Liegt er auf dem Tisch oder auf dem Boden?
records.back_translation: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Robin, Sina und Tobias spielen ein Spiel im Park. Das Spiel läuft folgendermaßen ab: Ein Kind versteckt sich, malt aber einen Hinweis in den Sandkasten, damit die anderen Kinder es finden können.
records.back_translation: Robin, Sina, and Tobias are playing a game in the park. The game works as follows: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so that the other children can find them.

records.source_text: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny means to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Johnny goes to hide behind the flower bush.
records.target_text: Tobias beschließt, sich hinter den Blumensträuchern zu verstecken. Er malt einen Hinweis in den Sand. Tobias will den Strauch zeichnen, aber die Zeichnung sieht stattdessen wie ein Stein aus! Dann versteckt sich Tobias hinter den Blumensträuchern.
records.back_translation: Tobias decides to hide behind the flower bushes. He draws a clue in the sand. Tobias wants to draw the bush, but the drawing looks like a stone instead! Then Tobias hides behind the flower bushes.

records.source_text: What did Johnny mean to draw?
records.target_text: Was wollte Tobias zeichnen?
records.back_translation: What did Tobias want to draw?

records.source_text: A flower bush
records.target_text: Einen Blumenstrauch
records.back_translation: A flower bush

records.source_text: A rock
records.target_text: Einen Felsen
records.back_translation: A rock

records.source_text: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?
records.target_text: Wenn Robin und Sina diesen Hinweis sehen, wo werden sie zuerst nach Tobias suchen? Hinter dem Blumenstrauch oder hinter dem Felsen?
records.back_translation: If Robin and Sina see this clue, where will they look for Tobias first? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Johnny really is?
records.target_text: Kannst du ihnen helfen, herauszufinden, wo Tobias wirklich ist?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find out where Tobias really is?

records.source_text: Behind the flower bush
records.target_text: Hinter dem Blumenstrauch
records.back_translation: Behind the flower bush

records.source_text: Behind the rock
records.target_text: Hinter dem Felsen
records.back_translation: Behind the rock

records.source_text: Look, Alex and Beth found Johnny, and won the game! How do you think Alex and Beth feel about winning the game?
records.target_text: Schau, Robin und Sina haben Tobias gefunden und das Spiel gewonnen! Was denkst du, wie Robin und Sina sich fühlen, weil sie das Spiel gewonnen haben?
records.back_translation: Look, Robin and Sina found Tobias and won the game! What do you think, how do Robin and Sina feel because they won the game?

records.source_text: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.
records.target_text: Papa sagt Jakob und Sophie, sie sollen sich für die Schule fertig machen. Papa sagt ihnen, dass sie ihre Schuhe anziehen sollen.
records.back_translation: Papa tells Jakob and Sophie to get ready for school. Papa tells them to put on their shoes.

records.source_text: Sophie can’t find one of her shoes! She’s looking everywhere but she can't find it.
records.target_text: Sophie kann einen ihrer Schuhe nicht finden! Sie sucht überall, aber sie kann ihn nicht finden.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find one of her shoes! She's looking everywhere, but she can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Sophie feel about losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Wie fühlt sich Sophie, weil sie ihren Schuh verloren hat?
records.back_translation: How does Sophie feel because she lost her shoe?

records.source_text: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?
records.target_text: Wie würde sich Sophie fühlen, wenn sie ihren Schuh finden würde?
records.back_translation: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?

records.source_text: Sophie can't find her shoe because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.
records.target_text: Sophie kann ihren Schuh nicht finden, denn früher am Tag, als niemand hinsah, hat Jakob Sophie einen Streich gespielt und ihren Schuh in der Spielzeugkiste versteckt.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find her shoe, because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Jakob played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.

records.source_text: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can’t find her shoe. Dad gets mad at Sophie, because she lost her shoe and now they are late for school.
records.target_text: Sophie sucht also überall, aber sie kann ihren Schuh nicht finden. Papa wird wütend auf Sophie, weil sie ihren Schuh verloren hat und sie nun zu spät zur Schule kommen.
records.back_translation: So Sophie searches everywhere, but she can't find her shoe. Papa gets angry at Sophie because she lost her shoe and now they will be late for school.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Ist es fair, dass Papa sauer auf Sophie ist, weil sie ihren Schuh verloren hat?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie because she lost her shoe?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James?
records.target_text: Ist Papa böse auf Jakob?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Jakob?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James?
records.target_text: Ist Sophie böse auf Jakob?
records.back_translation: Is Sophie mad at Jakob?

records.source_text: When James sees that Dad is mad at Sophie, he goes to the toy box and gets the shoe, and gives it back to Sophie.
records.target_text: Als Jakob sieht, dass Papa sauer auf Sophie ist, geht er zur Spielzeugkiste, holt den Schuh und gibt ihn Sophie zurück.
records.back_translation: When Jakob sees that Papa is mad at Sophie, he goes to the toy box, gets the shoe, and gives it back to Sophie.

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at Sophie now?
records.target_text: Ist Papa jetzt sauer auf Sophie?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Sophie now?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James now?
records.target_text: Ist Papa jetzt sauer auf Jakob?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Jakob now?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James now?
records.target_text: Ist Sophie jetzt sauer auf Jakob?
records.back_translation: Is Sophie mad at Jakob now?

records.source_text: James tells Sophie that he’s very sorry, and Sophie and Dad forgive James. They all hug.
records.target_text: Jakob sagt Sophie, dass es ihm sehr leid tut, und Sophie und Papa nehmen die Entschuldigung an. Sie umarmen sich alle.
records.back_translation: Jakob tells Sophie that he is very sorry, and Sophie and Papa accept the apology. They all hug.

records.source_text: This is Mika. Mika’s mom owns a bookshop, and sometimes Mika helps out. Earlier today, Mika was organizing books on tables and shelves. Mika put a very large stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.
records.target_text: Das ist Mika. Mikas Mutter hat eine Buchhandlung, und manchmal hilft Mika dort mit. Heute hat Mika die Bücher auf Tischen und Regalen sortiert. Mika hat einen sehr großen Stapel blauer Bücher auf den Schreibtisch gelegt, einen mittelgroßen Stapel roter Bücher auf den Tisch und einen kleinen Stapel gelber Bücher ins Regal.
records.back_translation: This is Mika. Mika's mother owns a bookstore, and sometimes Mika helps out there. Today, Mika sorted the books on tables and shelves. Mika placed a very large stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.

records.source_text: Mika’s mom just walked in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where the book is, and tells mom, “The book is in the small stack!”
records.target_text: Mikas Mutter kommt gerade herein. Mama fragt Mika nach einem der Bücher. Mika erinnert sich, wo das Buch ist, und sagt zu Mama: „Das Buch ist in dem kleinen Stapel!“
records.back_translation: Mika's mother just came in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where the book is and says to Mom: "The book is in the small pile!"

records.source_text: Which stack of books will mom look in?
records.target_text: In welchem Bücherstapel wird Mama nachsehen?
records.back_translation: In which stack of books will Mom look?

records.source_text: Which stack of books was Mika talking about?
records.target_text: Welchen Bücherstapel hat Mika gemeint?
records.back_translation: Which stack of books did Mika mean?

records.source_text: The large blue stack
records.target_text: Der große blaue Stapel
records.back_translation: The big blue stack

records.source_text: The medium sized red stack
records.target_text: Der mittelgroße rote Stapel
records.back_translation: The medium-sized red stack

records.source_text: The small yellow stack
records.target_text: Der kleine gelbe Stapel
records.back_translation: The small yellow stack

records.source_text: Mom looks in the wrong stack of books and can’t find the book that she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not finding the book she wanted?
records.target_text: Mama schaut in den falschen Stapel und findet das Buch nicht, das sie gesucht hat. Was glaubst du, wie Mama sich fühlt, wenn sie das gewünschte Buch nicht findet?
records.back_translation: Mom looks in the wrong pile and doesn't find the book she was looking for. How do you think Mom feels when she doesn't find the book she wanted?

records.source_text: How do you think Mom would feel if she could find the book she wanted?
records.target_text: Was glaubst du, wie sie sich fühlen würde, wenn sie das Buch finden würde, das sie sucht?
records.back_translation: What do you think, how would she feel if she found the book she is looking for?

records.source_text: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy shop across the street. Kat decides to go buy some new toys at the toy shop. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George says he would like a new basketball.
records.target_text: Georg und Theresa spielen zusammen. Sie schauen nach draußen und sehen auf der anderen Straßenseite ein neues Spielzeuggeschäft. Theresa beschließt, ein paar neue Spielsachen in dem Geschäft zu kaufen. Theresa fragt Georg, welches Spielzeug er gerne hätte, und Georg sagt, er hätte gerne einen neuen Basketball.
records.back_translation: Georg and Theresa are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy store across the street. Theresa decides to buy some new toys at the store. Theresa asks Georg which toy he would like, and Georg says he would like a new basketball.

records.source_text: While Kat is walking to the toy shop, George changes his mind and yells to Kat, “Actually, can I please have some crayons?” But Kat did not hear George ask for crayons.
records.target_text: Während Theresa zum Spielzeugladen geht, ändert Georg seine Meinung und ruft Theresa zu: „Kann ich bitte ein paar Buntstifte haben?“ Aber Theresa hat nicht gehört, wie Georg nach Buntstiften gefragt hat.
records.back_translation: While Theresa walks to the toy store, Georg changes his mind and calls out to Theresa: "Can I please have some colored pencils?" But Theresa did not hear Georg ask for colored pencils.

records.source_text: Which toy does Kat think George wants from the toy shop?
records.target_text: Welches Spielzeug, glaubt Theresa, möchte Georg aus dem Spielzeugladen haben?
records.back_translation: Which toy, does Theresa believe, would Georg like to have from the toy store?

records.source_text: Kat didn’t hear George say that he wanted crayons. So Kat thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy shop, but then the shop owner says that they don’t have any basketballs! But they do have storybooks, so Kat buys a storybook for George instead.
records.target_text: Theresa hat Georg nicht sagen hören, dass er Buntstifte haben möchte. Deshalb glaubt Theresa, dass Georg sich einen Basketball wünscht. Theresa geht in den Spielzeugladen, aber der Ladenbesitzer sagt, dass sie keine Basketbälle haben! Aber sie haben Märchenbücher, also kauft Theresa stattdessen ein Märchenbuch für Georg.
records.back_translation: Theresa didn't hear Georg say that he wanted colored pencils. Therefore, Theresa believes that Georg wants a basketball. Theresa goes to the toy store, but the shop owner says that they don't have any basketballs! But they have fairy tale books, so Theresa buys a fairy tale book for Georg instead.

records.source_text: Does George know that Kat bought a storybook?
records.target_text: Weiß Georg, dass Theresa ein Märchenbuch gekauft hat?
records.back_translation: Does Georg know that Theresa bought a storybook?

records.source_text: What does George think Kat bought at the toy shop?
records.target_text: Was glaubt Georg, was Theresa im Spielzeugladen gekauft hat?
records.back_translation: What does Georg believe Theresa bought at the toy store?

records.source_text: A basketball
records.target_text: Einen Basketball
records.back_translation: A basketball

records.source_text: A storybook
records.target_text: Ein Bilderbuch
records.back_translation: A picture book

records.source_text: Crayons
records.target_text: Buntstifte
records.back_translation: Colored pencils

records.source_text: Kat comes back and tells George, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t buy you a basketball because the store didn’t have any.”
records.target_text: Theresa kommt zurück und sagt zu Georg: „Es tut mir so leid, ich konnte dir keinen Basketball kaufen, weil der Laden keinen hatte.“
records.back_translation: Theresa comes back and says to Georg: "I'm so sorry, I couldn't buy you a basketball because the store didn't have any."

records.source_text: What toy does George want?
records.target_text: Welches Spielzeug wünscht sich Georg?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Georg wish for?

records.source_text: What toy did Kat buy for George?
records.target_text: Welches Spielzeug hat Theresa für Georg gekauft?
records.back_translation: Which toy did Theresa buy for Georg?

records.source_text: George is very happy to play with his new storybook.
records.target_text: Georg ist sehr glücklich, dass er ein neues Bilderbuch hat.
records.back_translation: Georg is very happy that he has a new picture book.
