records.source_text:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
In diesem Spiel wirst du mit Zahlen spielen.

Einige Fragen könnten leicht für dich sein und einige könnten schwer sein. Das ist nicht schlimm! Bitte gib dein Bestes und nimm dir Zeit. Los geht's!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That's okay! Please do your best and take your time. Let's go!

records.source_text: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: Es ist Zeit für das erste Zahlenspiel! Lass uns üben.
records.back_translation: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice.

records.source_text: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: Es ist Zeit für das nächste Zahlenspiel! Lass uns üben.
records.back_translation: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice.

records.source_text: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture! The grownup helping you will press the button.
records.target_text: In diesem Zahlenspiel wirst du sagen, wie viele Dinge im Bild sind! Der Erwachsene, der dir hilft, wird den Knopf drücken.
records.back_translation: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture! The adult helping you will press the button.

records.source_text: This time, you will choose the button with the right number!
records.target_text: Dieses Mal wirst du den Knopf mit der richtigen Zahl wählen!
records.back_translation: This time you will choose the button with the correct number!

records.source_text: This is the memory game.
records.target_text: Dies ist das Gedächtnisspiel.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game.

records.source_text: In this game, we are going to see squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares that light up.
records.target_text: In diesem Spiel werden wir sehen, wie Quadrate aufleuchten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die Quadrate zu berühren, die aufleuchten.
records.back_translation: In this game, we will see how squares light up. Your task is to touch the squares that light up.

records.source_text: Now we will see two squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares in the same order as they light up!
records.target_text: Jetzt werden zwei Quadrate aufleuchten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die Quadrate in derselben Reihenfolge zu berühren, in der sie aufleuchten!
records.back_translation: Now two squares will light up. Your task is to touch the squares in the same order in which they light up!

records.source_text: Watch the squares light up. I will touch the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Sieh zu, wie die Quadrate aufleuchten. Ich werde die Quadrate in derselben Reihenfolge berühren.
records.back_translation: Watch the squares light up. I will touch the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: OK, now you're going to play the rest of the memory game on your own. More squares will light up each time the longer you play, so watch carefully!
records.target_text: Okay, jetzt wirst du den Rest des Gedächtnisspiels alleine spielen. Mehr Quadrate werden jedes Mal aufleuchten, je länger du spielst, also passe gut auf!
records.back_translation: Okay, now you'll play the rest of the memory game alone. More squares will light up each time the longer you play, so pay close attention!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Wenn du einen Fehler machst, mach einfach weiter!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Hi! We are excited to have you play some games with us today!
records.target_text: ¡Hola! ¡Estamos encantados de que juegues hoy con nosotros!
records.back_translation: Hello! We are delighted that you are playing with us today!

records.source_text: First, you get to choose a buddy to play along with you. As you complete the different games, you will get to pick an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your buddy.
records.target_text: En primer lugar, tienes que elegir a un amigo para que juegue contigo. A medida que completes los diferentes juegos, podrás elegir un accesorio como un sombrero o unas gafas para decorar a tu amigo.
records.back_translation: First, you have to choose a friend to play with you. As you complete the different games, you'll be able to choose an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your friend.

records.source_text: Pick a buddy to play with!
records.target_text: ¡Escoge un amigo para jugar!
records.back_translation: Choose a friend to play!

records.source_text: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.
records.target_text: Ahora que ya tienes a tu amigo, queremos explicarte cómo funcionan los juegos.
records.back_translation: Now that you have your friend, we want to explain how the games work.

records.source_text: During the games you will need to listen to instructions so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is the way you like it. If you need to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button up in the corner of your screen.
records.target_text: Durante los juegos tendrás que escuchar las instrucciones, así que asegúrate de que los altavoces están encendidos y el volumen está a tu gusto. Si necesitas volver a escuchar las instrucciones, presiona el botón del altavoz situado en la esquina superior de la pantalla.
records.back_translation: During the games you will have to listen to the instructions, so make sure the speakers are on and the volume is to your liking. If you need to listen to the instructions again, press the speaker button located in the upper corner of the screen.

records.source_text:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can pick the way that works best for you.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, please ask the adult who is nearby to help you.
records.target_text:
Puedes elegir tus respuestas de diferentes maneras dependiendo del tipo de tableta u ordenador que estés utilizando. Puedes utilizar un ratón o un panel táctil para hacer clic en tu elección, puedes utilizar las teclas de flecha del teclado o puedes tocar la pantalla si utilizas una tableta. Puedes elegir la forma que más te convenga.

Si tienes alguna duda o necesitas ayuda para empezar, pide ayuda al adulto que esté cerca.
records.back_translation:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or a trackpad to click on your choice, you can use the arrow keys on the keyboard, or you can touch the screen if you are using a tablet. You can choose the method that suits you best.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, ask the adult nearby for assistance.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. 

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
En este juego, harás algunos problemas de matemáticas. Algunos serán como los que haces en la escuela y otros serán un poco diferentes de los que haces en la escuela. 

Algunas preguntas te resultarán fáciles y otras difíciles. ¡No pasa nada! Esfuérzate al máximo y tómate tu tiempo. La mayoría de las preguntas tienen cuatro opciones. Elige la que consideres correcta. ¡Empecemos!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school, and others will be a little different from the ones you do in school.

Some questions will be easy for you, and others will be difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Most questions have four options. Choose the one you think is correct. Let's begin!

records.source_text: The girl wearing a backpack was shown a flower by her friend.

records.explanation: The translation incorrectly shifts from passive voice in the source ('was shown a flower by her friend') to active voice ('su amiga le mostró una flor'). This fundamentally alters the grammatical structure being tested in a TROG item, which is critical for assessing comprehension of passive constructions.
records.suggested_fix: A la niña que llevaba el morral le fue mostrada una flor por su amiga.
records.back_translation: The friend showed a flower to the girl who was carrying the backpack.

records.source_text: This is the Stories Game. In this game, you will listen to some stories. Then you will answer questions about the stories.

records.back_translation: This is the Story Game. In this game, you are going to listen to some stories and then you are going to answer questions about those stories.

records.source_text: Nice work! Here is a new story.
records.target_text: ¡Bien hecho! Ahora vamos con una nueva historia.
records.back_translation: Well done! Now let's go with a new story.

records.source_text: Here is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Esta es Marisol. Esta mañana, Marisol puso su libro detrás de la silla, porque no quería que nadie lo encontrara.
records.back_translation: This is Marisol. This morning, Marisol put her book behind the chair, because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But when Madison was outside playing, someone did find it! And hid it under the rug.
records.target_text: Pero cuando Marisol estaba afuera jugando, ¡alguien lo encontró! Y lo escondió debajo de la alfombra.
records.back_translation: But when Marisol was outside playing, someone found it! And hid it under the rug.

records.source_text: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
records.target_text: Ahora, es el momento de leer y Marisol quiere su libro.
records.back_translation: Now, it's time to read and Marisol wants her book.

records.source_text: Where will Madison look first for her book?
records.target_text: ¿Dónde buscará Marisol su libro primero?
records.back_translation: Where will Marisol look for her book first?

records.source_text: Behind the chair
records.target_text: Detrás de la silla
records.back_translation: Behind the chair

records.source_text: Under the rug
records.target_text: Debajo de la alfombra
records.back_translation: Underneath the carpet

records.source_text: And where is her book really?
records.target_text: ¿Y dónde está realmente su libro?
records.back_translation: And where is your book really?

records.source_text: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
records.target_text: Esta mañana, cuando vino a la escuela, Elián puso su libro sobre la repisa encima de los colgaderos de abrigos. El libro de Elián es azul.
records.back_translation: This morning, when he came to school, Elián put his book on the shelf above the coat hangers. Elián's book is blue.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
records.target_text: Y luego salió a jugar, ¿ves? Aquí está Elián jugando afuera. Mientras Elián estaba afuera jugando, su libro se cayó de la repisa y quedó en el piso, debajo de los abrigos, ¿ves?
records.back_translation: And then he went out to play, see? Here's Elián playing outside. While Elián was outside playing, his book fell off the shelf and landed on the floor, under the coats, see?

records.source_text: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
records.target_text: Luego entró Ana y puso su libro sobre la repisa encima de los colgaderos. ¡El libro de Ana también es azul! Como Elián todavía está afuera jugando, no vio lo que hizo Ana.
records.back_translation: Then Ana came in and put her book on the shelf above the hangers. Ana's book is also blue! Since Elián is still outside playing, he didn't see what Ana did.

records.source_text: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
records.target_text: Entonces, cuando Elián regrese, ¿dónde buscará primero su libro?
records.back_translation: So, when Elián returns, where will he look for his book first?

records.source_text: On the shelf
records.target_text: Sobre la repisa
records.back_translation: On the shelf

records.source_text: Under the coats
records.target_text: Debajo de los abrigos
records.back_translation: Under the coats

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
records.target_text: Veamos lo que Elián hace. Oh, mira, Elián está cogiendo el libro que está sobre la repisa. Y ahora Ana ve a Elián cogiendo ese libro... ¡el libro que es de Ana!
records.back_translation: Let's see what Elián does. Oh, look, Elián is taking the book that is on the shelf. And now Ana sees Elián taking that book... the book that belongs to Ana!

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se siente Ana cuando Elián coge ese libro?
records.back_translation: How do you think Ana feels when Elián takes that book?

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría Ana si no hubiera visto a Elián coger el libro?
records.back_translation: How do you think Ana would feel if she hadn't seen Elián take the book?

records.source_text: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: ¿Elián está siendo malo y travieso al tomar el libro de Ana?
records.back_translation: Is Elián being bad and naughty by taking Ana's book?

records.source_text: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: ¿Debería Elián estar en problemas con el maestro por tomar el libro de Ana?
records.back_translation: Should Elián be in trouble with the teacher for taking Ana's book?

records.source_text: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudar a Ana a encontrar su libro? ¿Está sobre la repisa o debajo de los abrigos?
records.back_translation: Can you help Ana find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudar a Elián a encontrar su libro? ¿Está sobre la repisa o debajo de los abrigos?
records.back_translation: Can you help Elián find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Johan, Isabel e Iván están jugando. El juego es el siguiente: Uno de los niños se esconde, pero debe dibujar una pista en la arena que permita a los otros niños encontrarlo.
records.back_translation: Johan, Isabel, and Iván are playing. The game is as follows: One of the children hides, but must draw a clue in the sand that allows the other children to find him.

records.source_text: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
records.target_text: Entonces, Iván va primero. Dibuja esta pista en la arena y se esconde.
records.back_translation: So, Iván goes first. He draws this track in the sand and hides.

records.source_text: Now it's Joshua's turn to leave a clue, and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.
records.target_text: Ahora le toca a Johan dejar una pista y esconderse. Isabel e Iván intentarán utilizar la pista para encontrarlo.
records.back_translation: Now it's Johan's turn to leave a clue and hide. Isabel and Iván will try to use the clue to find him.

records.source_text: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Joshua goes and hides behind the fountain.
records.target_text: Johan decide esconderse detrás de la fuente. Él dibuja una pista en la arena. Él intenta dibujar la parte inferior de la fuente y el agua que sale de ella, ¡pero el dibujo que hace parece un árbol! Ahora, Johan se esconde detrás de la fuente.
records.back_translation: Johan decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the bottom of the fountain and the water coming out of it, but the drawing he makes looks like a tree! Now, Johan hides behind the fountain.

records.source_text: What did Joshua mean to draw?
records.target_text: ¿Qué quería dibujar Johan?
records.back_translation: What did Johan want to draw?

records.source_text: A fountain
records.target_text: Una fuente
records.back_translation: A source

records.source_text: A tree
records.target_text: Un árbol
records.back_translation: A tree

records.source_text: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look first for Joshua?
records.target_text: Cuando Isabel e Iván vean esta pista, ¿dónde buscarán primero a Johan?
records.back_translation: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look for Johan first?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarles a encontrar dónde está realmente Johan?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find where Johan really is?

records.source_text: Behind the fountain
records.target_text: Detrás de la fuente
records.back_translation: Behind the fountain

records.source_text: Behind the tree
records.target_text: Detrás del árbol
records.back_translation: Behind the tree

records.source_text: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua, and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?
records.target_text: ¡Mira, Isabel e Iván encontraron a Johan y ganaron el juego! ¿Cómo crees que se siente Isabel por ganar el juego?
records.back_translation: Look, Isabel and Iván found Johan and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?

records.source_text: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
records.target_text: Ya se acabaron los juegos y es hora de volver a casa. Mamá les dice a los niños que busquen todos sus juguetes.
records.back_translation: The games are over, and it's time to go home. Mom tells the children to look for all their toys.

records.source_text: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
records.target_text: Johan trajo su camión de juguete al parque, pero ahora no lo encuentra. Lo busca por todas partes, pero no puede encontrarlo.
records.back_translation: Johan brought his toy truck to the park, but now he can't find it. He looks for it everywhere, but he can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Joshua feel about losing his truck?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se siente Johan por perder su camión?
records.back_translation: How does Johan feel about losing his truck?

records.source_text: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se sentiría Johan si encontrara su camión?
records.back_translation: How would Johan feel if he found his truck?

records.source_text: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
records.target_text: Johan no encuentra su camión porque antes, cuando nadie miraba, Isabel cogió el camión de juguete y lo enterró en la arena.
records.back_translation: Johan can't find his truck because earlier, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sand.

records.source_text: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
records.target_text: Por eso, Johan mira por todas partes y no encuentra su camión de juguete. Mamá se enoja con Johan porque perdió el camión.
records.back_translation: That's why Johan looks everywhere and can't find his toy truck. Mom gets angry with Johan because he lost the truck.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
records.target_text: ¿Es justo que Mamá se enoje con Johan por haber perdido su camión?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Mom gets mad at Johan for losing his truck?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: ¿Mamá está enojada con Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Mom mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: ¿Johan está enojado con Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Johan mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
records.target_text: Cuando Isabel se da cuenta de que Mamá está enojada con Johan, va al patio de arena, saca el juguete de la arena y se lo devuelve a Johan.
records.back_translation: When Isabel realizes that Mom is angry with Johan, she goes to the sandbox, takes the toy out of the sand, and returns it to Johan.

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
records.target_text: ¿Ahora Mamá está enojada con Johan?
records.back_translation: Is Mom mad at Johan now?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: ¿Ahora Mamá está enojada con Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Mom angry with Isabel now?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: ¿Ahora Johan está enojado con Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Johan angry with Isabel now?

records.source_text: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
records.target_text: Isabel le pide disculpas a Johan y le da un fuerte abrazo. Johan le devuelve el abrazo, y Mamá se une a ellos.
records.back_translation: Isabel apologizes to Johan and gives him a big hug. Johan returns the hug, and Mom joins them.

records.source_text: This is Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house, while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium sized cup on the table, and a big cup that she put away up high, on the shelf.
records.target_text: Ella es Carla. Hace un rato, la mamá de María limpiaba la casa mientras María observaba. La mamá dejó tres tazas en la cocina: hay una taza pequeña en la barra, una taza mediana en la mesa y una taza grande en un estante que está muy alto.
records.back_translation: She is Carla. A while ago, Maria's mom was cleaning the house while Maria watched. The mom left three cups in the kitchen: there is a small cup on the counter, a medium cup on the table, and a large cup on a shelf that is very high.

records.source_text: Katie and Dad just walked in and Katie asks her dad to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad, “I want the big cup!”
records.target_text: Carla y Papá acaban de entrar y Carla le pide a su papá que le de una taza. Carla le dice a su papá "¡quiero la taza grande!".
records.back_translation: Carla and Dad have just entered and Carla asks her dad to give her a cup. Carla tells her dad "I want the big cup!".

records.source_text: Which cup will Dad give Katie?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál taza le dará el Papá a Carla?
records.back_translation: Which cup will Dad give to Carla?

records.source_text: Which cup does Katie want?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál taza quiere Carla?
records.back_translation: Which cup does Carla want?

records.source_text: The small cup
records.target_text: La taza pequeña
records.back_translation: The small cup

records.source_text: The medium sized cup
records.target_text: La taza mediana
records.back_translation: The medium cup

records.source_text: The big cup
records.target_text: La taza grande
records.back_translation: The big mug

records.source_text: How does Katie feel about not getting the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se siente Carla por no recibir la taza que ella quería?
records.back_translation: How does Carla feel about not getting the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: How would Katie feel if she had received the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se habría sentido Carla si recibía la taza que ella quería?
records.back_translation: How would Carla have felt if she received the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
records.target_text: Sam y María están jugando juntos. Cuando miran hacia afuera ven una tienda nueva al otro lado de la calle. María le dice a Sam: "voy a ir a comprar camisetas nuevas para nosotros" y se va.
records.back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. When they look outside, they see a new store across the street. Maria tells Sam: "I'm going to go buy new t-shirts for us" and leaves.

records.source_text: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
records.target_text: Mamá llega a casa y le dice a Sam que acaba de pasar por la tienda. "¿Venden camisetas?" pregunta Sam. "No", dice Mamá, "solo venden zapatos". "Probablemente ahora María va a comprar zapatos en la tienda", dice Sam.
records.back_translation: Mom comes home and tells Sam that she just passed by the store. "Do they sell t-shirts?" Sam asks. "No," Mom says, "they only sell shoes." "Maria is probably going to buy shoes at the store now," Sam says.

records.source_text: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
records.target_text: ¿María sabe que en la tienda venden zapatos?
records.back_translation: Does Maria know that they sell shoes at the store?

records.source_text: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
records.target_text: María llega a la tienda y dice "me gustaría comprar camisas." La vendedora responde "Sólo nos quedan medias." Como María también necesita medias, decide comprar algunos pares.
records.back_translation: Maria arrives at the store and says "I would like to buy shirts." The saleswoman responds "We only have socks left." Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to buy a few pairs.

records.source_text: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
records.target_text: ¿Sam sabe que María ha comprado medias?
records.back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria has bought socks?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: ¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell at the store?

records.source_text: Shoes
records.target_text: Zapatos
records.back_translation: Shoes

records.source_text: Socks
records.target_text: Medias
records.back_translation: Socks

records.source_text: Shirts
records.target_text: Camisetas
records.back_translation: T-shirts

records.source_text:
On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”
“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
records.target_text:
Caminando de regreso, María se encuentra con su padre. Ella le dice "acabo de comprar unas medias. Voy a compartirlas con mi hermano Sam. Es una sorpresa".
"Es muy amable de tu parte", dice Papá. Luego le pregunta a María: "¿Sam sabe qué le has comprado?".
records.back_translation:
Walking back, Maria meets her father. She tells him, "I just bought some socks. I'm going to share them with my brother Sam. It's a surprise."
"That's very kind of you," says Dad. Then he asks Maria, "Does Sam know what you've bought him?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: ¿Qué le dice María a Papá?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Dad?

records.source_text: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
records.target_text: Entonces Papá pregunta: "¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?".
records.back_translation: Then Dad asks: "What does Sam think they sell at the store?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: ¿Qué le dice María a Papá?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Dad?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: ¿Qué cree Sam que venden en la tienda?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell at the store?

records.source_text: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
records.target_text: Sam está muy feliz por recibir sus medias nuevas.
records.back_translation: Sam is very happy to receive his new socks.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
records.target_text: Imagina que vas camino a la escuela y llevas puestos tus zapatos nuevos. Te gustan mucho tus zapatos nuevos y es la primera vez que los usas.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're on your way to school and you're wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and it's the first time you're wearing them.

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
records.target_text: De repente, un chico te choca por detrás. Tropiezas y caes en un charco de barro y tus zapatos nuevos se ensucian de barro
records.back_translation: Suddenly, a boy bumps into you from behind. You trip and fall into a puddle of mud and your new shoes get dirty with mud.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: ¿Crees que el chico te golpeó a propósito o por accidente?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy hit you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Ahora escoge cuál de estas tres opciones harías tú:
records.back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

records.source_text: clean up my shoes
records.target_text: limpiar mis zapatos
records.back_translation: clean my shoes

records.source_text: walk away from the boy
records.target_text: alejarme del chico
records.back_translation: to get away from the boy

records.source_text: push the boy in the mud
records.target_text: empujar al chico al barro
records.back_translation: push the boy into the mud

records.source_text: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
records.target_text: Imagina que estás en el patio de recreo. Tú y otros niños están haciendo una carrera. Un niño está parado a un lado, haciendo rebotar una pelota de baloncesto.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're on the playground. You and other children are having a race. One child is standing to the side, bouncing a basketball.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
records.target_text: De repente, el chico hace rebotar la pelota y rueda bajo tus pies, haciéndote caer. Te raspas la rodilla, y alguien más gana la carrera.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, the boy bounces the ball and it rolls under your feet, making you fall. You scrape your knee, and someone else wins the race.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: ¿Crees que el chico te hizo caer a propósito o por accidente?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Ahora escoge cuál de estas tres opciones harías tú:
records.back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

records.source_text: go to another area of the playground
records.target_text: ir a otra zona del patio de recreo
records.back_translation: go to another area of the playground

records.source_text: say something mean to him
records.target_text: insultar al niño
records.back_translation: insult the child

records.source_text: take care of my knee
records.target_text: curar mi rodilla
records.back_translation: cure my knee

records.source_text: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.
records.target_text: Imagina que estás trabajando en una tarea en tu escritorio.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are working on a task at your desk.

records.source_text: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.
records.target_text: Te levantas para sacarle punta a tu lápiz y, de regreso a tu escritorio, vas detrás de un niño que camina justo delante de ti. El niño pasa por tu escritorio antes de que tú llegues.
records.back_translation: You get up to sharpen your pencil and, on your way back to your desk, you walk behind a child who is walking right in front of you. The child passes your desk before you arrive.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
records.target_text: De repente, el chico tira todos los papeles que estaban en tu escritorio y ahora están regados en el suelo.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, the boy throws all the papers that were on your desk and now they are scattered on the floor.

records.source_text: Do you think the boy knocked your papers onto the floor on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: ¿Crees que el chico tiró tus papeles al suelo a propósito o por accidente?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy threw your papers on the floor on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Ahora escoge cuál de estas tres opciones harías tú:
records.back_translation: Now choose which of these three options you would do:

records.source_text: call him a name
records.target_text: insultar al niño
records.explanation: The translation 'insultar al niño' is too strong and specific, implying a severe act. 'Call him a name' in English can range from mild teasing to more serious insults, and the current translation loses this nuance and ambiguity, potentially biasing the child's perception.
records.suggested_fix: ponerle un apodo feo
records.back_translation: insult the child

records.source_text: pick up the papers
records.target_text: recoger los papeles
records.back_translation: pick up the papers

records.source_text: do nothing
records.target_text: no hacer nada
records.back_translation: do nothing

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: por accidente
records.back_translation: by accident

records.source_text: on purpose
records.target_text: a propósito
records.back_translation: by the way

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: por accidente
records.back_translation: by accident

records.target_text: a propósito
records.back_translation: by the way

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: por accidente
records.back_translation: by accident

records.source_text: on purpose
records.target_text: a propósito
records.back_translation: by the way

records.source_text: This is the matching game. In this game, you're going to choose sets of cards that match in some way. First, let's look at some of the cards you are going to see.
records.target_text: Este es el juego de parejas. En este juego, vas a elegir conjuntos de cartas que se parecen de alguna manera. Primero, veamos algunas de las cartas que vas a ver.
records.back_translation: This is the matching game. In this game, you are going to choose sets of cards that resemble each other in some way. First, let's look at some of the cards you are going to see.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a circle.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene un círculo.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a circle.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a square.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene un cuadrado.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a square.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a triangle.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene un triángulo.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a triangle.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a star.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una estrella.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a star.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a green shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura verde.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a green figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a red shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura roja.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a red figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a blue shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura azul.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a blue figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a yellow shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura amarilla.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a yellow figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a small shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura pequeña.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a small figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a medium-sized shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura mediana.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a medium figure.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a large shape.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta que tiene una figura grande.
records.back_translation: Choose the card that has a large figure.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the white card.
records.target_text: Escoge la estrella en la carta blanca.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the blank card.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the gray card.
records.target_text: Escoge la estrella en la carta gris.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the gray card.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the black card.
records.target_text: Escoge la estrella en la carta negra.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the black card.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the striped card.
records.target_text: Escoge la estrella en la carta con rayas.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the striped card.

records.source_text: Choose the card with one star.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta con una estrella.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a star.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 2 stars.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta con 2 estrellas.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 2 stars.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 3 stars.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta con 3 estrellas.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 3 stars.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 4 stars.
records.target_text: Escoge la carta con 4 estrellas.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 4 stars.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see two cards that are the same in one way. Then you will see a new card that is similar to one of those cards. Your job is to choose the card that is similar to the new card.
records.target_text: Ahora vas a ver dos cartas que son iguales de alguna manera. Luego vas a ver una nueva carta que se parece a una de esas cartas. Tu trabajo es elegir la carta que se parece en algo a esa nueva carta.
records.back_translation: Now you are going to see two cards that are similar in some way. Then you are going to see a new card that resembles one of those cards. Your job is to choose the card that is similar in some way to that new card.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see three cards, and you're going to choose two that are the same in some way. Then you're going to see the same cards again, and pick two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Ahora vas a ver tres cartas y debes escoger dos que sean iguales de alguna manera. Luego vas a ver las mismas tres cartas, pero  vas a escoger otras dos cartas que sean iguales de alguna otra manera.
records.back_translation: Now you are going to see three cards and you must choose two that are alike in some way. Then you are going to see the same three cards, but you are going to choose two other cards that are alike in some other way.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both circles.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son círculos.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are circles.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both squares.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son cuadrados.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are squares.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both triangles.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son triángulos.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in something. Both are triangles.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both red.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son rojas.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are red.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. Something's the same. They both have green shapes.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Son iguales en algo. Ambas tienen figuras verdes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They are similar in one way. Both have green figures.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both yellow.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son amarillas.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are yellow.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both blue.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son azules.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are blue.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both small.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son pequeñas.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are small.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both medium.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son medianas.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are medium-sized.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both big.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos cartas. Estas cartas son iguales en algo. Las dos son grandes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. These cards are similar in one way. Both are big.

records.source_text: Here is another card. Which of these is similar to this one?
records.target_text: Aquí hay otra carta. ¿Cuál de estas tiene algo que es igual a esta?
records.back_translation: Here is another card. Which of these has something that is the same as this one?

records.source_text: Here is the same set of cards again. Choose two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Aquí están otra vez las mismas cartas. Ahora debe escoger dos cartas que sean pareja porque son iguales en algo diferente.
records.explanation: The translation uses formal address ('debe escoger') instead of informal ('debes escoger' or 'escoge'), which is inappropriate for children. The phrasing 'que sean pareja porque son iguales en algo diferente' is clunky and less natural than the source's 'same in a different way'.
records.suggested_fix: Aquí están otra vez las mismas cartas. Ahora escoge dos cartas que sean iguales de una manera diferente.
records.back_translation: Here are the same cards again. Now you must choose two cards that are a pair because they are alike in something different.

records.source_text: Here is a new set of cards. Choose two cards that are the same in some way.
records.target_text: Aquí hay un nuevo grupo de cartas. Escoge dos cartas que sean iguales en algún aspecto.
records.back_translation: Here is a new group of cards. Choose two cards that are alike in some aspect.

records.source_text: Choose two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Escoge dos cartas que sean pareja porque son iguales en algo diferente.
records.explanation: The translation is convoluted and unnatural for a child. 'Pareja' is redundant, and 'iguales en algo diferente' is vague, failing to clearly convey the concept of 'same in a different way' (i.e., same along a different dimension).
records.suggested_fix: Escoge dos cartas que sean iguales, pero de una forma diferente.
records.back_translation: Choose two cards that are a pair because they are the same in something different.

records.source_text: Choose three cards that are the same in only one way.
records.target_text: Escoge tres cartas que sean iguales en un solo aspecto.
records.back_translation: Choose three cards that are the same in only one aspect.

records.source_text: Choose another three cards that are the same in only one way.
records.target_text: Escoge otras tres cartas que sean iguales en un solo aspecto.
records.back_translation: Choose three other cards that are the same in only one aspect.

records.source_text: Watch the squares light up.
records.target_text: Observa se iluminan los cuadrados.
records.explanation: The translation is grammatically incorrect and unnatural. It's missing the conjunction 'cómo' to properly link 'observa' with the action 'se iluminan los cuadrados'. This makes the sentence sound disjointed and potentially confusing for a child.
records.suggested_fix: Observa cómo se iluminan los cuadrados.
records.back_translation: Observe the squares light up.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Escoge los cuadrados en el mismo orden.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This is the memory game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Este es el juego de la memoria. Las reglas son las siguientes.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game. The rules are as follows.

records.source_text: You will see squares light up.
records.target_text: Verás que los cuadrados se iluminan.
records.back_translation: You'll see the squares light up.

records.source_text: You're going to choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Vas a escoger los cuadrados en el mismo orden.
records.back_translation: You are going to choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: Watch carefully! Try to remember the order.
records.target_text: ¡Observa con atención! Intenta recordar el orden.
records.back_translation: Observe carefully! Try to remember the order.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Escoge los cuadrados en el mismo orden.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Eso no está del todo bien. ¡Inténtalo de nuevo! Escoge los cuadrados en el mismo orden.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again! Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This time the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Esta vez el juego no te dirá si la respuesta es correcta o no. ¡Empecemos a jugar al juego de memoria!
records.back_translation: This time the game will not tell you if the answer is correct or not. Let's start playing the memory game!

records.source_text: Now let's play the memory game backwards!
records.target_text: Ahora vamos a jugar al juego de la memoria a la inversa.
records.back_translation: Now we are going to play the reverse memory game.

records.source_text: Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: ¡Empecemos a jugar al juego de memoria!
records.back_translation: Let's start playing the memory game!

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Escoge los cuadrados en orden inverso.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Eso no está del todo bien. ¡Inténtalo de nuevo! Escoge los cuadrados en orden inverso.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again! Choose the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: This is the heart game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Este es el juego del corazón. Las reglas son las siguientes.
records.back_translation: This is the game of the heart. The rules are as follows.

records.source_text: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.
records.target_text: Cuando veas un corazón, presiona el botón del mismo lado.
records.back_translation: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again.
records.target_text: Eso no está del todo bien. ¡Inténtalo de nuevo!
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again!

records.source_text: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: El corazón está en el lado derecho. Presiona el botón derecho.
records.back_translation: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.

records.source_text: Time to practice!
records.target_text: ¡Es hora de practicar!
records.back_translation: It's time to practice!

records.source_text: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
records.target_text: ¡Recuerda! Cuando veas un CORAZÓN, presiona el botón del MISMO lado.
records.back_translation: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.

records.source_text: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Esta vez el juego irá más rápido. No te dirá si la respuesta es correcta o no. ¡Trata de seguir el ritmo!
records.back_translation: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if the answer is correct or not. Try to keep up!

records.source_text: Try to answer as fast as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Intenta responder lo más rápido que puedas sin cometer errores. Si cometes un error, ¡sigue adelante!
records.back_translation: Try to answer as quickly as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, keep going!

records.source_text: Time to play!
records.target_text: ¡Hora de jugar!
records.back_translation: Time to play!

records.source_text: This is the flower game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Este es el juego de las flores. Las reglas son las siguientes.
records.back_translation: This is the flower game. The rules are as follows.

records.source_text: When you see a flower, press the button on the other side.
records.target_text: Cuando veas una flor, presiona el botón del lado opuesto.
records.back_translation: When you see a flower, press the button on the opposite side.

records.source_text: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: La flor está en el lado izquierdo. Presione el botón derecho.
records.back_translation: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.

records.source_text: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OTHER side.
records.target_text: Cuando veas una FLOR, presiona el botón en el lado OPUESTO.
records.back_translation: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

records.source_text: Now, we're going to play a game with hearts and flowers.
records.target_text: Ahora, vamos a jugar un juego con corazones y flores.
records.back_translation: Now, we are going to play a game with hearts and flowers.

records.source_text: Try to keep up!
records.target_text: ¡Trata de seguir el ritmo!
records.back_translation: Try to keep up!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Si cometes un error, ¡sigue adelante!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, keep going!

records.source_text: Great job! You completed the game!
records.target_text: ¡Bien hecho, has terminado el juego!
records.back_translation: Well done, you have finished the game!
