records.source_text: In this game, you are going to listen to words and look at different pictures. Your job is to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: En este juego, escucharás palabras y observarás diferentes imágenes. ¡Tu tarea es elegir la imagen que coincida con la palabra!
records.back_translation: In this game, you will hear words and see different images. Your task is to choose the image that matches the word!

records.source_text: You are going to see some different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then, you'll hear a word for one of the pictures. Make sure to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: A continuación, verás algunas imágenes, por ejemplo, una imagen de una manzana y una imagen de una zanahoria. Luego, escucharás la palabra que identifica una de las imágenes. ¡Asegúrate de elegir la imagen que coincida con la palabra!
records.back_translation: Next, you will see some images, for example, an image of an apple and an image of a carrot. Then, you will hear the word that identifies one of the images. Make sure to choose the image that matches the word!

records.source_text: Some words are hard, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just give your best guess!
records.target_text: Algunas palabras son difíciles, pero no te preocupes, si tienes dudas, ¡haz tu mejor intento!
records.back_translation: Some words are difficult, but don't worry, if you have doubts, do your best!

records.source_text: If you need to hear the word again, press the speaker button.
records.target_text: Si necesitas escuchar la palabra otra vez, presiona el botón del altavoz.
records.back_translation: If you need to hear the word again, press the speaker button.

records.source_text: You can tap on a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Try it now.
records.target_text: Puedes tocar una pantalla táctil, usar el panel táctil o pulsar las flechas para esta actividad. Pruébala ahora.
records.back_translation: You can touch a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrows for this activity. Try it now.

records.source_text: To use an arrow key to choose a picture, press the key that points the same direction as the arrow below the picture.
records.target_text: Para usar una tecla de flecha para elegir una imagen, presiona la tecla que apunta en la misma dirección que la flecha debajo de la imagen.
records.back_translation: To use an arrow key to choose an image, press the key that points in the same direction as the arrow below the image.

records.source_text: You can press the replay button to hear things again. Try it now.
records.target_text: Puedes presionar el botón de reproducir para escuchar las cosas de nuevo. Inténtalo ahora.
records.back_translation: You can press the play button to listen to things again. Try it now.

records.source_text: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look at the pictures carefully. Choose the picture that goes with the words you hear.
records.target_text: Esta es una actividad de emparejamiento. Escucha lo que digo, luego mira las imágenes con cuidado. Elige la imagen que va con las palabras que escuchas.
records.back_translation: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look at the pictures carefully. Choose the picture that goes with the words you hear.

records.source_text: These questions ask you about how you feel at school and some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time. The first two are for practice.
records.target_text: Estas preguntas se refieren a cómo te sientes en el colegio, y a algunas de las cosas que haces en el colegio. No hay respuestas correctas ni incorrectas. Elige la respuesta que mejor diga lo que tú piensas. No, nunca; Sí, algunas veces; Sí, muchas veces; Sí, siempre. Las primeras dos preguntas son de práctica.
records.back_translation: These questions refer to how you feel at school, and to some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best says what you think. No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, many times; Yes, always. The first two questions are for practice.

records.source_text: Do you like to read comic books?
records.target_text: ¿Te gusta leer historietas (comics)?
records.back_translation: Do you like to read comic books (comics)?

records.source_text: Are you neat and tidy at school?
records.target_text: ¿Eres limpio y ordenado en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Are you clean and tidy at school?

records.source_text: Is your teacher nice to you?
records.target_text: ¿Tu profesor te trata bien?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher treat you well?

records.source_text: Does your teacher like you?
records.target_text: ¿Le caes bien a tu profesor?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher like you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher listen to you?
records.target_text: ¿Tu profesor te escucha?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher listen to you?

records.source_text: Is school fun?
records.target_text: ¿Es divertido ir al colegio?
records.back_translation: Is it fun to go to school?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy school?
records.target_text: ¿Te gusta el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you like school?

records.source_text: Are you happy at school?
records.target_text: ¿Te sientes feliz en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you feel happy at school?

records.source_text: Do you feel safe at school?
records.target_text: ¿Te sientes seguro o segura en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you feel safe at school?

records.source_text: Do you have friends in your class?
records.target_text: ¿Tienes amigos o amigas en tu salón?
records.back_translation: Do you have male or female friends in your classroom?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class help you when you need it?
records.target_text: ¿Te ayudan los niños y las niñas de tu salón cuando lo necesitas?
records.back_translation: Do the boys and girls in your classroom help you when you need it?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class play with you?
records.target_text: ¿Los niños y las niñas de tu salón juegan contigo?
records.back_translation: Do the boys and girls in your classroom play with you?

records.source_text: Are the kids in your class nice to you?
records.target_text: ¿Los niños y las niñas de tu salón son amables contigo?
records.back_translation: Are the boys and girls in your classroom kind to you?

records.source_text: Do you feel lonely at school?
records.target_text: ¿Te sientes solo o sola en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you feel alone at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at learning things in school?
records.target_text: ¿Te queda fácil aprender en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Is it easy for you to learn at school?

records.source_text: When schoolwork is hard, do you give up right away?
records.target_text: Cuando las tareas escolares son difíciles, ¿te rindes enseguida?
records.back_translation: When school assignments are difficult, do you give up right away?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing reading activities at school?
records.target_text: ¿Te gusta hacer actividades de lectura en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing reading activities at school?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing math activities at school?
records.target_text: ¿Te gusta hacer actividades de matemáticas en el colegio?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing math activities at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at reading?
records.target_text: ¿Eres bueno o buena para la lectura?
records.back_translation: Are you good at reading?

records.source_text: Are you good at math?
records.target_text: ¿Eres bueno o buena para las matemáticas?
records.back_translation: Are you good at math?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get smarter if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get smarter if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Algunos niños y niñas piensan que pueden ser más inteligentes si se esfuerzan mucho. ¿Crees que tú puedes ser más inteligente si te esfuerzas mucho?
records.back_translation: Some boys and girls think they can be smarter if they try very hard. Do you think you can be smarter if you try very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at reading if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at reading if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Algunos niños y niñas creen que pueden mejorar en lectura si se esfuerzan mucho. ¿Crees que tú puedes mejorar en lectura si te esfuerzas mucho?
records.back_translation: Some boys and girls believe they can improve their reading if they try very hard. Do you think you can improve your reading if you try very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at math if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at math if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Algunos niños y niñas creen que pueden mejorar en matemáticas si se esfuerzan mucho. ¿Crees que tú puedes mejorar en matemáticas si te esfuerzas mucho?
records.back_translation: Some boys and girls believe they can improve in math if they try very hard. Do you think you can improve in math if you try very hard?

records.source_text: No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time
records.target_text: No, nunca; Sí, algunas veces; Sí, muchas veces; Sí, siempre
records.back_translation: No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, many times; Yes, always

records.source_text: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Aquí está Diana. Esta mañana en el colegio, Diana ha metido su juguete en este cajón porque no quería que nadie lo encontrara.
records.back_translation: Here's Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But while Diana was outside, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer, to inside the desk.
records.target_text: Pero mientras Diana estaba fuera, ¡alguien lo encontró! Y lo movió del cajón al escritorio.
records.back_translation: But while Diana was out, someone found it! And moved it from the drawer to the desk.

records.source_text: So now it’s playtime and Diana wants her toy.
records.target_text: Así que ahora es hora de jugar y Diana quiere su juguete.
records.back_translation: So now it's time to play and Diana wants her toy.

records.source_text: Where will Diana look for her toy?
records.target_text: ¿Dónde buscará Diana su juguete?
records.back_translation: Where will Diana look for her toy?

records.source_text: And where is her toy really?
records.target_text: ¿Y dónde está realmente su juguete?
records.back_translation: And where is your toy really?

records.source_text: In the desk
records.target_text: En el escritorio
records.back_translation: On the desk

records.source_text: In the drawer
records.target_text: En el cajón
records.back_translation: In the drawer

records.source_text: This morning when she came to school, Allie put her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.
records.target_text: Esta mañana, cuando vino a la escuela, Alejandra puso su lápiz de color amarillo en la repisa, sobre el mueble de las maletas.
records.back_translation: This morning, when she came to school, Alejandra put her yellow colored pencil on the shelf, above the suitcase cabinet.

records.source_text: And then she went outside to play, see? Here’s Allie playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Allie’s yellow pencil fell down from on top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, see?
records.target_text: Y luego salió a jugar, ¿ves? Aquí está Alejandra jugando afuera. Y mientras estaba afuera jugando, el lápiz de color amarillo de Alejandra se cayó de la repisa y quedó detrás del mueble de las maletas, ¿ves?
records.back_translation: And then she went out to play, see? Here's Alejandra playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Alejandra's yellow crayon fell off the shelf and landed behind the luggage cabinet, see?

records.source_text: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike’s pencil is also yellow! But Allie is still outside playing, so she didn’t see what Mike was doing.
records.target_text: Entonces entra Miguel y Miguel pone su lápiz encima del mueble de las maletas. El lápiz de Miguel también es de color amarillo. Pero Alejandra todavía está fuera jugando, así que no vio lo que Miguel estaba haciendo.
records.back_translation: Then Miguel comes in and Miguel puts his pencil on top of the luggage cabinet. Miguel's pencil is also yellow. But Alejandra is still outside playing, so she didn't see what Miguel was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Allie comes in from outside, where will she look first for her pencil?
records.target_text: Ahora, cuando Alejandra vuelva de fuera, ¿dónde buscará primero su lápiz?
records.back_translation: Now, when Alejandra comes back from outside, where will she look for her pencil first?

records.source_text: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf
records.target_text: En la repisa sobre el mueble de las maletas
records.back_translation: On the shelf above the luggage cabinet

records.source_text: Behind the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Detrás del mueble de las maletas
records.back_translation: Behind the luggage cabinet

records.source_text: Let’s see what she does. Oh look, here is Allie reaching for this pencil up on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie reaching for that pencil... the pencil that is Mike's!
records.target_text: Veamos lo que hace. Oh, mira, aquí está Alejandra cogiendo este lápiz de encima del mueble. Y ahora Miguel ve a Alejandra cogiendo ese lápiz... ¡el lápiz que es de Miguel!
records.back_translation: Let's see what she does. Oh, look, here's Alejandra picking up this pencil from on top of the furniture. And now Miguel sees Alejandra picking up that pencil... the pencil that belongs to Miguel!

records.source_text: How do you think Mike feels about Allie reaching for that pencil?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se siente Miguel cuando Alejandra intenta coger ese lápiz?
records.back_translation: How do you think Miguel feels when Alejandra tries to grab that pencil?

records.source_text: How do you think Mike would feel if he had not seen Allie reaching for the pencil?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría Miguel si no hubiera visto a Alejandra intentar coger el lápiz?
records.back_translation: How do you think Miguel would feel if he hadn't seen Alejandra try to grab the pencil?

records.source_text: Is Allie being mean and naughty for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: ¿Alejandra está siendo mala y traviesa por coger el lápiz de Miguel?
records.back_translation: Is Alejandra being bad and naughty for taking Miguel's pencil?

records.source_text: Should Allie get in trouble with the teacher for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: ¿Debería Alejandra meterse en problemas con el profesor por coger el lápiz de Miguel?
records.back_translation: Should Alejandra get in trouble with the teacher for taking Miguel's pencil?

records.source_text: Can you help Mike find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarle a Miguel a encontrar su lápiz? ¿Está encima de la repisa o detrás del mueble de maletas?
records.back_translation: Can you help Miguel find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the luggage cabinet?

records.source_text: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarle a Alejandra a encontrar su lápiz? ¿Está encima de la repisa o detrás del mueble de maletas?
records.back_translation: Can you help Alejandra find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the luggage cabinet?

records.source_text: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.
records.target_text: Este es Marco. Marco está jugando hoy un juego un poco loco en el que no dice ninguna palabra en todo el día. En vez de hablar, está haciendo dibujos. Marco está en la biblioteca, decidiendo qué libro le gustaría leer. La mamá le muestra a Marco dos libros: uno sobre tazas y otro sobre montañas.
records.back_translation: This is Marco. Marco is playing a somewhat crazy game today in which he doesn't say a single word all day. Instead of talking, he's drawing. Marco is in the library, deciding which book he would like to read. His mom shows Marco two books: one about cups and another about mountains.

records.source_text: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside-down, so that it looks like a cup!
records.target_text: Marco dibuja una colina para decirle a la mamá que quiere leer el libro sobre montañas. Pero cuando Marco le da el dibujo a mamá, ella lo mira al revés, ¡y entonces parece una taza!
records.back_translation: Marco draws a hill to tell his mom he wants to read the book about mountains. But when Marco gives the drawing to mom, she looks at it upside down, and then it looks like a cup!

records.source_text: What did Mark mean to draw?
records.target_text: ¿Qué quería dibujar Marco?
records.back_translation: What did Marco want to draw?

records.source_text: A hill
records.target_text: Una montaña
records.back_translation: A mountain

records.source_text: A cup
records.target_text: Una taza
records.back_translation: A cup

records.source_text: When Mom sees the picture, what book will she give Mark?
records.target_text: Cuando la mamá vea el dibujo, ¿qué libro le dará a Marco?
records.back_translation: When Mom sees the drawing, what book will she give Marco?

records.source_text: What book does Mark really want?
records.target_text: ¿Qué libro quiere Marco en realidad?
records.back_translation: What book does Marco actually want?

records.source_text: The book about hills
records.target_text: El libro de las montañas
records.back_translation: The book of the mountains

records.source_text: The book about cups
records.target_text: El libro sobre tazas
records.back_translation: The book about cups

records.source_text: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?
records.target_text: Mira, la mamá se ha dado cuenta de su error y le ha dado a Marco el libro que él realmente quería. ¿Cómo crees que se siente Marco al recibir el libro que quería?
records.back_translation: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Marco the book he really wanted. How do you think Marco feels about getting the book he wanted?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah tells all of the kids to take one storybook from the bag that she brought. There is one storybook for every kid.
records.target_text: La profesora Sara le dice a todos sus estudiantes que cojan un libro de cuentos de la bolsa que trajo. Hay un libro de cuentos para cada estudiante.
records.back_translation: Professor Sara tells all her students to take a storybook from the bag she brought. There is one storybook for each student.

records.source_text: Now there are two storybooks left, and Brian and Megan are the last two kids without storybooks. But when Brian goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows that Megan doesn’t have a storybook yet, and that everyone is only supposed to have one. Brian hides the extra storybook in his desk.
records.target_text: Ahora quedan solo dos libros de cuentos y Brian y Megan son los dos últimos estudiantes que todavía no tienen un libro. Pero cuando Brian va a escoger su libro, decide coger los dos, aunque sabe que Megan todavía no tiene uno y que se supone que todos deberían tener un libro. Brian esconde el segundo libro de cuentos en su escritorio.
records.back_translation: Now there are only two storybooks left, and Brian and Megan are the last two students who still don't have a book. But when Brian goes to choose his book, he decides to take both, even though he knows Megan still doesn't have one and that everyone is supposed to have a book. Brian hides the second storybook in his desk.

records.source_text: How does Megan feel about being the only child without a storybook?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se siente Megan al ser la única niña sin libro de cuentos?
records.back_translation: How does Megan feel about being the only girl without a storybook?

records.source_text: How would Megan feel if she received a book?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se sentiría Megan si recibiera un libro?
records.back_translation: How would Megan feel if she received a book?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah asks Brian, “Is there a storybook leftover, so Megan can have one?” Brian tells Teacher Sarah, “No, there is no storybook left. They are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: La profesora Sara le pregunta a Brian: "¿Queda algún libro de cuentos para que Megan pueda tener uno?"  Brian le dice a la profesora Sara: "No, no queda ningún libro de cuentos. Todos se están usando."
records.back_translation: Professor Sara asks Brian: "Are there any storybooks left so Megan can have one?" Brian tells Professor Sara: "No, there are no storybooks left. They are all being used."

records.source_text: Is Brian lying?
records.target_text: ¿Está mintiendo Brian?
records.back_translation: Is Brian lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: ¿Queda un libro de cuentos que no se esté usando?
records.back_translation: Is there a storybook left that isn't being used?

records.source_text: Megan is sad that she doesn’t have a storybook, and asks Teacher Sarah, "is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says, “I’m so sorry Megan, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Megan está triste porque no tiene un libro de cuentos y le pregunta a la profesora Sara: "¿Queda algún libro de cuentos para mí?" La profesora Sara le dice: "Lo siento mucho Megan, pero no quedan libros de cuentos, todos están en uso."
records.back_translation: Megan is sad because she doesn't have a storybook and asks Professor Sara: "Are there any storybooks left for me?" Professor Sara tells her: "I'm very sorry, Megan, but there are no storybooks left; they are all in use."

records.source_text: Is Teacher Sarah lying?
records.target_text: ¿Está mintiendo la profesora Sara?
records.back_translation: Is Professor Sara lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: ¿Queda un libro de cuentos que no se esté usando?
records.back_translation: Is there a storybook left that isn't being used?

records.source_text: This is Josh. Earlier today, Josh was tidying his room. Josh put his big basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball down on the bottom shelf.
records.target_text: Este es José. Hace un rato, José estaba ordenando su habitación. José puso su pelota grande de baloncesto en el escritorio, su pelota mediano de fútbol en la mesa de noche y su pelota pequeña de béisbol en el estante de abajo.
records.back_translation: This is José. A while ago, José was tidying his room. José put his big basketball on the desk, his medium soccer ball on the nightstand, and his small baseball on the bottom shelf.

records.source_text: Josh’s mom just walked in and Josh asks his mom to get one of the toys. Josh tells his mom, “I want the small ball!”
records.target_text: La madre de José acaba de entrar y José le pide a ella que coja un juguete. José le dice a su mamá: "¡Quiero la pelota pequeña!
records.back_translation: José's mother has just entered and José asks her to pick up a toy. José tells his mom: "I want the small ball!"

records.source_text: Which ball will mom get for Josh?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál pelota cogerá la mamá para José?
records.back_translation: Which ball will mom take for José?

records.source_text: Which ball does Josh want?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál pelota quiere José?
records.back_translation: Which ball does José want?

records.source_text: The small baseball
records.target_text: La pelota pequeña de béisbol
records.back_translation: The small baseball ball

records.source_text: The medium sized soccer ball
records.target_text: La pelota mediana de fútbol
records.back_translation: The medium-sized soccer ball

records.source_text: The big basketball
records.target_text: La pelota grande de baloncesto
records.back_translation: The big basketball ball

records.source_text: Josh wanted the baseball but mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Josh feels about receiving the wrong toy?
records.target_text: José quería la pelota de béisbol, ¡pero su mamá le dio la pelota de fútbol! ¿Cómo crees que se siente José al recibir el juguete equivocado?
records.back_translation: José wanted the baseball, but his mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think José feels about getting the wrong toy?

records.source_text: How do you think Josh would feel if he had received the correct toy?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría José si hubiera recibido el juguete correcto?
records.back_translation: How do you think José would feel if he had received the correct toy?

records.source_text: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she would like to take to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball at recess.
records.target_text: Esta mañana, Papá le preguntó a Emma qué juguete le gustaría llevarse al colegio y Emma dijo que quería jugar con su pelota amarilla en el recreo.
records.back_translation: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she would like to take to school and Emma said she wanted to play with her yellow ball during recess.

records.source_text: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind, so she yelled to her dad, “Actually, may I please have my red ball instead?” and kept getting ready for school. But Dad did not hear Emma ask for her red ball.
records.target_text: Después, Emma se fue a su habitación a prepararse para ir al colegio. Mientras se preparaba, cambió de opinión y le gritó a su papá: "En realidad, ¿podría mejor llevar mi pelota roja, por favor?" y siguió preparándose para ir al colegio. Pero Papá no oyó a Emma pedir su pelota roja.
records.back_translation: Afterward, Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind and yelled to her dad: "Actually, could I take my red ball instead, please?" and continued getting ready for school. But Dad didn't hear Emma ask for her red ball.

records.source_text: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete cree el papá que Emma quiere llevar a la escuela?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to take to school?

records.source_text: Dad didn’t hear Emma say she wants her red ball. So dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad goes to pack Emma’s bag, but can’t find her yellow ball in the toy box! But dad finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.
records.target_text: El papá no oyó a Emma decir que quería su pelota roja. Así que el papá piensa que Emma quiere su pelota amarilla. El papá va a preparar la mochila de Emma, ¡pero no encuentra su pelota amarilla en la caja de juguetes! Pero papá el encuentra la pelota azul en la caja de juguetes, así que empaca la pelota azul en la maleta de Emma.
records.back_translation: Dad didn't hear Emma say she wanted her red ball. So Dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad is going to pack Emma's backpack, but he can't find her yellow ball in the toy box! But Dad finds the blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball in Emma's suitcase.

records.source_text: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?
records.target_text: ¿Emma sabe que su papá empacó la pelota azul?
records.back_translation: Does Emma know her dad packed the blue ball?

records.source_text: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál pelota cree Emma que empacó su papá?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Emma think her dad packed?

records.source_text: The yellow ball
records.target_text: La pelota amarilla
records.back_translation: The yellow ball

records.source_text: The red ball
records.target_text: La pelota roja
records.back_translation: The red ball

records.source_text: The blue ball
records.target_text: La pelota azul
records.back_translation: The blue ball

records.source_text: On the way to school, Dad tells Emma, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t pack the toy that you wanted because I couldn’t find it”.
records.target_text: De camino al colegio, el papá le dice a Emma "Lo siento mucho, no pude empacar el juguete que querías porque no lo encontré".
records.back_translation: On the way to school, the dad tells Emma, "I'm very sorry, I couldn't pack the toy you wanted because I didn't find it."

records.source_text: What toy does Emma want?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete quiere Emma?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Emma want?

records.source_text: What toy did Dad pack for Emma?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete le ha empacado el papá?
records.back_translation: Which toy has dad packed for him?

records.source_text: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.
records.target_text: Emma está muy feliz de jugar con su pelota.
records.back_translation: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.

records.source_text: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil box.
records.target_text: Aquí está Gabriel. Esta tarde en el colegio, Gabriel guardó su lápiz en su cartuchera.
records.back_translation: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil case.

records.source_text: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel’s pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.
records.target_text: Pero mientras Gabriel estaba fuera, ¡alguien usó su lápiz! Después de usar el lápiz de Gabriel, la persona puso el lápiz en una canasta.
records.back_translation: But while Gabriel was out, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel's pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.

records.source_text: So now it’s time for class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.
records.target_text: Es hora de ir a clase y Gabriel quiere su lápiz.
records.back_translation: It's time to go to class and Gabriel wants his pencil.

records.source_text: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?
records.target_text: ¿Dónde buscará Gabriel su lápiz?
records.back_translation: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?

records.source_text: In the box
records.target_text: En la cartuchera
records.back_translation: In the pencil case

records.source_text: In the basket
records.target_text: En la canasta
records.back_translation: In the basket

records.source_text: And where is his pencil really?
records.target_text: ¿Y dónde está realmente su lápiz?
records.back_translation: And where is your pencil really?

records.source_text: This afternoon when he came home, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.
records.target_text: Esta tarde, cuando llegó a casa, Roberto puso su balón de fútbol sobre la mesa.
records.back_translation: This afternoon, when he arrived home, Roberto put his soccer ball on the table.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Bobby playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Bobby’s soccer ball fell off the table and onto the floor.
records.target_text: Y luego salió a jugar, ¿ves? Aquí está Roberto jugando fuera. Y mientras estaba fuera jugando, el balón de fútbol de Roberto se cayó de la mesa y al suelo.
records.back_translation: And then he went out to play, see? Here's Roberto playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Roberto's soccer ball fell off the table and onto the floor.

records.source_text: Then Bobby’s sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn’t see what Anna was doing.
records.target_text: Entonces entra Anna, la hermana de Roberto. Anna también tiene un balón de fútbol. Anna pone su balón en la mesa. Roberto todavía está afuera jugando, así que no ve lo que hace Anna.
records.back_translation: Then Anna, Roberto's sister, comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball. Anna puts her ball on the table. Roberto is still outside playing, so he doesn't see what Anna does.

records.source_text: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look first for his soccer ball?
records.target_text: Ahora, cuando Roberto vuelva de entrar, ¿dónde buscará primero su balón de fútbol?
records.back_translation: Now, when Roberto comes back in, where will he look for his soccer ball first?

records.source_text: On the table
records.target_text: En la mesa
records.back_translation: On the table

records.source_text: On the floor
records.target_text: En el suelo
records.back_translation: On the floor

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for that soccer ball... the soccer ball that is Anna's!
records.target_text: Veamos lo que hace. Oh, mira, aquí está Roberto cogiendo el balón de fútbol que está en la mesa. Y ahora Anna ve a Roberto buscando el balón... ¡el balón que es de Anna!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh, look, here's Roberto picking up the soccer ball that's on the table. And now Anna sees Roberto looking for the ball... the ball that belongs to Anna!

records.source_text: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby reaching for that soccer ball?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se siente Anna cuando Roberto coge ese balón?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna feels when Roberto takes that ball?

records.source_text: How do you think Anna would feel if she had not seen Bobby reaching for the soccer ball?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría Anna si no hubiera visto a Roberto intentando coger el balón?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna would feel if she hadn't seen Roberto trying to get the ball?

records.source_text: Is Bobby being mean and naughty for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: ¿Roberto está siendo necio y travieso por coger el balón de fútbol de Anna?
records.back_translation: Is Roberto being stubborn and mischievous for taking Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Should Bobby get in trouble with their mom for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: ¿Debería Roberto estar en problemas con su madre por coger el balón de fútbol de Anna?
records.back_translation: Should Roberto be in trouble with his mother for taking Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarle a Anna a encontrar su balón de fútbol? ¿Está sobre la mesa o en el suelo?
records.back_translation: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarle a Roberto a encontrar su balón de fútbol? ¿Está sobre la mesa o en el suelo?
records.back_translation: Can you help Roberto find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Alex, Isabel y John están jugando un juego en el parque. En este juego uno de los niños se esconde, pero antes de esconderse, debe dibujar una pista en la arenera para que los otros puedan encontrarle.
records.back_translation: Alex, Isabel, and John are playing a game in the park. In this game, one of the children hides, but before hiding, they must draw a clue in the sandbox so that the others can find them.

records.source_text: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny means to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Johnny goes to hide behind the flower bush.
records.target_text: John decide esconderse detrás de una planta con flores. Él dibuja una pista en la arena. Pero aunque John quiere dibujar la planta con flores, ¡su dibujo parece una roca! Al terminar su dibujo, John se va a esconder detrás de la planta con flores.
records.back_translation: John decides to hide behind a flowering plant. He draws a clue in the sand. But even though John wants to draw the flowering plant, his drawing looks like a rock! After finishing his drawing, John goes to hide behind the flowering plant.

records.source_text: What did Johnny mean to draw?
records.target_text: ¿Qué quería dibujar John?
records.back_translation: What did John want to draw?

records.source_text: A flower bush
records.target_text: Una planta con flores
records.back_translation: A plant with flowers

records.source_text: A rock
records.target_text: Una roca
records.back_translation: A rock

records.source_text: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?
records.target_text: Cuando Alex e Isabel vean esta pista, ¿dónde buscarán primero a John? ¿Detrás de la planta con flores o detrás de la roca?
records.back_translation: When Alex and Isabel see this clue, where will they look for John first? Behind the flowering plant or behind the rock?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Johnny really is?
records.target_text: ¿Puedes ayudarles a encontrar dónde se esconde John realmente?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find where John is really hiding?

records.source_text: Behind the flower bush
records.target_text: Detrás de la planta con flores
records.back_translation: Behind the flowering plant

records.source_text: Behind the rock
records.target_text: Detrás de la roca
records.back_translation: Behind the rock

records.source_text: Look, Alex and Beth found Johnny, and won the game! How do you think Alex and Beth feel about winning the game?
records.target_text: Mira, Alex e Isabel encontraron a John y ganaron el juego. ¿Cómo crees que se sienten Alex e Isabel por ganar el juego?
records.back_translation: Look, Alex and Isabel found John and won the game. How do you think Alex and Isabel feel about winning the game?

records.source_text: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.
records.target_text: El papá les dice a Jaime y a Sofía que se preparen para ir al colegio. El papá les dice que se pongan los zapatos.
records.back_translation: Dad tells Jaime and Sofía to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.

records.source_text: Sophie can’t find one of her shoes! She’s looking everywhere but she can't find it.
records.target_text: Sofía no encuentra uno de sus zapatos. Lo está buscando por todas partes, pero no lo encuentra.
records.back_translation: Sofía can't find one of her shoes. She's looking everywhere for it, but she can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Sophie feel about losing her shoe?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se siente Sofía por perder su zapato?
records.back_translation: How does Sofía feel about losing her shoe?

records.source_text: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo se sentiría Sofía si encontrara su zapato?
records.back_translation: How would Sofía feel if she found her shoe?

records.source_text: Sophie can't find her shoe because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.
records.target_text: Sofía no encuentra su zapato porque Jaime, por hacerle una broma, se lo escondió en la caja de juguetes hace un rato cuando nadie estaba mirando.
records.back_translation: Sofía can't find her shoe because Jaime, to play a prank on her, hid it in the toy box a while ago when no one was looking.

records.source_text: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can’t find her shoe. Dad gets mad at Sophie, because she lost her shoe and now they are late for school.
records.target_text: Entonces Sofía está buscando su zapato por todas partes, pero no lo encuentra. Ahora el papá se ha enfadado con Sofía porque perdió su zapato y van tarde para el colegio.
records.back_translation: So Sofía is looking for her shoe everywhere, but she can't find it. Now Dad has gotten angry with Sofía because she lost her shoe and they are late for school.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?
records.target_text: ¿Es justo que papá se enfade con Sofía por haber perdido su zapato?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Dad gets angry with Sofía for losing her shoe?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James?
records.target_text: ¿Está el papá enfadado con Jaime?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Jaime?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James?
records.target_text: ¿Está Sofía enfadada con Jaime?
records.back_translation: Is Sofía mad at Jaime?

records.source_text: When James sees that Dad is mad at Sophie, he goes to the toy box and gets the shoe, and gives it back to Sophie.
records.target_text: Cuando Jaime ve que papá está enfadado con Sofía, va a la caja de juguetes, coge el zapato y se lo devuelve a Sofía.
records.back_translation: When Jaime sees that Dad is angry with Sofía, he goes to the toy box, takes the shoe, and gives it back to Sofía.

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at Sophie now?
records.target_text: ¿Está el papá enfadado con Sofía ahora?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Sofía now?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James now?
records.target_text: ¿Está el papá enfadado con Jaime ahora?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at Jaime now?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James now?
records.target_text: ¿Está Sofía enfadada con Jaime ahora?
records.back_translation: Is Sofía mad at Jaime now?

records.source_text: James tells Sophie that he’s very sorry, and Sophie and Dad forgive James. They all hug.
records.target_text: Jaime le pide perdón a Sofía, y Sofía y el papá perdonan a Jaime. Todos se abrazan.
records.back_translation: Jaime asks Sofía for forgiveness, and Sofía and her dad forgive Jaime. Everyone hugs.

records.source_text: This is Mika. Mika’s mom owns a bookshop, and sometimes Mika helps out. Earlier today, Mika was organizing books on tables and shelves. Mika put a very large stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.
records.target_text: Esta es Melisa. La madre de Melisa tiene una librería y Melisa a veces la ayuda. Hace un rato, Melisa estaba organizando unos libros en las mesas y biblioteca. Melisa puso una torre muy grande de libros azules en el escritorio, una torre mediana de libros rojos en la mesa y una torre pequeña de libros amarillos en la biblioteca.
records.back_translation: This is Melisa. Melisa's mother owns a bookstore and Melisa sometimes helps her. A little while ago, Melisa was organizing some books on the tables and bookshelf. Melisa put a very large tower of blue books on the desk, a medium tower of red books on the table, and a small tower of yellow books on the bookshelf.

records.source_text: Mika’s mom just walked in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where the book is, and tells mom, “The book is in the small stack!”
records.target_text: La madre de Melisa acaba de entrar. La madre le pide a Melisa uno de los libros. Melisa recuerda dónde está ese libro y le dice a su mamá: "¡El libro está en la torre pequeña!".
records.back_translation: Melisa's mother just came in. The mother asks Melisa for one of the books. Melisa remembers where that book is and tells her mom: "The book is in the small tower!"

records.source_text: Which stack of books will mom look in?
records.target_text: ¿En cuál torre de libros va a buscar la mamá?
records.back_translation: In which book tower will mom look?

records.source_text: Which stack of books was Mika talking about?
records.target_text: ¿A cuál torre de libros se refería Melisa?
records.back_translation: Which tower of books was Melisa referring to?

records.source_text: The large blue stack
records.target_text: La torre azul grande
records.back_translation: The big blue tower

records.source_text: The medium sized red stack
records.target_text: La torre roja mediana
records.back_translation: The medium red tower

records.source_text: The small yellow stack
records.target_text: La torre amarilla pequeña
records.back_translation: The small yellow tower

records.source_text: Mom looks in the wrong stack of books and can’t find the book that she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not finding the book she wanted?
records.target_text: La mamá busca en la torre de libros equivocada y no encuentra el libro que quería. ¿Cómo crees que se siente la mamá al no encontrar el libro que quería?
records.back_translation: Mom looks in the wrong tower of books and doesn't find the book she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not finding the book she wanted?

records.source_text: How do you think Mom would feel if she could find the book she wanted?
records.target_text: ¿Cómo crees que se sentiría la mamá si pudiera encontrar el libro que quería?
records.back_translation: How do you think the mom would feel if she could find the book she wanted?

records.source_text: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy shop across the street. Kat decides to go buy some new toys at the toy shop. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George says he would like a new basketball.
records.target_text: Jorge y Catalina están jugando juntos. Miran fuera y ven una juguetería nueva al otro lado de la calle. Catalina decide ir a comprar juguetes a la juguetería. Catalina le pregunta a Jorge cuál juguete le gustaría tener y Jorge dice que le gustaría un balón de baloncesto nuevo.
records.back_translation: Jorge and Catalina are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy store across the street. Catalina decides to go buy toys at the toy store. Catalina asks Jorge which toy he would like to have and Jorge says he would like a new basketball.

records.source_text: While Kat is walking to the toy shop, George changes his mind and yells to Kat, “Actually, can I please have some crayons?” But Kat did not hear George ask for crayons.
records.target_text: Mientras Catalina caminaba a la juguetería, Jorge cambió de opinión y le gritó a Catalina: "En realidad, ¿me compras unos colores, por favor?". Pero Catalina no escuchó a Jorge pedir los colores.
records.back_translation: As Catalina walked to the toy store, Jorge changed his mind and yelled to Catalina: "Actually, will you buy me some colored pencils, please?" But Catalina did not hear Jorge ask for the colored pencils.

records.source_text: Which toy does Kat think George wants from the toy shop?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete cree Catalina que Jorge quiere de la juguetería?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Catalina think Jorge wants from the toy store?

records.source_text: Kat didn’t hear George say that he wanted crayons. So Kat thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy shop, but then the shop owner says that they don’t have any basketballs! But they do have storybooks, so Kat buys a storybook for George instead.
records.target_text: Catalina no escuchó a Jorge decir que quería unos colores, así que Catalina piensa que Jorge quiere un balón de baloncesto. Catalina va a la juguetería, pero el dueño le dice aunque no tienen balones de baloncesto, sí tienen libros de cuentos. Catalina le compra un libro de cuentos a Jorge.
records.back_translation: Catalina didn't hear Jorge say he wanted some colored pencils, so Catalina thinks Jorge wants a basketball. Catalina goes to the toy store, but the owner tells her that although they don't have basketballs, they do have storybooks. Catalina buys Jorge a storybook.

records.source_text: Does George know that Kat bought a storybook?
records.target_text: ¿Jorge sabe que Catalina compró un libro de cuentos?
records.back_translation: Does Jorge know that Catalina bought a storybook?

records.source_text: What does George think Kat bought at the toy shop?
records.target_text: ¿Qué cree Jorge que Catalina compró en la juguetería?
records.back_translation: What does Jorge think Catalina bought at the toy store?

records.source_text: A basketball
records.target_text: Un balón de baloncesto
records.back_translation: A basketball ball

records.source_text: A storybook
records.target_text: Un libro de cuentos
records.back_translation: A book of short stories

records.source_text: Crayons
records.target_text: Unos colores
records.back_translation: Some colors

records.source_text: Kat comes back and tells George, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t buy you a basketball because the store didn’t have any.”
records.target_text: Catalina vuelve y le dice a Jorge: "Lo siento mucho, no pude comprarte un balón de baloncesto porque no los vendían en la tienda".
records.back_translation: Catalina comes back and tells Jorge: "I'm very sorry, I couldn't buy you a basketball because they didn't sell them at the store."

records.source_text: What toy does George want?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete quiere Jorge?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Jorge want?

records.source_text: What toy did Kat buy for George?
records.target_text: ¿Cuál juguete le compró Catalina a Jorge?
records.back_translation: Which toy did Catalina buy for Jorge?

records.source_text: George is very happy to play with his new storybook.
records.target_text: Jorge está emocionado por leer su nuevo libro de cuentos.
records.back_translation: Jorge is excited to read his new storybook.

records.source_text: Welcome to ROAR - Inference
records.target_text: Bienvenido a ROAR - Inferencia
records.back_translation: Welcome to ROAR - Inference

records.source_text: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.
records.target_text: Lee cada historia con atención. Piensa en lo que ocurrió en la historia y en lo que sabes. Elige la mejor respuesta para cada pregunta.
records.back_translation: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.

records.source_text: Now it's your turn!
records.target_text: ¡Ahora es tu turno!
records.back_translation: Now it's your turn!

records.source_text: Here is another picture. I have to choose which of these pictures is the same as this new picture.
records.target_text: Aquí hay otra imagen. Tengo que elegir cuál de estas imágenes es igual a esta nueva imagen.
records.back_translation: Here's another image. I have to choose which of these images is the same as this new image.

records.source_text: I will pick this one! This one is the same as the new picture because they are both squares.
records.target_text: ¡Escogeré esta! Esta es igual a la nueva imagen porque ambas son cuadrados.
records.back_translation: I'll choose this one! This is the same as the new image because both are squares.

records.source_text: This is the matching game. In this game, we are going to look at pictures and find things about them that are the same in some way.
records.target_text: Este es el juego de emparejar. En este juego, vamos a mirar imágenes y encontrar cosas que sean iguales de alguna manera.
records.back_translation: This is the matching game. In this game, we are going to look at images and find things that are alike in some way.

records.source_text: Now we're going to look at more pictures and find things about them that are the same. Let's learn how to play!
records.target_text: Ahora vamos a ver más imágenes y encontrar cosas que sean iguales. ¡Vamos a aprender a jugar!
records.back_translation: Now we are going to see more images and find things that are the same. Let's learn to play!

records.source_text: Now you're going to play the rest of the game on your own!
records.target_text: ¡Ahora vas a jugar el resto del juego por tu cuenta!
records.back_translation: Now you're going to play the rest of the game on your own!

records.source_text: Now we're going to try something new! You're going to find pairs of shapes that are the same in some way. Let's learn how!
records.target_text: ¡Ahora vamos a intentar algo nuevo! Vas a encontrar pares de formas que sean iguales de alguna manera. ¡Vamos a aprender cómo!
records.back_translation: Now we're going to try something new! You're going to find pairs of shapes that are alike in some way. Let's learn how!

records.source_text: Here are three pictures. I have to choose 2 of them that are the same in some way. I will pick these 2 pictures because they are both triangles.
records.target_text: Aquí hay tres imágenes. Tengo que elegir 2 de ellas que sean iguales de alguna manera. Voy a escoger estas 2 imágenes porque ambas son triángulos.
records.back_translation: Here are three images. I have to choose 2 of them that are similar in some way. I'm going to choose these 2 images because they are both triangles.

records.source_text: Here are the same three pictures. I have to choose 2 of them that are the same in a different way. I will pick these 2 pictures because they are both red.
records.target_text: Aquí están las mismas tres imágenes. Tengo que elegir 2 de ellas que sean iguales de otra manera. Voy a escoger estas 2 imágenes porque ambas son rojas.
records.back_translation: Here are the same three images. I have to choose 2 of them that are equal in another way. I'm going to choose these 2 images because both are red.

records.source_text: Show me the circle.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el círculo.
records.back_translation: Show me the circle.

records.source_text: Show me the square.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el cuadrado.
records.back_translation: Show me the square.

records.source_text: Show me the triangle.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el triángulo.
records.back_translation: Show me the triangle.

records.source_text: Show me the star.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la estrella.
records.back_translation: Show me the star.

records.source_text: Show me the green one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el verde.
records.back_translation: Show me the green.

records.source_text: Show me the red one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el rojo.
records.back_translation: Show me the red one.

records.source_text: Show me the blue one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el azul.
records.back_translation: Show me the blue.

records.source_text: Show me the yellow one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el amarillo.
records.back_translation: Show me the yellow one.

records.source_text: Show me the small one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el pequeño.
records.back_translation: Show me the little one.

records.source_text: Show me the medium one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el mediano.
records.back_translation: Show me the medium one.

records.source_text: Show me the large one.
records.target_text: Muéstrame el grande.
records.back_translation: Show me the big one.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with the white background.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con el fondo blanco.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with the white background.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with the gray background.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con el fondo gris.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with the gray background.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with the black background.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con el fondo negro.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with the black background.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with the striped background.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con el fondo a rayas.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with the striped background.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with one shape.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con una forma.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with a shape.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with two shapes.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con dos formas.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with two shapes.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with three shapes.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con tres formas.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with three shapes.

records.source_text: Show me the picture with four shapes.
records.target_text: Muéstrame la imagen con cuatro formas.
records.back_translation: Show me the image with four shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two pictures. Something's the same. They're both circles.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos imágenes. Algo es igual. Ambas son círculos.
records.back_translation: Here are two images. Something is the same. Both are circles.

records.source_text: Here are two pictures. Something's the same. They're both squares.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos imágenes. Algo es igual. Ambas son cuadrados.
records.back_translation: Here are two images. Something is the same. Both are squares.

records.source_text: Here are two pictures. Something's the same. They're both triangles.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos imágenes. Algo es igual. Ambas son triángulos.
records.back_translation: Here are two images. Something is the same. Both are triangles.

records.source_text: Here are two pictures. Something's the same. They're both red.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos imágenes. Algo es igual. Ambas son rojas.
records.back_translation: Here are two images. Something is the same. Both are red.

records.source_text: Here are two pictures. Something's the same. They're both green.
records.target_text: Aquí hay dos imágenes. Algo es igual. Ambas son verdes.
records.back_translation: Here are two images. Something is the same. Both are green.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
En este juego, jugarás con números.

Algunas preguntas pueden ser fáciles para ti y algunas pueden ser difíciles. ¡Está bien! Haz tu mejor esfuerzo y tómate tu tiempo. ¡Comencemos!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

Some questions may be easy for you and some may be difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Let's begin!

records.source_text: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: ¡Es hora del primer juego de números! Vamos a practicar.
records.back_translation: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice.

records.source_text: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: ¡Es hora del siguiente juego de números! Vamos a practicar.
records.back_translation: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice.

records.source_text: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture! The grownup helping you will press the button.
records.target_text: En este juego de números, dirás cuántas cosas hay en la imagen. El adulto que te está ayudando presionará el botón.
records.back_translation: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture. The adult who is helping you will press the button.

records.source_text: This time, you will choose the button with the right number!
records.target_text: ¡Esta vez, elegirás el botón con el número correcto!
records.back_translation: This time, you'll choose the button with the correct number!

records.source_text: This is the memory game.
records.target_text: Este es el juego de memoria.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game.

records.source_text: In this game, we are going to see squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares that light up.
records.target_text: En este juego, vamos a ver cuadrados encenderse. Tu tarea es tocar los cuadrados que se encienden.
records.back_translation: In this game, we are going to see squares light up. Your task is to touch the squares that light up.

records.source_text: Now we will see two squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares in the same order as they light up!
records.target_text: Ahora veremos dos cuadrados encenderse. Tu tarea es tocar los cuadrados en el mismo orden en que se encienden.
records.back_translation: Now we will see two squares light up. Your task is to touch the squares in the same order in which they light up.

records.source_text: Watch the squares light up. I will touch the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Mira cómo se encienden los cuadrados. Tocaré los cuadrados en el mismo orden.
records.back_translation: Watch how the squares light up. I will touch the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: OK, now you're going to play the rest of the memory game on your own. More squares will light up each time the longer you play, so watch carefully!
records.target_text: OK, ahora vas a jugar el resto del juego de memoria por tu cuenta. Más cuadrados se encenderán cada vez que juegues más tiempo, así que ¡mira con atención!
records.back_translation: OK, now you're going to play the rest of the memory game by yourself. More squares will light up each time you play longer, so watch carefully!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Si cometes un error, ¡sigue adelante!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, keep going!

records.back_translation: Use a tablet in landscape mode, a desktop computer, or a laptop to complete the activities.

records.source_text: Hi! We are excited to have you play some games with us today!
records.target_text: Bonjour! Nous sommes ravis que tu viennes jouer avec nous aujourd’hui!
records.back_translation: Hello! We're delighted you're coming to play with us today!

records.source_text: First, you get to choose a buddy to play along with you. As you complete the different games, you will get to pick an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your buddy.
records.target_text: Tout d’abord, il faut choisir un ami avec lequel tu vas jouer. Au fur et à mesure que tu termines les différents jeux, tu pourras choisir un accessoire, comme un chapeau ou des lunettes, pour décorer ton ami.
records.back_translation: First, you need to choose a friend with whom you will play. As you complete the different games, you will be able to choose an accessory, like a hat or glasses, to decorate your friend.

records.source_text: Pick a buddy to play with!
records.target_text: Choisis un ami avec qui jouer!
records.back_translation: Choose a friend to play with!

records.source_text: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.
records.target_text: Maintenant que tu as ton ami, nous voulons t'expliquer comment les jeux fonctionnent.
records.back_translation: Now that you have your friend, we want to explain to you how the games work.

records.source_text: During the games you will need to listen to instructions so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is the way you like it. If you need to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button up in the corner of your screen.
records.target_text: Pendant les jeux, tu devras écouter aux instructions, donc assure-toi que les haut-parleurs sont activés et que le volume te convient. Si tu souhaites réécouter les instructions, tu peux cliquer sur le bouton haut-parleur dans le coin de ton écran.
records.back_translation: During the games, you will need to listen to the instructions, so make sure the speakers are on and the volume is suitable for you. If you wish to listen to the instructions again, you can click on the speaker button in the corner of your screen.

records.source_text:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can pick the way that works best for you.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, please ask the adult who is nearby to help you.
records.target_text:
Tu peux choisir tes réponses de différentes manières selon le type de tablette ou d’ordinateur que tu utilises. Tu peux utiliser une souris ou un pavé tactile pour cliquer sur ton choix, utiliser les touches fléchées de ton clavier, ou toucher l’écran si tu utilises une tablette. Tu peux choisir la méthode qui te convient le mieux.

Si tu as des questions ou si tu as besoin d’aide pour commencer, demande à l’adulte à proximité de t'aider.
records.back_translation:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or a trackpad to click on your choice, use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or touch the screen if you are using a tablet. You can choose the method that suits you best.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, ask the adult nearby to help you.

records.target_text: Bon travail avec l'entraînement! Tu peux en essayer d'autres tout seul.
records.back_translation: Good job with the training! You can try others by yourself.

records.source_text: We’re going to show you a puzzle, and your job is to pick the best piece to complete the puzzle. Let's get started!
records.target_text: Nous allons te montrer un puzzle, et ton travail est de choisir la meilleure pièce pour compléter le puzzle. Allons-y!
records.back_translation: We are going to show you a puzzle, and your job is to choose the best piece to complete the puzzle. Let's go!

records.source_text: See this big puzzle? It's missing a piece! Which piece goes in the puzzle?
records.target_text: Tu vois ce grand puzzle? Il manque une pièce! Quelle pièce va dans le puzzle?
records.back_translation: You see this big puzzle? It's missing a piece! Which piece goes in the puzzle?

records.target_text: Choisis le meilleur motif pour remplir le vide.
records.back_translation: Choose the best pattern to fill the void.

records.source_text: Do you see these two outlines? One goes with this shape. Let’s see which one goes with the shape.
records.target_text: Tu vois ces deux contours ? L'un va avec cette forme. Voyons lequel va avec la forme. EDIT EDIT.
records.back_translation: You see these two outlines? One goes with this shape. Let's see which one goes with the shape. EDIT EDIT.

records.source_text: Let's see if this shape goes with the outline. This shape doesn’t go with the outline.
records.target_text: Voyons si cette forme va avec le contour. Cette forme ne va pas avec le contour.
records.explanation: The phrase "va avec" is too general for a mental rotation task. It doesn't clearly convey that the child needs to rotate the shape to see if it matches the outline, potentially leading to misinterpretation of the task.
records.suggested_fix: Voyons si cette forme correspond au contour quand on la tourne. Cette forme ne correspond pas au contour quand on la tourne.
records.back_translation: Let's see if this shape fits the outline. This shape does not fit the outline.

records.source_text: Let's see if this shape goes with the outline. This shape does go with the outline.
records.target_text: Voyons si cette forme va avec le contour. Cette forme va avec le contour.
records.explanation: The phrase "va avec le contour" is ambiguous and does not clearly convey the concept of rotational matching, which is critical for a mental rotation task. A child might interpret it as a general matching or adjacency task.
records.suggested_fix: Voyons si cette forme correspond au contour en la tournant. Cette forme correspond au contour en la tournant.
records.back_translation: Let's see if this shape goes with the contour. This shape goes with the contour.

records.source_text: Now you try! Can you find the shape that goes with the outline?
records.target_text: À toi de jouer! Est-ce que tu peux trouver la forme qui va avec le contour?
records.back_translation: It's your turn! Can you find the shape that goes with the outline?

records.back_translation: Now, you will see images that show blocks with three sides. Your task is to choose the corresponding image.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. 

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
Dans ce jeu, tu vas faire quelques problèmes de mathématiques. Certains seront comme ceux que tu fais à l’école, et d’autres seront différents. 

Tu vas trouver certaines questions faciles et d’autres difficiles. Ce n’est pas grave! Fait de ton mieux et prends ton temps. La plupart des questions auront quatre choix. Tu choisiras celui que tu penses être correct. Allons-y!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you're going to do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do at school, and others will be different.

You'll find some questions easy and others difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Most questions will have four choices. You will choose the one you think is correct. Let's go!

records.source_text: Here is the first section. Let's start with some practice!
records.target_text: Voici la première section. Pratiquons ensemble!
records.back_translation: Here is the first section. Let's practice together!

records.source_text: Here is another section. The first few are for practice.
records.target_text: Voici une autre section. Les premières questions sont pour s'entraîner.
records.back_translation: Here's another section. The first questions are for practice.

records.source_text: In this section sometimes you will add and sometimes you will subtract. Be sure to look carefully for the plus or minus sign. The first few are for practice.
records.target_text: Dans cette section, tu devras parfois faire des additions et parfois des soustractions. Assure-toi de bien regarder le signe plus ou moins. Les premières questions sont pour pratiquer.
records.back_translation: In this section, you will sometimes have to do additions and sometimes subtractions. Make sure to look carefully at the plus or minus sign. The first questions are for practice.

records.source_text: This is the Stories Game. In this game, you will listen to some stories. Then you will answer questions about the stories.

records.source_text: Nice work! Here is a new story.

records.back_translation: Good job! Here's a new story.

records.source_text: Here is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Voici Madison. Ce matin, Madison a mis son livre derrière la chaise parce qu'elle ne voulait pas que quelqu'un le trouve.
records.back_translation: This is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But when Madison was outside playing, someone did find it! And hid it under the rug.
records.target_text: Mais quand Madison était dehors en train de jouer, quelqu'un l'a trouvé et l'a caché sous le tapis!
records.back_translation: But when Madison was outside playing, someone found it and hid it under the rug!

records.source_text: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
records.target_text: Maintenant, c'est l'heure de la lecture et Madison veut son livre.
records.back_translation: Now it's reading time and Madison wants her book.

records.source_text: Where will Madison look first for her book?
