records.back_translation: Where will Madison look first to find her book?

records.source_text: Behind the chair
records.target_text: Derrière la chaise
records.back_translation: Behind the chair

records.source_text: Under the rug
records.target_text: Sous le tapis
records.back_translation: Under the rug

records.source_text: And where is her book really?
records.target_text: Et où est vraiment son livre?
records.back_translation: And where is his book, really?

records.source_text: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
records.target_text: Ce matin, lorsqu'il est arrivé à l'école, Ethan a mis son livre sur l'étagère au-dessus des crochets à manteaux. Le livre d'Ethan est bleu.
records.back_translation: This morning, when he arrived at school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan's book is blue.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
records.target_text: Puis il est allé jouer dehors. Voici Ethan en train de jouer dehors. Pendant qu'il jouait dehors, le livre d'Ethan est tombé du dessus des crochets à manteaux et s'est retrouvé par terre sous les manteaux.
records.back_translation: Then he went to play outside. Here's Ethan playing outside. While he was playing outside, Ethan's book fell from on top of the coat hooks and ended up on the floor under the coats.

records.source_text: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
records.target_text: Puis Hannah entre et met son livre au-dessus des crochets à manteaux. Le livre de Hannah est également bleu! Ethan est toujours dehors en train de jouer, donc il n'a pas vu ce que Hannah faisait.
records.back_translation: Then Hannah comes in and puts her book above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
records.target_text: Maintenant, quand Ethan rentrera de dehors, où est-ce qu'il cherchera d'abord son livre?
records.back_translation: Now, when Ethan comes back from outside, where will he look for his book first?

records.source_text: On the shelf
records.target_text: Sur l'étagère
records.back_translation: On the shelf

records.source_text: Under the coats
records.target_text: Sous les manteaux
records.back_translation: Under the coats

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
records.target_text: Voyons ce qu'il fait. Oh regarde, voici Ethan qui tend la main vers ce livre sur l'étagère. Et maintenant Hannah voit Ethan qui tend la main vers ce livre... le livre qui appartient à Hannah!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he's doing. Oh look, here's Ethan reaching for that book on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that belongs to Hannah!

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Hannah se sent face à Ethan qui tend la main vers ce livre?
records.back_translation: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Hannah se sentirait si elle n'avait pas vu Ethan tendre la main vers le livre?
records.back_translation: How do you think Hannah would feel if she hadn't seen Ethan reach for the book?

records.source_text: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Ethan est méchant et vilain d'avoir pris le livre de Hannah?
records.back_translation: Is Ethan mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Ethan devrait-il avoir des problèmes avec l'enseignant pour avoir pris le livre de Hannah?
records.back_translation: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux aider Hannah à retrouver son livre? Est-ce qu'il est sur l'étagère ou sous les manteaux?
records.back_translation: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux aider Ethan à trouver son livre? Est-ce qu'il est sur l'étagère ou sous les manteaux?
records.back_translation: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Joshua, Isabel, et Ivan jouent à un jeu. Voici comment le jeu fonctionne: Un enfant se cache, mais dessine un indice dans le bac à sable pour que les autres enfants puissent le trouver.
records.back_translation: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game works: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox for the other children to find them.

records.source_text: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
records.target_text: Donc, Ivan passe en premier. Il dessine cet indice dans le bac à sable, puis il va se cacher.
records.back_translation: So, Ivan goes first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, then he goes to hide.

records.source_text: Now it's Joshua's turn to leave a clue, and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.
records.target_text: C'est maintenant au tour de Joshua de laisser un indice et de se cacher. Isabel et Ivan essaieront alors d'utiliser l'indice pour le trouver.
records.back_translation: It's now Joshua's turn to leave a clue and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.

records.source_text: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Joshua goes and hides behind the fountain.
records.target_text: Joshua décide de se cacher derrière la fontaine. Il dessine un indice dans le sable. Il essaie de dessiner la fontaine, avec la partie inférieure et l'eau qui sort. Mais le dessin ressemble plutôt à un arbre! Puis Joshua va se cacher derrière la fontaine.
records.back_translation: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the lower part and the water coming out. But the drawing looks more like a tree! Then Joshua goes to hide behind the fountain.

records.source_text: What did Joshua mean to draw?
records.target_text: Qu'est-ce que Joshua voulait dessiner?
records.back_translation: What did Joshua want to draw?

records.source_text: A fountain
records.target_text: Une fontaine
records.back_translation: A fountain

records.source_text: A tree
records.target_text: Un arbre
records.back_translation: A tree

records.source_text: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look first for Joshua?
records.target_text: Quand Isabel et Ivan voient cet indice, où est-ce qu'ils chercheront Joshua en premier?
records.back_translation: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look for Joshua first?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux les aider à trouver où se trouve vraiment Joshua?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?

records.source_text: Behind the fountain
records.target_text: Derrière la fontaine
records.back_translation: Behind the fountain

records.source_text: Behind the tree
records.target_text: Derrière l'arbre
records.back_translation: Behind the tree

records.source_text: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua, and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?
records.target_text: Regarde, Isabel et Ivan ont trouvé Joshua et ont gagné le jeu! Comment est-ce que tu penses que Isabel se sent après avoir gagné le jeu?
records.back_translation: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels after winning the game?

records.source_text: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
records.target_text: Maintenant les jeux sont terminés, et il est presque temps de rentrer à la maison. Maman dit aux enfants de retrouver tous leurs jouets.
records.back_translation: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mom tells the children to find all their toys.

records.source_text: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
records.target_text: Joshua a apporté son camion au parc, mais maintenant il ne le trouve plus. Il cherche partout, mais il ne peut pas le trouver.
records.back_translation: Joshua brought his truck to the park, but now he can't find it anymore. He's looking everywhere, but he can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Joshua feel about losing his truck?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Joshua se sent après avoir perdu son camion?
records.back_translation: How does Joshua feel after losing his truck?

records.source_text: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Joshua se sentirait s'il retrouvait son camion?
records.back_translation: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck again?

records.source_text: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
records.target_text: Joshua ne trouve pas son camion parce qu'au début de la journée, quand personne ne regardait, Isabel a pris le camion et l'a enterré dans le bac à sable.
records.back_translation: Joshua can't find his truck because at the beginning of the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the truck and buried it in the sandbox.

records.source_text: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
records.target_text: Alors Joshua cherche partout, mais il ne trouve pas son camion. Maman se fâche contre Joshua, parce qu'il a perdu son camion.
records.back_translation: So Joshua looks everywhere, but he can't find his truck. Mom gets mad at Joshua because he lost his truck.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
records.target_text: Est-ce que c'est juste que Maman se fâche contre Joshua parce qu'il a perdu son camion?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Mom gets mad at Joshua because he lost his truck?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Maman est fâchée contre Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Mom mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Joshua est fâché contre Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
records.target_text: Quand Isabel voit que Maman est fâchée contre Joshua, elle va au bac à sable, déterre le camion, et le rend à Joshua.
records.back_translation: When Isabel sees that Mom is angry with Joshua, she goes to the sandbox, digs up the truck, and gives it back to Joshua.

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Maman est toujours fâchée contre Joshua?
records.back_translation: Is Mom still mad at Joshua?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Maman est toujours fâchée contre Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Mom still mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Joshua est toujours fâché contre Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Joshua still mad at Isabel?

records.source_text: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
records.target_text: Isabel dit à Joshua qu'elle est vraiment désolée, et elle lui donne un gros câlin. Joshua lui redonne un gros câlin, et Maman se joint à eux.
records.back_translation: Isabel tells Joshua she's really sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mom joins them.

records.source_text: This is Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house, while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium sized cup on the table, and a big cup that she put away up high, on the shelf.
records.target_text: Voici Katie. Plus tôt aujourd’hui, la maman de Katie nettoyait la maison pendant que Katie regardait. Maman a laissé trois tasses dans la cuisine. Il y a une petite tasse sur le comptoir, une tasse de taille moyenne sur la table, et une grande tasse qu’elle avait rangée en haut, sur l'étagère.
records.back_translation: Here's Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There's a small cup on the counter, a medium-sized cup on the table, and a large cup that she had put away up high, on the shelf.

records.source_text: Katie and Dad just walked in and Katie asks her dad to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad, “I want the big cup!”
records.target_text: Katie et Papa viennent d'entrer et Katie demande à Paper de lui prendre une tasse. Katie dit à son Papa: « Je veux la grande tasse! »
records.back_translation: Katie and Dad just came in and Katie asks Paper to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad: "I want the big cup!"

records.source_text: Which cup will Dad give Katie?
records.target_text: Quelle tasse est-ce que Papa donnera à Katie?
records.back_translation: Which cup will Dad give to Katie?

records.source_text: Which cup does Katie want?
records.target_text: Quelle tasse est-ce que Katie veut?
records.back_translation: Which cup does Katie want?

records.source_text: The small cup
records.target_text: La petite tasse
records.back_translation: The small cup

records.source_text: The medium sized cup
records.target_text: La tasse de taille moyenne
records.back_translation: The medium-sized cup

records.source_text: The big cup
records.target_text: La grande tasse
records.back_translation: The big cup

records.source_text: How does Katie feel about not getting the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Katie se sent de ne pas avoir eu la tasse qu'elle voulait?
records.back_translation: How does Katie feel about not getting the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: How would Katie feel if she had received the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Katie se sentirait si elle avait reçu la tasse qu'elle voulait?
records.back_translation: How would Katie feel if she had received the mug she wanted?

records.source_text: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
records.target_text: Sam et Maria jouent ensemble. Ils regardent dehors et voient un nouveau magasin de l'autre côté de la rue. Maria dit à Sam: « Je vais nous acheter des nouveaux chandails là-bas », et elle part.
records.back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new store across the street. Maria says to Sam, "I'm going to buy us some new sweaters there," and she leaves.

records.source_text: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
records.target_text: Maman rentre à la maison et dit à Sam qu'elle vient de passer devant le magasin. « Est-ce qu'ils vendent des chandails? » demande Sam. « Non », dit Maman, « ils vendent seulement des chaussures ». « Maria va probablement maintenant acheter des chaussures au magasin », dit Sam.
records.back_translation: Mom comes home and tells Sam she just passed the store. "Do they sell sweaters?" asks Sam. "No," says Mom, "they only sell shoes." "Maria will probably now buy shoes at the store," says Sam.

records.source_text: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Maria sait qu'ils vendent des chaussures dans le magasin?
records.back_translation: Does Maria know that they sell shoes in the store?

records.source_text: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
records.target_text: Maria est arrivée au magasin. « J'aimerais acheter des chandails », dit-elle. « Il nous reste seulement des chaussettes », dit le commerçant. Comme Maria a aussi besoin de chaussettes, elle décide d’en acheter.
records.back_translation: Maria arrived at the store. "I'd like to buy some sweaters," she said. "We only have socks left," said the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to buy some.

records.source_text: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Sam sait que Maria a acheté des chaussettes?
records.back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria bought socks?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Qu'est-ce que Sam pense qu'ils vendent au magasin?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell at the store?

records.source_text: Shoes
records.target_text: Chaussures
records.back_translation: Footwear

records.source_text: Socks
records.target_text: Chaussettes
records.back_translation: Socks

records.source_text: Shirts
records.target_text: Chandails
records.back_translation: Sweaters

records.source_text:
On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”
“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
records.target_text:
Sur le chemin du retour, Maria voit son père. Elle dit à son père : « Je viens d'acheter des chaussettes. Je vais les partager avec mon frère, Sam. C'est une surprise. »
« C'est gentil de ta part », dit Papa. Puis il demande à Maria : « Est-ce que Sam sait ce que tu lui as acheté? »
records.back_translation: On the way back, Maria sees her father. She says to her father: "I just bought some socks. I'm going to share them with my brother, Sam. It's a surprise." "That's nice of you," says Dad. Then he asks Maria: "Does Sam know what you bought him?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Qu'est-ce que Maria dit à Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Dad?

records.source_text: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
records.target_text: Puis, Papa demande : « Qu'est-ce que Sam pense qu'ils vendent au magasin? »
records.back_translation: Then, Dad asks: "What does Sam think they sell at the store?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Qu'est-ce que Maria dit à Papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to Dad?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Qu'est-ce que Sam pense qu'ils vendent au magasin?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they are selling at the store?

records.source_text: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
records.target_text: Sam est très content de recevoir ses nouvelles chaussettes.
records.back_translation: Sam is very happy to receive his new socks.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
records.target_text: Imagine que tu marches à l'école et que tu portes tes nouvelles chaussures. Tu aimes vraiment tes nouvelles chaussures, et c'est le premier jour que tu les portes.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're walking to school and you're wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes, and it's the first day you're wearing them.

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
records.target_text: Tout à coup, un garçon te pousse par derrière. Tu trébuches et tu tombes dans une flaque de boue, et tes nouvelles chaussures se salissent.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, a boy pushes you from behind. You stumble and fall into a puddle of mud, and your new shoes get dirty.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu penses que le garçon t'a bousculé par exprès ou par accident?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy pushed you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Maintenant, choisis l'une des trois options que tu ferais:
records.back_translation: Now, choose one of the three options you would do:

records.source_text: clean up my shoes
records.target_text: nettoyer mes chaussures
records.back_translation: clean my shoes

records.source_text: walk away from the boy
records.target_text: m'éloigner du garçon
records.back_translation: to move away from the boy

records.source_text: push the boy in the mud
records.target_text: pousser le garçon dans la boue
records.back_translation: push the boy into the mud

records.source_text: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
records.target_text: Imagine que tu es dans la cour de récréation. Toi et d'autres enfants faites une course. Un garçon est debout sur le côté, en train de faire rebondir un ballon de basketball.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are in the schoolyard. You and other children are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
records.target_text: Tout à coup, le garçon fait rebondir le ballon et il roule sous tes pieds, et te fait tomber. Tu écorches ton genou, et quelqu'un d'autre gagne la course.
records.back_translation: Suddenly, the boy bounces the ball and it rolls under your feet, making you fall. You scrape your knee, and someone else wins the race.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu penses que le garçon t'a fait tomber par exprès ou par accident?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Maintenant, choisis l'une des trois options que tu ferais:
records.back_translation: Now, choose one of the three options you would do:

records.source_text: go to another area of the playground
records.target_text: aller dans une autre zone de la cour
records.back_translation: go to another area of the yard

records.source_text: say something mean to him
records.target_text: lui dire quelque chose de méchant
records.back_translation: tell him something mean

records.source_text: take care of my knee
records.target_text: soigner mon genou
records.back_translation: to treat my knee

records.source_text: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.
records.target_text: Imagine que tu travailles sur un devoir à ton bureau.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are working on an assignment at your desk.

records.source_text: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.
records.target_text: Tu vas tailler ton crayon, et en revenant à ton bureau, un garçon marche devant toi. Le garçon passe devant ton bureau avant que tu y arrives.
records.back_translation: You're going to sharpen your pencil, and on your way back to your desk, a boy walks in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
records.target_text: Tout à coup, le garçon a fait tomber tous les papiers de ton bureau, et ils sont éparpillés sur le sol.
records.back_translation: All of a sudden, the boy knocked all the papers off your desk, and they are scattered on the floor.

records.source_text: Do you think the boy knocked your papers onto the floor on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu penses que le garçon a fait tomber tes papiers par exprès ou par accident?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy dropped your papers on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Maintenant, choisis l'une des trois options que tu ferais:
records.back_translation: Now, choose one of the three options you would do:

records.source_text: call him a name
records.target_text: l'insulter
records.back_translation: insulting him/her/it

records.source_text: pick up the papers
records.target_text: ramasser les papiers
records.back_translation: pick up the papers

records.source_text: do nothing
records.target_text: ne rien faire
records.back_translation: to do nothing

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: par accident
records.back_translation: by accident

records.source_text: on purpose
records.target_text: par exprès
records.back_translation: on purpose

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: par accident
records.back_translation: by accident

records.source_text: on purpose
records.target_text: par exprès
records.back_translation: on purpose

records.source_text: by accident
records.target_text: par accident
records.back_translation: by accident

records.source_text: on purpose
records.target_text: par exprès
records.back_translation: on purpose

records.source_text: This is the matching game. In this game, you're going to choose sets of cards that match in some way. First, let's look at some of the cards you are going to see.
records.target_text: Voici le jeu de correspondance. Dans ce jeu, tu vas choisir des ensembles de cartes qui correspondent d'une certaine manière. D'abord, regardons certaines des cartes que tu vas voir.
records.back_translation: Here is the matching game. In this game, you will choose sets of cards that match in a certain way. First, let's look at some of the cards you will see.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a circle.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec un cercle.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a circle.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a square.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec un carré.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a square.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a triangle.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec un triangle.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a triangle.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a star.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une étoile.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a star.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a green shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une forme verte.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a green shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a red shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une forme rouge.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a red shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a blue shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une forme bleue.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a blue shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a yellow shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une forme jaune.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a yellow shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a small shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une petite forme.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a small shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a medium-sized shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une forme de taille moyenne.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a medium-sized shape.

records.source_text: Choose the card with a large shape.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec une grande forme.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with a large shape.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the white card.
records.target_text: Choisis l'étoile sur la carte blanche.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the white map.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the gray card.
records.target_text: Choisis l'étoile sur la carte grise.
records.back_translation: Choose the star on the registration certificate.

records.source_text: Choose the star on the black card.
records.target_text: Choisis l'étoile sur la carte noire.

records.target_text: Choisis l'étoile sur la carte rayée.

records.source_text: Choose the card with one star.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec 1 étoile.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 1 star.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 2 stars.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec 2 étoiles.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 2 stars.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 3 stars.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec 3 étoiles.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 3 stars.

records.source_text: Choose the card with 4 stars.
records.target_text: Choisis la carte avec 4 étoiles.
records.back_translation: Choose the card with 4 stars.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see two cards that are the same in one way. Then you will see a new card that is similar to one of those cards. Your job is to choose the card that is similar to the new card.
records.target_text: Maintenant, tu vas voir deux cartes qui sont identiques d’une certaine manière. Ensuite, tu vas voir une nouvelle carte qui est semblable à l’une de ces cartes. Ta tâche est de choisir la carte qui est semblable à la nouvelle carte.
records.back_translation: Now, you will see two cards that are identical in a certain way. Then, you will see a new card that is similar to one of these cards. Your task is to choose the card that is similar to the new card.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see three cards, and you're going to choose two that are the same in some way. Then you're going to see the same cards again, and pick two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Maintenant, tu vas voir trois cartes, et tu vas choisir les deux qui sont identiques d'une certaine manière. Ensuite, tu verras à nouveau les mêmes cartes, et tu choisiras les deux cartes qui sont identiques d'une manière différente.
records.back_translation: Now, you're going to see three cards, and you're going to choose the two that are identical in a certain way. Then, you'll see the same cards again, and you'll choose the two cards that are identical in a different way.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both circles.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des cercles.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have circles.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both squares.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des carrés.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have squares.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both triangles.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des triangles.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have triangles.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both red.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des formes rouges.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have red shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. Something's the same. They both have green shapes.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des formes vertes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have green shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both yellow.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des formes jaunes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have yellow shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both blue.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des formes bleues.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have blue shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both small.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des petites formes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have small shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both medium.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des formes de taille moyenne.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have medium-sized shapes.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both big.
records.target_text: Voici deux cartes. Elles ont quelque chose en commun. Elles ont toutes les deux des grandes formes.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. They have something in common. They both have large shapes.

records.source_text: Here is another card. Which of these is similar to this one?
records.target_text: Voici une autre carte. Laquelle de ces cartes est semblable à celle-ci?
records.back_translation: Here is another card. Which of these cards is similar to this one?

records.source_text: Here is the same set of cards again. Choose two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Voici le même ensemble de cartes. Choisis deux cartes qui sont identiques de manière différente.
records.back_translation: Here is the same set of cards. Choose two cards that are identical in a different way.

records.source_text: Here is a new set of cards. Choose two cards that are the same in some way.
records.target_text: Voici un nouvel ensemble de cartes. Choisis deux cartes qui sont identiques d’une certaine manière.
records.back_translation: Here is a new set of cards. Choose two cards that are identical in some way.

records.source_text: Choose two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Choisis deux cartes qui sont identiques de manière différente.
records.back_translation: Choose two cards that are identical in a different way.

records.source_text: Choose three cards that are the same in only one way.
records.target_text: Choisis trois cartes qui sont identiques d’une seule manière.
records.back_translation: Choose three cards that are identical in only one way.

records.source_text: Choose another three cards that are the same in only one way.
records.target_text: Choisis encore trois cartes qui sont identiques d’une seule manière.
records.back_translation: Choose three more cards that are identical in only one way.

records.source_text: Watch the squares light up.
records.target_text: Regarde les carrés s’illuminer.
records.back_translation: Watch the squares light up.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Choisis les carrés dans le même ordre.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This is the memory game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Ceci est le jeu de mémoire. Voici comment jouer.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game. Here's how to play.

records.source_text: You will see squares light up.
records.target_text: Tu verras les carrés s'illuminer.
records.back_translation: You will see the squares light up.

records.source_text: You're going to choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Tu vas choisir les carrés dans le même ordre.
records.back_translation: You will choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: Watch carefully! Try to remember the order.
records.target_text: Regarde attentivement! Essaie de mémoriser l'ordre.
records.back_translation: Look carefully! Try to memorize the order.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Choisis les carrés dans le même ordre.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Ce n'est pas tout à fait correct. Essaie encore. Choisis les carrés dans le même ordre.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again. Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This time the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Cette fois, le jeu ne te dira pas si tu as raison ou tort. Jouons au jeu de mémoire!
records.back_translation: This time, the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let's play the memory game!

records.source_text: Now let's play the memory game backwards!
records.target_text: Jouons maintenant au jeu de mémoire à l'envers!
records.back_translation: Let's play the reverse memory game now!

records.source_text: Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Jouons au jeu de mémoire!
records.back_translation: Let's play the memory game!

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Choisis les carrés dans l'ordre inverse.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again. Choose the squares in the backward order.
records.target_text: Ce n'est pas tout à fait correct. Essaie encore. Choisis les carrés dans l'ordre inverse.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again. Choose the squares in reverse order.

records.source_text: This is the heart game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Ceci est le jeu de cœur. Voici comment jouer.
records.back_translation: This is the game of hearts. Here's how to play.

records.source_text: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.
records.target_text: Quand tu vois un cœur, appuie sur le bouton du même côté.
records.back_translation: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again.
records.target_text: Ce n’est pas tout à fait correct. Essaie encore.
records.back_translation: That's not quite right. Try again.

records.source_text: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: Le cœur est à droite. Appuie sur le bouton de droite.
records.back_translation: The heart is on the right. Press the right button.

records.source_text: Time to practice!
records.target_text: C'est le temps de pratiquer!
records.back_translation: It's time to practice!

records.source_text: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
records.target_text: N'oublie pas! Lorsque tu vois un CŒUR, appuie sur le bouton du MÊME côté.
records.back_translation: Don't forget! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.

records.source_text: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Cette fois, le jeu ira plus vite. Il ne vas pas te dire si tu as raison ou tort. Essaie de garder le rythme!
records.back_translation: This time, the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up the pace!

records.source_text: Try to answer as fast as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Essaie de répondre aussi vite que possible sans te tromper. Si tu fais une erreur, tu n’as qu'à continuer!
records.back_translation: Try to answer as quickly as possible without making a mistake. If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Time to play!
records.target_text: C'est l'heure de jouer!
records.back_translation: It's time to play!

records.source_text: This is the flower game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Ceci est le jeu de fleurs. Voici comment jouer.
records.back_translation: This is the flower game. Here's how to play.

records.source_text: When you see a flower, press the button on the other side.
records.target_text: Quand vous voyez une fleur, appuyez sur le bouton du côté opposé.
records.back_translation: When you see a flower, press the button on the opposite side.

records.source_text: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: La fleur est à gauche. Appuie sur le bouton de droite.
records.back_translation: The flower is on the left. Press the right button.

records.source_text: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OTHER side.
records.target_text: Quand vous voyez une FLEUR, appuyez sur le bouton du côté OPPOSÉ.
records.back_translation: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

records.source_text: Now, we're going to play a game with hearts and flowers.
records.target_text: Maintenant, nous allons jouer à un jeu avec des cœurs et des fleurs.
records.back_translation: Now, we are going to play a game with hearts and flowers.

records.source_text: Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Essaie de garder le rythme!
records.back_translation: Try to keep up the pace!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Si vous faites une erreur, continuez!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, keep going!

records.source_text: Great job! You completed the game!
records.target_text: Bon travail! Tu as complété le jeu!
records.back_translation: Good job! You completed the game!
