records.source_text: In this game, you are going to listen to words and look at different pictures. Your job is to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: Dans ce jeu, tu vas écouter des mots et regarder différentes images. Ta tâche est de choisir l'image qui correspond au mot!
records.back_translation: In this game, you will listen to words and look at different images. Your task is to choose the image that matches the word!

records.source_text: You are going to see some different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then, you'll hear a word for one of the pictures. Make sure to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: Tu vas voir différentes images. Par exemple, une image d'une pomme et une image d'une carotte. Ensuite, tu vas entendre un mot pour l'une des images. Assure-toi de choisir l'image qui correspond au mot!
records.back_translation: You will see different images. For example, an image of an apple and an image of a carrot. Then, you will hear a word for one of the images. Make sure to choose the image that matches the word!

records.source_text: Some words are hard, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just give your best guess!
records.target_text: Certains mots sont difficiles, et c'est correct. Si tu n'es pas sûr, fait de ton mieux pour deviner!
records.back_translation: Some words are difficult, and that's okay. If you're not sure, do your best to guess!

records.source_text: If you need to hear the word again, press the speaker button.
records.target_text: Si tu veux entendre le mot à nouveau, appuie sur le bouton haut-parleur.
records.back_translation: If you want to hear the word again, press the speaker button.

records.source_text: You can tap on a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Try it now.
records.target_text: Tu peux appuyer sur un écran tactile, utiliser le pavé tactile, ou appuyer sur les touches fléchées pour cette activité. Essaie-le maintenant.
records.back_translation: You can tap a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Try it now.

records.source_text: To use an arrow key to choose a picture, press the key that points the same direction as the arrow below the picture.
records.target_text: Pour utiliser une touche fléchée pour choisir une image, appuie sur la touche qui pointe dans la même direction que la flèche sous l'image.
records.back_translation: To use an arrow key to choose an image, press the key that points in the same direction as the arrow under the image.

records.source_text: You can press the replay button to hear things again. Try it now.
records.target_text: Tu peux appuyer sur le bouton de relecture pour réécouter. Essaie-le maintenant.
records.back_translation: You can press the replay button to listen again. Try it now.

records.source_text: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look at the pictures carefully. Choose the picture that goes with the words you hear.
records.target_text: Ceci est une activité d'association. Écoute ce que je dis, puis regarde attentivement les images. Choisis l'image qui correspond aux mots que tu entends.
records.back_translation: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look carefully at the images. Choose the image that corresponds to the words you hear.

records.source_text: These questions ask you about how you feel at school and some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time. The first two are for practice.
records.target_text: Ces questions te demande comment tu te sens à l'école et certaines choses que tu fais à l'école. Il n'y a pas de bonnes ou de mauvaises réponses. Choisis la réponse qui décrit le mieux ce que tu penses. Non, jamais; Oui, quelquefois; Oui, la plupart du temps; Oui, tout le temps. Les deux premières sont pour se pratiquer.
records.back_translation: These questions ask you how you feel at school and some things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all the time. The first two are for practice.

records.source_text: Do you like to read comic books?
records.target_text: Aimes-tu lire des bandes dessinées?
records.back_translation: Do you like reading comic books?

records.source_text: Are you neat and tidy at school?
records.target_text: Es-tu propre et ordonné à l'école?
records.back_translation: Are you clean and tidy at school?

records.source_text: Is your teacher nice to you?
records.target_text: Est-ce que ton enseignant est gentil avec toi?
records.back_translation: Is your teacher nice to you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher like you?
records.target_text: Est-ce que ton enseignant t'aime?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher like you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher listen to you?
records.target_text: Est-ce que ton enseignant t'écoute?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher listen to you?

records.source_text: Is school fun?
records.target_text: Est-ce que l'école est amusante?
records.back_translation: Is school fun?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu aimes l'école?
records.back_translation: Do you like school?

records.source_text: Are you happy at school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu es heureux à l'école?
records.back_translation: Are you happy at school?

records.source_text: Do you feel safe at school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu te sens en sécurité à l'école?
records.back_translation: Do you feel safe at school?

records.source_text: Do you have friends in your class?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu as des amis dans ta classe?
records.back_translation: Do you have friends in your class?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class help you when you need it?
records.target_text: Est-ce que les enfants de ta classe t'aident quand tu en as besoin?
records.back_translation: Do the children in your class help you when you need it?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class play with you?
records.target_text: Est-ce que les enfants de ta classe jouent avec toi?
records.back_translation: Do the children in your class play with you?

records.source_text: Are the kids in your class nice to you?
records.target_text: Est-ce que les enfants de ta classe sont gentils avec toi?
records.back_translation: Are the children in your class nice to you?

records.source_text: Do you feel lonely at school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu te sens seul à l'école?
records.back_translation: Do you feel lonely at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at learning things in school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu es bon pour apprendre des choses à l'école?
records.back_translation: Are you good at learning things at school?

records.source_text: When schoolwork is hard, do you give up right away?
records.target_text: Quand le travail scolaire est difficile, est-ce que tu abandonnes tout de suite?
records.back_translation: When schoolwork is difficult, do you give up right away?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing reading activities at school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu aimes faire des activités de lecture à l'école?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing reading activities at school?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing math activities at school?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu aimes faire des activités de mathématiques à l'école?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing math activities at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at reading?
records.target_text: Es-tu bon en lecture?
records.back_translation: Are you good at reading?

records.source_text: Are you good at math?
records.target_text: Es-tu bon en mathématiques?
records.back_translation: Are you good at mathematics?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get smarter if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get smarter if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Certains enfants pensent qu'ils peuvent devenir plus intelligents s'ils travaillent très fort. Est-ce que tu penses que tu peux devenir plus intelligent si tu travailles très fort?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can become smarter if they work very hard. Do you think you can become smarter if you work very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at reading if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at reading if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Certains enfants pensent qu'ils peuvent s'améliorer en lecture s'ils travaillent très fort. Est-ce que tu penses que tu peux t'améliorer en lecture si tu travailles très fort?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can improve their reading if they work very hard. Do you think you can improve your reading if you work very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at math if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at math if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Certains enfants pensent qu'ils peuvent s'améliorer en mathématiques s'ils travaillent très fort. Est-ce que tu penses que tu peux t'améliorer en maths si tu travailles très fort?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can improve in math if they work very hard. Do you think you can improve in math if you work very hard?

records.source_text: No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time
records.target_text: Non, jamais; Oui, quelquefois; Oui, la plupart du temps; Oui, tout le temps
records.back_translation: No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all the time

records.source_text: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Voici Diana. Ce matin à l'école, Diana a mis son jouet dans ce tiroir, parce qu'elle ne voulait pas que quelqu'un le trouve.
records.back_translation: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But while Diana was outside, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer, to inside the desk.
records.target_text: Mais pendant que Diana était dehors, quelqu'un l'a trouvé et l'a déplacé de l'intérieur du tiroir à l'intérieur du bureau!
records.back_translation: But while Diana was out, someone found it and moved it from inside the drawer to inside the desk!

records.source_text: So now it’s playtime and Diana wants her toy.
records.target_text: C'est l'heure de jouer et Diana veut son jouet.
records.back_translation: It's time to play and Diana wants her toy.

records.source_text: Where will Diana look for her toy?
records.target_text: Où est-ce que Diana va chercher son jouet?
records.back_translation: Where does Diana go to get her toy?

records.source_text: And where is her toy really?
records.target_text: Et où est vraiment son jouet?
records.back_translation: And where is his toy really?

records.source_text: In the desk
records.target_text: Dans le bureau
records.back_translation: In the office

records.source_text: In the drawer
records.target_text: Dans le tiroir
records.back_translation: In the drawer

records.source_text: This morning when she came to school, Allie put her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.
records.target_text: Ce matin, quand elle est arrivée à l'école, Allie a mis son crayon jaune sur cette étagère, au-dessus de l'étagère qui range les sacs à dos.
records.back_translation: This morning, when she arrived at school, Allie put her yellow pencil on that shelf, above the shelf that stores the backpacks.

records.source_text: And then she went outside to play, see? Here’s Allie playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Allie’s yellow pencil fell down from on top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, see?
records.target_text: Puis elle est sortie pour jouer. Voici Allie en train de jouer dehors. Et pendant qu'elle jouait dehors, le crayon jaune d'Allie est tombé de l'étagère, derrière l'étagère des sacs à dos.
records.back_translation: Then she went out to play. Here's Allie playing outside. And while she was playing outside, Allie's yellow crayon fell off the shelf, behind the backpack shelf.

records.source_text: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike’s pencil is also yellow! But Allie is still outside playing, so she didn’t see what Mike was doing.
records.target_text: Ensuite, Mike entre, et Mike met son crayon au-dessus de l'étagère des sacs à dos. Le crayon de Mike est également jaune, mais Allie est toujours dehors en train de jouer, donc elle n'a pas vu ce que Mike faisait.
records.back_translation: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike's pencil is also yellow, but Allie is still outside playing, so she didn't see what Mike was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Allie comes in from outside, where will she look first for her pencil?
records.target_text: Maintenant, quand Allie revient de l'extérieur, où cherchera-t-elle son crayon?
records.back_translation: Now, when Allie comes back from outside, where will she look for her pencil?

records.source_text: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Sur l'étagère, au-dessus de l'étagère des sacs à dos
records.back_translation: On the shelf, above the backpack shelf

records.source_text: Behind the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Derrière l'étagère des sacs à dos
records.back_translation: Behind the backpack shelf

records.source_text: Let’s see what she does. Oh look, here is Allie reaching for this pencil up on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie reaching for that pencil... the pencil that is Mike's!
records.target_text: Voyons ce qu'elle fait. Oh, regarde, voici Allie qui tend la main vers ce crayon en haut de l'étagère. Et maintenant, Mike voit Allie prendre le crayon... le crayon qui appartient à Mike!
records.back_translation: Let's see what she's doing. Oh, look, here's Allie reaching for that pencil on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie taking the pencil... the pencil that belongs to Mike!

records.source_text: How do you think Mike feels about Allie reaching for that pencil?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Mike se sent lorsque Allie prend ce crayon?
records.back_translation: How do you think Mike feels when Allie takes that pencil?

records.source_text: How do you think Mike would feel if he had not seen Allie reaching for the pencil?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Mike se serait-il senti s’il n’avait pas vu Allie prendre le crayon?
records.back_translation: How do you think Mike would have felt if he hadn't seen Allie take the pencil?

records.source_text: Is Allie being mean and naughty for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Est-ce qu’Allie est méchante et malicieuse pour avoir pris le crayon de Mike?
records.back_translation: Is Allie mean and malicious for taking Mike's pencil?

records.source_text: Should Allie get in trouble with the teacher for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Est-ce qu’Allie devrait se faire chicaner par l’enseignant pour avoir pris le crayon de Mike?
records.back_translation: Should Allie be told off by the teacher for taking Mike's pencil?

records.source_text: Can you help Mike find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Peux-tu aider Mike à retrouver son crayon? Est-ce qu’il est sur l'étagère ou derrière l’étagère des sacs à dos?
records.back_translation: Can you help Mike find his pencil? Is it on the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Peux-tu aider Allie à retrouver son crayon? Est-ce qu’il est sur l'étagère ou derrière l’étagère des sacs à dos?
records.back_translation: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.
records.target_text: Voici Mark. Mark joue à un jeu vraiment niaiseux aujourd’hui et ne dit pas un mot toute la journée. Au lieu de parler, Mark dessine des images. Mark est à la bibliothèque, et décide le livre qu'il va lire. Maman montre à Mark deux livres, un livre sur les tasses et un livre sur les collines.
records.back_translation: Here's Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and isn't saying a word all day. Instead of talking, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he's going to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.

records.source_text: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside-down, so that it looks like a cup!
records.target_text: Mark dessine une image d’une colline, pour dire à Maman qu’il veut lire le livre sur les collines. Mais quand Mark donne l’image à Maman, elle la tient à l’envers, de sorte qu’elle ressemble à une tasse!
records.back_translation: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives the picture to Mom, she holds it upside down, so that it looks like a cup!

records.source_text: What did Mark mean to draw?
records.target_text: Qu’est-ce que Mark voulait dessiner?
records.back_translation: What did Mark want to draw?

records.source_text: A hill
records.target_text: Une colline
records.back_translation: A hill

records.source_text: A cup
records.target_text: Une tasse
records.back_translation: A cup

records.source_text: When Mom sees the picture, what book will she give Mark?
records.target_text: Quand Maman voit l’image, quel livre donnera-t-elle à Mark?
records.back_translation: When Mom sees the picture, what book will she give to Mark?

records.source_text: What book does Mark really want?
records.target_text: Quel livre est-ce que Mark veut vraiment?
records.back_translation: Which book does Mark really want?

records.source_text: The book about hills
records.target_text: Le livre sur les collines
records.back_translation: The book on the hills

records.source_text: The book about cups
records.target_text: Le livre sur les tasses
records.back_translation: The book on cups

records.source_text: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?
records.target_text: Regarde, Maman a réalisé son erreur et a donné à Mark le livre qu’il voulait vraiment! Comment est-ce que tu penses que Mark se sent d'avoir reçu le livre qu’il voulait?
records.back_translation: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah tells all of the kids to take one storybook from the bag that she brought. There is one storybook for every kid.
records.target_text: L’enseignante Sarah demande à tous les enfants de prendre un livre dans le sac qu’elle a apporté. Il y a un livre pour chaque enfant.
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks all the children to take a book from the bag she brought. There is one book for each child.

records.source_text: Now there are two storybooks left, and Brian and Megan are the last two kids without storybooks. But when Brian goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows that Megan doesn’t have a storybook yet, and that everyone is only supposed to have one. Brian hides the extra storybook in his desk.
records.target_text: Il reste que deux livres, et Brian et Megan sont les deux derniers enfants sans à ne pas en avoir. Mais quand Brian va chercher son livre, il décide de prendre les deux livres, même s’il sait que Megan n’en a pas encore et que chaque enfant est censé d'en avoir un seul. Brian cache le livre supplémentaire dans son bureau.
records.back_translation: There are only two books left, and Brian and Megan are the last two children not to have one. But when Brian goes to get his book, he decides to take both books, even though he knows Megan doesn't have one yet and that each child is supposed to have only one. Brian hides the extra book in his desk.

records.source_text: How does Megan feel about being the only child without a storybook?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Megan se sent d’être la seule sans livre?
records.back_translation: How does Megan feel about being the only one without a book?

records.source_text: How would Megan feel if she received a book?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Megan se sentirait-elle si elle recevait un livre?
records.back_translation: How would Megan feel if she received a book?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah asks Brian, “Is there a storybook leftover, so Megan can have one?” Brian tells Teacher Sarah, “No, there is no storybook left. They are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: L’enseignante Sarah demande à Brian: « Est-ce qu’il reste un livre pour que Megan puisse en avoir un? » Brian répond à l’enseignante Sarah: « Non, il ne reste plus de livre. Ils sont tous utilisés en ce moment. »
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks Brian: "Is there a book left so Megan can have one?" Brian answers Teacher Sarah: "No, there are no books left. They are all in use right now."

records.source_text: Is Brian lying?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Brian ment?
records.back_translation: Is Brian lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Est-ce qu'il reste un livre qui n’est pas utilisé en ce moment?
records.back_translation: Is there a book left that is not being used right now?

records.source_text: Megan is sad that she doesn’t have a storybook, and asks Teacher Sarah, "is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says, “I’m so sorry Megan, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Megan est triste de ne pas avoir de livre et demande à l’enseignante Sarah: « Y a-t-il un livre pour moi? » L’enseignante Sarah dit: « Je suis vraiment désolée Megan, mais il n’y a plus de livres, ils sont tous utilisés en ce moment. »
records.back_translation: Megan is sad not to have a book and asks the teacher Sarah: "Is there a book for me?" Teacher Sarah says: "I'm really sorry Megan, but there are no more books, they are all in use right now."

records.source_text: Is Teacher Sarah lying?
records.target_text: Est-ce que l’enseignante Sarah ment?
records.back_translation: Is the teacher Sarah lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Est-ce qu'il reste un livre qui n’est pas utilisé en ce moment?
records.back_translation: Is there a book left that is not being used right now?

records.source_text: This is Josh. Earlier today, Josh was tidying his room. Josh put his big basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball down on the bottom shelf.
records.target_text: Voici Josh. Plus tôt dans la journée, Josh rangeait sa chambre. Josh a déposé son gros ballon de basketball sur son bureau, son ballon de soccer de taille moyenne sur sa table, et sa petite balle de baseball en bas de l’étagère.
records.back_translation: Here's Josh. Earlier today, Josh was tidying his room. Josh placed his large basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball at the bottom of the shelf.

records.source_text: Josh’s mom just walked in and Josh asks his mom to get one of the toys. Josh tells his mom, “I want the small ball!”
records.target_text: La maman de Josh vient d’entrer et Josh lui demande de prendre un des jouets. Et Josh dit à sa maman: « Je veux la petite balle! »
records.back_translation: Josh's mom just came in and Josh asks her to take one of the toys. And Josh tells his mom: "I want the little ball!"

records.source_text: Which ball will mom get for Josh?
records.target_text: Quelle balle maman ira-t-elle chercher pour Josh?
records.back_translation: Which ball will Mom go get for Josh?

records.source_text: Which ball does Josh want?
records.target_text: Quelle la balle Josh veut-il?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Josh want?

records.source_text: The small baseball
records.target_text: La petite balle de baseball
records.back_translation: The little baseball

records.source_text: The medium sized soccer ball
records.target_text: Le ballon de soccer de taille moyenne
records.back_translation: The medium-sized soccer ball

records.source_text: The big basketball
records.target_text: Le gros ballon de basketball
records.back_translation: The big basketball

records.source_text: Josh wanted the baseball but mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Josh feels about receiving the wrong toy?
records.target_text: Josh voulait la balle de baseball, mais sa maman lui a donné le ballon de soccer! Comment est-ce que tu penses que Josh se sent d'avoir reçu le mauvais jouet?
records.back_translation: Josh wanted the baseball, but his mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Josh feels about getting the wrong toy?

records.source_text: How do you think Josh would feel if he had received the correct toy?
records.target_text: Comment penses-tu que Josh se sentirait s'il avait reçu le bon jouet?
records.back_translation: How do you think Josh would feel if he had received the right toy?

records.source_text: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she would like to take to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball at recess.
records.target_text: Ce matin, Papa a demandé à Emma quel jouet elle voulait apporter à l’école, et Emma lui a répondu qu’elle aimerait jouer avec sa balle jaune lors de la récréation.
records.back_translation: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she wanted to bring to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball during recess.

records.source_text: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind, so she yelled to her dad, “Actually, may I please have my red ball instead?” and kept getting ready for school. But Dad did not hear Emma ask for her red ball.
records.target_text: Puis Emma est allée dans sa chambre pour se préparer pour l’école. En se préparant, elle a changé d'idée et a crié à son père: « En fait, est-ce que je peux plutôt avoir ma balle rouge? » et elle a continué de se préparer pour l’école. Mais Papa n’a pas entendu Emma demander sa balle rouge.
records.back_translation: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While getting ready, she changed her mind and yelled to her father: "Actually, can I have my red ball instead?" and she continued to get ready for school. But Dad didn't hear Emma ask for her red ball.

records.source_text: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?
records.target_text: Quel jouet Papa pense-t-il que Emma veut apporter à l’école?
records.back_translation: What toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?

records.source_text: Dad didn’t hear Emma say she wants her red ball. So dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad goes to pack Emma’s bag, but can’t find her yellow ball in the toy box! But dad finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.
records.target_text: Papa n’a pas entendu Emma dire qu’elle voulait sa balle rouge. Alors Papa pense que Emma veut sa balle jaune. Papa va préparer le sac de Emma, mais ne trouve pas sa balle jaune dans le coffre à jouets! Mais Papa trouve une balle bleue dans le coffre à jouets, alors il met plutôt la balle bleue dans le sac de Emma.
records.back_translation: Dad didn't hear Emma say she wanted her red ball. So Dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad is going to pack Emma's bag, but can't find her yellow ball in the toy chest! But Dad finds a blue ball in the toy chest, so he puts the blue ball in Emma's bag instead.

records.source_text: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Emma sait que Papa a mis la balle bleue dans son sac?
records.back_translation: Does Emma know that Dad put the blue ball in her bag?

records.source_text: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?
records.target_text: Quelle balle Emma pense-t-elle que Papa a mise dans son sac?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Emma think Dad put in her bag?

records.source_text: The yellow ball
records.target_text: La balle jaune
records.back_translation: The yellow ball

records.source_text: The red ball
records.target_text: La balle rouge
records.back_translation: The red ball

records.source_text: The blue ball
records.target_text: La balle bleue
records.back_translation: The blue ball

records.source_text: On the way to school, Dad tells Emma, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t pack the toy that you wanted because I couldn’t find it”.
records.target_text: En chemin vers l’école, Papa dit à Emma: « Je suis tellement désolé, je n’ai pas pu mettre le jouet que tu voulais parce que je ne l’ai pas trouvé. »
records.back_translation: On the way to school, Dad said to Emma: "I'm so sorry, I couldn't put the toy you wanted because I didn't find it."

records.source_text: What toy does Emma want?
records.target_text: Quel jouet Emma veut-elle?
records.back_translation: What toy does Emma want?

records.source_text: What toy did Dad pack for Emma?
records.target_text: Quel jouet Papa a-t-il mis dans le sac de Emma?
records.back_translation: What toy did Daddy put in Emma's bag?

records.source_text: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.
records.target_text: Emma est très heureuse de jouer avec sa balle.
records.back_translation: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.

records.source_text: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil box.
records.target_text: Voici Gabriel. Cet après-midi à l’école, Gabriel a mis son crayon dans son étui à crayons.
records.back_translation: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil case.

records.source_text: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel’s pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.
records.target_text: Mais pendant que Gabriel était dehors, quelqu’un a utilisé son crayon! Après avoir utilisé le crayon de Gabriel, la personne a remis le crayon dans un panier.
records.back_translation: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel's pencil, the person put the pencil back in a basket.

records.source_text: So now it’s time for class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.
records.target_text: Maintenant il est temps d’aller en classe, et Gabriel veut son crayon.
records.back_translation: Now it's time to go to class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.

records.source_text: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?
records.target_text: Où est-ce que Gabriel cherchera son crayon?
records.back_translation: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?

records.source_text: In the box
records.target_text: Dans l’étui à crayon
records.back_translation: In the pencil case

records.source_text: In the basket
records.target_text: Dans le panier
records.back_translation: In the basket

records.source_text: And where is his pencil really?
records.target_text: Et où est vraiment son crayon?
records.back_translation: And where is his pencil really?

records.source_text: This afternoon when he came home, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.
records.target_text: Cet après-midi en rentrant chez lui, Bobby a mis son ballon de soccer sur la table.
records.back_translation: This afternoon, on his way home, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Bobby playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Bobby’s soccer ball fell off the table and onto the floor.
records.target_text: Et puis il est sorti jouer. Voici Bobby en train de jouer dehors. Pendant qu’il jouait dehors, le ballon de soccer de Bobby est tombé de la table, et sur le sol.
records.back_translation: And then he went out to play. Here's Bobby playing outside. While he was playing outside, Bobby's soccer ball fell off the table, and onto the floor.

records.source_text: Then Bobby’s sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn’t see what Anna was doing.
records.target_text: Ensuite, la sœur de Bobby, Anna, entre. Anna a aussi un ballon de soccer! Anna met son ballon de soccer sur la table. Bobby est toujours dehors en train de jouer, donc il n’a pas vu ce que Anna faisait.
records.back_translation: Then, Bobby's sister, Anna, enters. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Anna was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look first for his soccer ball?
records.target_text: Maintenant, quand Bobby rentre de dehors, où est-ce qu’il cherchera d’abord son ballon de soccer?
records.back_translation: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look for his soccer ball first?

records.source_text: On the table
records.target_text: Sur la table
records.back_translation: On the table

records.source_text: On the floor
records.target_text: Sur le plancher
records.back_translation: On the floor

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for that soccer ball... the soccer ball that is Anna's!
records.target_text: Voyons ce qu’il fait. Oh regarde, voici Bobby qui essaie de prendre le ballon de soccer sur la table. Et maintenant, Anna voit Bobby qui essaie de prendre ce ballon de soccer... le ballon de soccer qui appartient à Anna!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he's doing. Oh look, here's Bobby trying to get the soccer ball off the table. And now, Anna sees Bobby trying to get that soccer ball... the soccer ball that belongs to Anna!

records.source_text: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby reaching for that soccer ball?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Anna se sent quand Bobby essaie de prendre ce ballon de soccer?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna feels when Bobby tries to take that soccer ball?

records.source_text: How do you think Anna would feel if she had not seen Bobby reaching for the soccer ball?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que tu penses que Anna se sentirait si elle n’avait pas vu Bobby prendre ce ballon de soccer?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna would feel if she hadn't seen Bobby take that soccer ball?

records.source_text: Is Bobby being mean and naughty for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Bobby est méchant et malicieux d'avoir pris le ballon de soccer de Anna?
records.back_translation: Is Bobby mean and malicious for taking Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Should Bobby get in trouble with their mom for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Bobby devrait-il se faire chicaner par sa mère pour avoir pris le ballon de soccer de Anna?
records.back_translation: Should Bobby be told off by his mother for taking Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux aider Anna à trouver son ballon de soccer? Est-ce qu’il est sur la table ou par terre?
records.back_translation: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux aider Bobby à trouver son ballon de soccer? Est-ce qu’il est sur la table ou par terre?
records.back_translation: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Alex, Beth et Johnny jouent à un jeu au parc. Voici comment se déroule le jeu: Un enfant se cache, mais dessine un indice dans le bac à sable pour que les autres puissent les trouver.
records.back_translation: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game works: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the others can find them.

records.source_text: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny means to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Johnny goes to hide behind the flower bush.
records.target_text: Johnny décide de se cacher derrière le buisson de fleurs. Il dessine un indice dans le sable. Johnny a l’intention de dessiner le buisson de fleurs, mais le dessin ressemble plutôt à une roche! Alors Johnny va se cacher derrière le buisson de fleurs.
records.back_translation: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny intends to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks more like a rock! So Johnny is going to hide behind the flower bush.

records.source_text: What did Johnny mean to draw?
records.target_text: Qu’est-ce que Johnny voulait dessiner?
records.back_translation: What did Johnny want to draw?

records.source_text: A flower bush
records.target_text: Un buisson de fleurs
records.back_translation: A bush of flowers

records.source_text: A rock
records.target_text: Une roche
records.back_translation: A rock

records.source_text: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?
records.target_text: Quand Alex et Beth voient cet indice, où est-ce qu’ils vont chercher d’abord pour Johnny? Derrière le buisson de fleurs ou derrière la roche?
records.back_translation: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Johnny really is?
records.target_text: Est-ce que tu peux les aider à trouver où Johnny se cache vraiment?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find where Johnny is really hiding?

records.source_text: Behind the flower bush
records.target_text: Derrière le buisson de fleurs
records.back_translation: Behind the flower bush

records.source_text: Behind the rock
records.target_text: Derrière la roche
records.back_translation: Behind the rock

records.source_text: Look, Alex and Beth found Johnny, and won the game! How do you think Alex and Beth feel about winning the game?
records.target_text: Regarde, Alex et Beth ont trouvé Johnny et ont gagné le jeu! Comment est-ce que tu penses que Alex et Beth se sentent d’avoir gagné le jeu?
records.back_translation: Look, Alex and Beth found Johnny and won the game! How do you think Alex and Beth feel about winning the game?

records.source_text: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.
records.target_text: Papa dit à James et Sophie de se préparer pour l’école. Papa leur dit de mettre leurs chaussures.
records.back_translation: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.

records.source_text: Sophie can’t find one of her shoes! She’s looking everywhere but she can't find it.
records.target_text: Sophie ne trouve pas une de ses chaussures! Elle cherche partout, mais ne peut pas la trouver.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find one of her shoes! She's looking everywhere, but can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Sophie feel about losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Comment est-ce que Sophie se sent après avoir perdu sa chaussure?
records.back_translation: How does Sophie feel after losing her shoe?

records.source_text: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?
records.target_text: Comment Sophie se sentirait-t-elle si elle retrouvait sa chaussure?
records.back_translation: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?

records.source_text: Sophie can't find her shoe because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.
records.target_text: Sophie ne trouve pas sa chaussure parce qu’au début de la journée, lorsque personne ne regardait, James a joué un tour à Sophie et a caché sa chaussure dans le coffre à jouets.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find her shoe because at the beginning of the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy chest.

records.source_text: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can’t find her shoe. Dad gets mad at Sophie, because she lost her shoe and now they are late for school.
records.target_text: Sophie cherche partout, mais ne peut pas trouver sa chaussure. Papa est fâché contre Sophie parce qu’elle a perdu sa chaussure, et maintenant ils sont en retard pour l’école.
records.back_translation: Sophie is looking everywhere, but cannot find her shoe. Dad is angry at Sophie because she lost her shoe, and now they are late for school.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Est-ce juste que Papa soit fâché contre Sophie pour avoir perdu sa chaussure?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Papa est fâché contre James?
records.back_translation: Is Dad mad at James?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Sophie est fâchée contre James?
records.back_translation: Is Sophie mad at James?

records.source_text: When James sees that Dad is mad at Sophie, he goes to the toy box and gets the shoe, and gives it back to Sophie.
records.target_text: Quand James voit que Papa est fâché contre Sophie, il va au coffre à jouets, récupère la chaussure, et la donne à Sophie.
records.back_translation: When James sees that Dad is angry with Sophie, he goes to the toy chest, retrieves the shoe, and gives it to Sophie.

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at Sophie now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Papa est maintenant fâché contre Sophie?
records.back_translation: Is Dad now mad at Sophie?

records.source_text: Is Dad mad at James now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Papa est maintenant fâché contre James?
records.back_translation: Is Dad now mad at James?

records.source_text: Is Sophie mad at James now?
records.target_text: Est-ce que Sophie est maintenant fâchée contre James?
records.back_translation: Is Sophie now mad at James?

records.source_text: James tells Sophie that he’s very sorry, and Sophie and Dad forgive James. They all hug.
records.target_text: James dit à Sophie qu'il est très désolé et Sophie et Papa pardonnent James. Ils font tous un câlin.
records.back_translation: James tells Sophie he is very sorry and Sophie and Dad forgive James. They all hug.

records.source_text: This is Mika. Mika’s mom owns a bookshop, and sometimes Mika helps out. Earlier today, Mika was organizing books on tables and shelves. Mika put a very large stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.
records.target_text: Voici Mika. La maman de Mika travaille dans une librairie et parfois Mika l'aide. Plus tôt dans la journée, Mika rangeait des livres sur les tables et les étagères. Mika a mis une pile de livres bleus sur le bureau, une pile de taille moyenne de livres rouges sur la table, et une petite pile de livres jaunes sur l’étagère.
records.back_translation: This is Mika. Mika's mom works in a bookstore and sometimes Mika helps her. Earlier in the day, Mika was tidying books on the tables and shelves. Mika put a stack of blue books on the desk, a medium-sized stack of red books on the table, and a small stack of yellow books on the shelf.

records.source_text: Mika’s mom just walked in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where the book is, and tells mom, “The book is in the small stack!”
records.target_text: La maman de Mika vient d’entrer. Maman demande un des livres à Mika. Mika se rappelle où il est et dit à Maman : « Le livre est dans la petite pile! »
records.back_translation: Mika's mom just came in. Mom asks Mika for one of the books. Mika remembers where it is and tells Mom: "The book is in the small pile!"

records.source_text: Which stack of books will mom look in?
records.target_text: Dans quelle pile de livres maman regardera-t-elle?
records.back_translation: In which pile of books will Mom look?

records.source_text: Which stack of books was Mika talking about?
records.target_text: De quelle pile de livres Mika parlait-il?
records.back_translation: Which stack of books was Mika talking about?

records.source_text: The large blue stack
records.target_text: La grosse pile bleue
records.back_translation: The big blue battery

records.source_text: The medium sized red stack
records.target_text: La pile de taille moyenne rouge
records.back_translation: The red medium-sized battery

records.source_text: The small yellow stack
records.target_text: La petite pile jaune
records.back_translation: The small yellow battery

records.source_text: Mom looks in the wrong stack of books and can’t find the book that she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not finding the book she wanted?
records.target_text: Maman cherche dans la mauvaise pile de livres et ne trouve pas le livre qu’elle voulait. Comment est-ce que tu penses que Maman se sent de ne pas avoir trouvé le livre qu’elle voulait?
records.back_translation: Mom is looking in the wrong pile of books and can't find the book she wanted. How do you think Mom feels about not having found the book she wanted?

records.source_text: How do you think Mom would feel if she could find the book she wanted?
records.target_text: Selon toi, comment Maman se sentirait-elle si elle pouvait trouver le livre qu’elle voulait?
records.back_translation: According to you, how would Mom feel if she could find the book she wanted?

records.source_text: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy shop across the street. Kat decides to go buy some new toys at the toy shop. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George says he would like a new basketball.
records.target_text: George et Kat jouent ensemble. Ils regardent dehors et voient un nouveau magasin de jouets de l’autre côté de la rue. Kat décide d’aller acheter des nouveaux jouets au magasin de jouets. Kat demande à George quel jouet il aimerait avoir, et George répond qu’il aimerait un nouveau ballon de basketball.
records.back_translation: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy store across the street. Kat decides to go buy new toys at the toy store. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George replies that he would like a new basketball.

records.source_text: While Kat is walking to the toy shop, George changes his mind and yells to Kat, “Actually, can I please have some crayons?” But Kat did not hear George ask for crayons.
records.target_text: Lorsque Kat se dirige vers le magasin de jouets, George change d’avis et crie à Kat : « En fait, est-ce que je peux avoir des crayons? », Mais Kat n’a pas entendu George demander des crayons.
records.back_translation: When Kat heads to the toy store, George changes his mind and shouts to Kat, "Actually, can I have some crayons?" But Kat didn't hear George ask for crayons.

records.source_text: Which toy does Kat think George wants from the toy shop?
records.target_text: Quel jouet Kat pense-t-elle que George veut du magasin de jouets?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Kat think George wants from the toy store?

records.source_text: Kat didn’t hear George say that he wanted crayons. So Kat thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy shop, but then the shop owner says that they don’t have any basketballs! But they do have storybooks, so Kat buys a storybook for George instead.
records.target_text: Kat n’a pas entendu George dire qu’il voulait des crayons. Elle pense donc que George veut un ballon de basketball. Kat va au magasin de jouets, mais le propriétaire du magasin lui dit qu’ils n’ont pas de ballons de basketball! Mais ils ont des livres, alors Kat achète un livre pour George.
records.back_translation: Kat didn't hear George say he wanted crayons. So she thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy store, but the store owner tells her they don't have basketballs! But they have books, so Kat buys a book for George.

records.source_text: Does George know that Kat bought a storybook?
records.target_text: Est-ce que George sait que Kat a acheté un livre?
records.back_translation: Does George know that Kat bought a book?

records.source_text: What does George think Kat bought at the toy shop?
records.target_text: Qu’est-ce que George pense que Kat a acheté au magasin de jouets?
records.back_translation: What does George think Kat bought at the toy store?

records.source_text: A basketball
records.target_text: Un ballon de basketball
records.back_translation: A basketball

records.source_text: A storybook
records.target_text: Un livre
records.back_translation: A book

records.source_text: Crayons
records.target_text: Des crayons
records.back_translation: Pencils

records.source_text: Kat comes back and tells George, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t buy you a basketball because the store didn’t have any.”
records.target_text: Kat revient et dit à George: « Je suis vraiment désolée, je n’ai pas pu t’acheter un ballon de basketball parce que le magasin n’en avait pas. »
records.back_translation: Kat comes back and tells George: "I'm really sorry, I couldn't buy you a basketball because the store didn't have any."

records.source_text: What toy does George want?
records.target_text: Quel jouet veut George?
records.back_translation: What toy does George want?

records.source_text: What toy did Kat buy for George?
records.target_text: Quel jouet est-ce que Kat a acheté pour George?
records.back_translation: What toy did Kat buy for George?

records.source_text: George is very happy to play with his new storybook.
records.target_text: George est très heureux de jouer avec son nouveau livre.
records.back_translation: George is very happy to play with his new book.

records.source_text: Welcome to ROAR - Inference
records.target_text: Bienvenue à ROAR - Inférence
records.back_translation: Welcome to ROAR - Inference

records.source_text: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.
records.target_text: Lisez chaque histoire attentivement. Pensez à ce qui s'est passé dans l'histoire et à ce que vous savez. Choisissez la meilleure réponse pour chaque question.
records.back_translation: Read each story carefully. Think about what happened in the story and what you know. Choose the best answer for each question.

records.source_text: Now it's your turn!
records.target_text: À ton tour!
records.back_translation: Your turn!

records.source_text: Here is another picture. I have to choose which of these pictures is the same as this new picture.
records.target_text: Voici une autre image. Je dois choisir laquelle de ces images est identique à cette nouvelle image.
records.back_translation: Here is another image. I need to choose which of these images is identical to this new image.

records.source_text: I will pick this one! This one is the same as the new picture because they are both squares.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
Dans ce jeu, tu vas jouer avec des nombres.

Certaines questions pourraient être faciles et d’autres difficiles. Ce n’est pas grave! Fais de ton mieux et prends ton temps. Allons-y!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you're going to play with numbers.

Some questions might be easy and others difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Let's go!

records.source_text: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: Il est temps pour le premier jeu de nombres! Pratiquons ensemble.
records.back_translation: It's time for the first number game! Let's practice together.

records.source_text: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice.
records.target_text: Il est temps pour le prochain jeu de nombres! Pratiquons ensemble.
records.back_translation: It's time for the next number game! Let's practice together.

records.source_text: In this number game, you will say how many things are in the picture! The grownup helping you will press the button.
records.target_text: Dans ce jeu de nombres, tu vas dire combien d’objets se trouvent dans l’image! L’adulte qui t'aide appuiera sur le bouton.
records.back_translation: In this number game, you're going to say how many objects are in the picture! The adult helping you will press the button.

records.source_text: This time, you will choose the button with the right number!
records.target_text: Cette fois, tu choisiras le bouton avec le bon nombre!
records.back_translation: This time, you'll choose the button with the right number!

records.source_text: This is the memory game.
records.target_text: Ceci est le jeu de mémoire.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game.

records.source_text: In this game, we are going to see squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares that light up.
records.target_text: Dans ce jeu, nous allons voir des carrés s'allumer. Ton travail consiste à toucher les carrés qui s'allument.
records.back_translation: In this game, we're going to see squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares that light up.

records.source_text: Now we will see two squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares in the same order as they light up!
records.target_text: Maintenant, nous allons voir deux carrés s'allumer. Ton travail consiste à toucher les carrés dans le même ordre qu'ils s'allument !
records.back_translation: Now, we're going to see two squares light up. Your job is to touch the squares in the same order they light up!

records.source_text: Watch the squares light up. I will touch the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Regarde les carrés s'allumer. Je vais toucher les carrés dans le même ordre.
records.back_translation: Watch the squares light up. I'm going to touch the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: OK, now you're going to play the rest of the memory game on your own. More squares will light up each time the longer you play, so watch carefully!
records.target_text: D'accord, maintenant vous allez jouer le reste du jeu de mémoire seul. Plus de carrés s'allumeront à chaque fois plus vous jouerez longtemps, alors regardez attentivement !
records.back_translation: Okay, now you're going to play the rest of the memory game alone. More squares will light up each time the longer you play, so watch carefully!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Si vous faites une erreur, continuez!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, keep going!

records.back_translation: Please use a tablet in landscape mode, a desktop computer, or a laptop to complete the activities.

records.source_text: Hi! We are excited to have you play some games with us today!
records.target_text: Hoi! We zijn blij dat je vandaag een paar spelletjes met ons komt spelen!
records.back_translation: Hi! We're happy you're coming to play some games with us today!

records.source_text: First, you get to choose a buddy to play along with you. As you complete the different games, you will get to pick an accessory like a hat or glasses to decorate your buddy.
records.target_text: Eerst mag je een maatje kiezen om mee te spelen. Naarmate je de verschillende spelletjes voltooit, mag je een accessoire kiezen, zoals een hoed of een bril, om je maatje te versieren.
records.back_translation: First, you get to choose a buddy to play with. As you complete the different games, you get to choose an accessory, such as a hat or glasses, to decorate your buddy.

records.source_text: Pick a buddy to play with!
records.target_text: Kies een maatje om mee te spelen!
records.back_translation: Choose a buddy to play with!

records.source_text: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.
records.target_text: Nu je jouw maatje hebt, willen we uitleggen hoe de spelletjes werken.
records.back_translation: Now that you have your buddy, we want to explain how the games work.

records.source_text: During the games you will need to listen to instructions so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is the way you like it. If you need to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button up in the corner of your screen.
records.target_text: Tijdens de spelletjes moet je naar de instructies luisteren, dus zorg ervoor dat je speakers aanstaan en dat het volume naar wens is. Als je de instructies nog een keer wilt horen, kun je op de speakerknop boven in de hoek van je scherm klikken.
records.back_translation: During the games, you need to listen to the instructions, so make sure your speakers are on and the volume is to your liking. If you want to hear the instructions again, you can click the speaker button in the top corner of your screen.

records.source_text:
You can choose your answers in different ways depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can pick the way that works best for you.

If you have any questions or need help getting started, please ask the adult who is nearby to help you.
records.target_text:
Je kan je antwoorden op verschillende manieren kiezen, afhankelijk van het type tablet of computer dat je gebruikt. Je kan een muis of touchpad gebruiken om op je keuze te klikken, je kan de pijltjestoetsen op je toetsenbord gebruiken of je kunt jouw scherm aanraken als je een tablet gebruikt. Je kan de manier kiezen die het beste voor je werkt.

Als je vragen hebt of hulp nodig hebt om te beginnen, vraag dan de volwassene die in de buurt is om je te helpen.
records.back_translation:
You can choose your answers in different ways, depending on the type of tablet or computer you are using. You can use a mouse or touchpad to click on your choice, you can use the arrow keys on your keyboard, or you can touch your screen if you are using a tablet. You can choose the method that works best for you.

If you have questions or need help getting started, ask the adult nearby to help you.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. 

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
In dit spel ga je wat rekensommen maken. Sommige lijken op de sommen die je op school doet en sommige zijn net iets anders dan op school. 

Sommige vragen kunnen makkelijk voor je zijn en andere kunnen moeilijk zijn. Dat is oké! Doe je best en neem de tijd. De meeste vragen hebben vier keuzes. Kies degene waarvan je denkt dat die juist is. Laten we beginnen!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you're going to do some math problems. Some are similar to the problems you do at school, and some are just a little different from school.

Some questions might be easy for you, and others might be difficult. That's okay! Do your best and take your time. Most questions have four choices. Choose the one you think is correct. Let's begin!
