records.target_text: Ze struikelde over een steen en liet haar boeken vallen.
records.back_translation: She stumbled over a stone and dropped her books.

records.source_text: The teacher will give the students cake if they stand in a line.
records.target_text: De leraar zal de leerlingen taart geven, als ze in de rij gaan staan.
records.back_translation: The teacher will give the students cake if they line up.

records.source_text: We will dance together if there is music playing.
records.target_text: We zullen samen dansen, als er muziek speelt.
records.back_translation: We will dance together, if music plays.

records.source_text: Although it is hot outside, I am wearing a jacket with a hood.
records.target_text: Hoewel het buiten warm is, draag ik een jas met capuchon.
records.back_translation: Although it is warm outside, I am wearing a hooded jacket.

records.source_text: He likes swimming. However, he chose to play soccer with his friends.
records.target_text: Hij houdt van zwemmen. Hij koos er echter voor om met zijn vrienden te voetballen.
records.back_translation: He loves swimming. However, he chose to play soccer with his friends.

records.source_text: Despite the noise in the classroom, she focused on reading her notebook.
records.target_text: Ondanks het lawaai in het klaslokaal concentreerde ze zich op het lezen van haar schrift.
records.back_translation: Despite the noise in the classroom, she concentrated on reading her notebook.

records.source_text: He wore the clown's hat despite its large size.
records.target_text: Hij droeg de clownshoed, ondanks de grote omvang.
records.back_translation: He wore the clown hat, despite its large size.

records.source_text: The duck following the turtle is walking across the bridge.
records.target_text: De eend die de schildpad volgt, loopt over de brug.
records.back_translation: The duck that follows the turtle walks over the bridge.

records.source_text: Bumping the table with my foot caused a book to fall.
records.target_text: Toen ik met mijn voet tegen de tafel stootte, viel er een boek op de grond.
records.back_translation: When I bumped my foot against the table, a book fell to the ground.

records.source_text: The person chases the dog that is big.
records.target_text: De persoon zit achter de hond aan die groot is.
records.back_translation: The person is chasing the dog that is big.

records.source_text: The girl wearing a backpack was shown a flower by her friend.
records.target_text: Het meisje met de rugzak kreeg van haar vriendin een bloem te zien.
records.back_translation: The girl with the backpack was shown a flower by her friend.

records.source_text: The kids cleaned the room, but forgot to put away the train.
records.target_text: De kinderen hebben de kamer opgeruimd, maar zijn vergeten de trein op te bergen.
records.back_translation: The children cleaned up the room, but forgot to put away the train.

records.source_text: The monkey neither ate the banana nor swung on the vine.
records.target_text: De aap at de banaan niet op en slingerde ook niet aan de liaan.
records.back_translation: The monkey did not eat the banana and also did not swing on the liana.

records.source_text: Her mom said it would be sunny. However, it rained heavily.
records.target_text: Haar moeder zei dat het zonnig zou zijn. Het regende echter hevig.
records.back_translation: Her mother said it would be sunny. However, it rained heavily.

records.source_text: The plane that is gray is above the clouds.
records.target_text: Het vliegtuig dat grijs is, is boven de wolken.
records.back_translation: The airplane that is gray is above the clouds.

records.source_text: The fish swim beneath a whale and a sea turtle.
records.target_text: De vissen zwemmen onder een walvis en een zeeschildpad.
records.back_translation: The fish swim under a whale and a sea turtle.

records.source_text: The car that the truck followed is driving toward the tunnel.
records.target_text: De auto die door de vrachtwagen werd gevolgd, rijdt richting de tunnel.
records.back_translation: The car that was followed by the truck drives towards the tunnel.

records.source_text: Instead of doing homework she did a puzzle in her room.
records.target_text: In plaats van huiswerk te maken, maakte ze een puzzel in haar kamer.
records.back_translation: Instead of doing her homework, she did a puzzle in her room.

records.source_text: yes
records.target_text: ja
records.back_translation: yes

records.source_text: no
records.target_text: nee
records.back_translation: no

records.source_text: happy
records.target_text: blij
records.back_translation: happy

records.source_text: sad
records.target_text: verdrietig
records.back_translation: sad

records.source_text: angry
records.target_text: boos
records.back_translation: angry

records.source_text: scared
records.target_text: bang
records.back_translation: afraid

records.source_text: calm
records.target_text: kalm
records.back_translation: calm

records.source_text: proud
records.target_text: trots
records.back_translation: proud

records.source_text: disgusted
records.target_text: walgend
records.back_translation: disgusting

records.source_text: surprised
records.target_text: verrast
records.back_translation: surprised

records.source_text: This is the Stories Game. In this game, you will listen to some stories. Then you will answer questions about the stories.
records.target_text: Dit is het verhalenspel. In dit spel luister je naar verhalen. Daarna beantwoord je vragen over de verhalen.
records.back_translation: This is the story game. In this game, you listen to stories. Afterwards, you answer questions about the stories.

records.source_text: Nice work! Here is a new story.
records.target_text: Goed gedaan! Hier is een nieuw verhaal.
records.back_translation: Well done! Here is a new story.

records.source_text: Here is Madison. This morning, Madison put her book behind the chair, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Hier is Madeleen. Vanmorgen legde Madeleen haar boek achter de stoel, omdat ze niet wilde dat iemand het zou vinden.
records.back_translation: Here is Madeleen. This morning Madeleen put her book behind the chair because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But when Madison was outside playing, someone did find it! And hid it under the rug.
records.target_text: Maar toen Madeleen buiten aan het spelen was, vond iemand het wel! En verstopte het onder het tapijt.
records.back_translation: But when Madeleen was playing outside, someone did find it! And hid it under the carpet.

records.source_text: So now it’s reading time and Madison wants her book.
records.target_text: Het is nu tijd om te lezen en Madeleen wil haar boek.
records.back_translation: It is now time to read and Madeleen wants her book.

records.source_text: Where will Madison look first for her book?
records.target_text: Waar zal Madeleen als eerste naar haar boek zoeken?
records.back_translation: Where will Madeleen look for her book first?

records.source_text: Behind the chair
records.target_text: Achter de stoel
records.back_translation: Behind the chair

records.source_text: Under the rug
records.target_text: Onder het tapijt
records.back_translation: Under the carpet

records.source_text: And where is her book really?
records.target_text: En waar is haar boek eigenlijk?
records.back_translation: And where is her book actually?

records.source_text: This morning when he came to school, Ethan put his book on the shelf above the coat hooks. Ethan’s book is blue!
records.target_text: Toen hij vanmorgen op school kwam, legde Edwin zijn boek op de plank boven de kapstok. Edwins boek is blauw!
records.back_translation: When he arrived at school this morning, Edwin placed his book on the shelf above the coat rack. Edwin's book is blue!

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Ethan playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Ethan’s book fell down from above the coat hooks onto the floor under the coats, see?
records.target_text: En toen ging hij naar buiten om te spelen, zie je? Hier is Edwin buiten aan het spelen. En terwijl hij buiten aan het spelen was, viel Edwins boek van boven de kapstok op de grond onder de jassen, zie je?
records.back_translation: And then he went outside to play, you see? Here's Edwin playing outside. And while he was playing outside, Edwin's book fell from above the coat rack to the floor under the coats, you see?

records.source_text: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book up above the coat hooks. Hannah's book is also blue! Ethan is still outside playing, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.
records.target_text: Dan komt Hannah binnen en Hannah legt haar boek boven de kapstok. Hannahs boek is ook blauw! Edwin is nog buiten aan het spelen, dus hij zag niet wat Hannah aan het doen was.
records.back_translation: Then Hannah comes in and Hannah puts her book above the coat rack. Hannah's book is also blue! Edwin is still playing outside, so he didn't see what Hannah was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Ethan comes in from outside, where will he look first for his book?
records.target_text: Dus, als Edwin van buiten binnenkomt, waar zal hij dan als eerste naar zijn boek zoeken?
records.back_translation: So, if Edwin comes in from outside, where will he look for his book first?

records.source_text: On the shelf
records.target_text: Op de plank
records.back_translation: On the shelf

records.source_text: Under the coats
records.target_text: Onder de jassen
records.back_translation: Under the jackets

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Ethan reaching for this book up on the shelf. And now Hannah sees Ethan reaching for that book... the book that is Hannah's!
records.target_text: Laten we eens kijken wat hij doet. Oh kijk, hier is Edwin die dit boek op de plank wil pakken. En nu ziet Hannah dat Edwin dat boek wil pakken... het boek dat van Hannah is!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh look, here's Edwin who wants to grab this book from the shelf. And now Hannah sees that Edwin wants to grab that book... the book that belongs to Hannah!

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah feels about Ethan reaching for that book?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Hannah zich voelt over dat Edwin dat boek pakt?
records.back_translation: How do you think Hannah feels about Edwin taking that book?

records.source_text: How do you think Hannah would feel if she had not seen Ethan reaching for the book?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Hannah zich zou voelen, als ze niet had gezien dat Edwin het boek pakte?
records.back_translation: How do you think Hannah would feel if she hadn't seen Edwin take the book?

records.source_text: Is Ethan being mean and naughty for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Is Edwin gemeen en ondeugend, omdat hij Hannahs boek heeft meegenomen?
records.back_translation: Is Edwin mean and naughty because he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Should Ethan get in trouble with the teacher for taking Hannah's book?
records.target_text: Zou Edwin op zijn kop moeten krijgen van de leraar, omdat hij Hannahs boek heeft meegenomen?
records.back_translation: Should Edwin get a scolding from the teacher because he took Hannah's book?

records.source_text: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kan jij Hannah helpen haar boek te vinden? Ligt op de plank of onder de jassen?
records.back_translation: Can you help Hannah find her book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Can you help Ethan find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?
records.target_text: Kan jij Edwin helpen zijn boek te vinden? Ligt het op de plank of onder de jassen?
records.back_translation: Can you help Edwin find his book? Is it on the shelf or under the coats?

records.source_text: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Joshua, Isabel en Ivan spelen een spelletje. Zo gaat het spelletje: Een kind verstopt zich, maar tekent een aanwijzing in de zandbak, zodat de andere kinderen hem/haar kunnen vinden.
records.back_translation: Joshua, Isabel, and Ivan are playing a game. This is how the game works: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so that the other children can find him/her.

records.source_text: So Ivan is going first. He draws this clue in the sandbox, and then he goes to hide.
records.target_text: Dus Ivan gaat als eerste. Hij tekent deze aanwijzing in de zandbak en gaat zich dan verstoppen.
records.back_translation: So Ivan goes first. He draws this clue in the sandbox and then goes to hide.

records.source_text: Now it's Joshua's turn to leave a clue, and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.
records.target_text: Nu is het Jips beurt om een aanwijzing achter te laten en zich te verstoppen. Isabel en Ivan zullen dan proberen de aanwijzing te gebruiken om hem te vinden.
records.back_translation: Now it's Jip's turn to leave a clue and hide. Isabel and Ivan will then try to use the clue to find him.

records.source_text: Joshua decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Joshua goes and hides behind the fountain.
records.target_text: Jip besluit zich achter de fontein te verstoppen. Hij tekent een aanwijzing in het zand. Hij probeert de fontein te tekenen, met het onderste gedeelte en het water dat eruit komt. Maar de tekening lijkt in plaats daarvan op een boom! Dan gaat Jip zich verstoppen achter de fontein.
records.back_translation: Jip decides to hide behind the fountain. He draws a clue in the sand. He tries to draw the fountain, with the bottom part and the water coming out of it. But the drawing looks like a tree instead! Then Jip goes to hide behind the fountain.

records.source_text: What did Joshua mean to draw?
records.target_text: Wat wilde Jip tekenen?
records.back_translation: What did Jip want to draw?

records.source_text: A fountain
records.target_text: Een fontein
records.back_translation: A fountain

records.source_text: A tree
records.target_text: Een boom
records.back_translation: A tree

records.source_text: When Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look first for Joshua?
records.target_text: Als Isabel en Ivan deze aanwijzing zien, waar zullen ze  dan als eerste naar Jip zoeken?
records.back_translation: If Isabel and Ivan see this clue, where will they look for Jip first?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Joshua really is?
records.target_text: Kun jij ze helpen ontdekken waar Jip werkelijk is?
records.back_translation: Can you help them discover where Jip really is?

records.source_text: Behind the fountain
records.target_text: Achter de fontein
records.back_translation: Behind the fountain

records.source_text: Behind the tree
records.target_text: Achter de boom
records.back_translation: Behind the tree

records.source_text: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Joshua, and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?
records.target_text: Kijk, Isabel en Ivan hebben Jip gevonden en het spel gewonnen! Hoe denk je dat Isabel zich voelt over het winnen van het spel?
records.back_translation: Look, Isabel and Ivan found Jip and won the game! How do you think Isabel feels about winning the game?

records.source_text: Now the games are over, and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the kids to find all of their toys.
records.target_text: Nu zijn de spelletjes afgelopen en is het bijna tijd om naar huis te gaan. Moeder zegt tegen de kinderen dat ze al hun speelgoed moeten verzamelen.
records.back_translation: Now the games are over and it's almost time to go home. Mother tells the children to collect all their toys.

records.source_text: Joshua brought his toy truck with him to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere but he can't find it.
records.target_text: Joshua heeft zijn speelgoedvrachtwagen meegenomen naar het park, maar nu kan hij hem niet vinden. Hij zoekt overal, maar hij kan hem niet vinden.
records.back_translation: Joshua took his toy truck to the park, but now he can't find it. He's looking everywhere, but he can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Joshua feel about losing his truck?
records.target_text: Hoe voelt Jip zich over het kwijtraken van zijn vrachtwagen?
records.back_translation: How does Jip feel about losing his truck?

records.source_text: How would Joshua feel if he found his truck?
records.target_text: Hoe zou Jip zich voelen als hij zijn vrachtwagen zou vinden?
records.back_translation: How would Jip feel if he found his truck?

records.source_text: Joshua can't find his truck because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.
records.target_text: Jip kan zijn vrachtwagen niet vinden, want eerder die dag, toen niemand keek, heeft Isabel de speelgoedvrachtwagen gepakt en in de zandbak begraven.
records.back_translation: Jip cannot find his truck, because earlier that day, when no one was looking, Isabel took the toy truck and buried it in the sandbox.

records.source_text: So Joshua looks everywhere and he can't find his toy truck. Mother gets mad at Joshua, because he lost his truck.
records.target_text: Dus Jip zoekt overal en hij kan zijn speelgoedvrachtwagen niet vinden. Moeder wordt boos op Jip, omdat hij zijn vrachtwagen kwijt is.
records.back_translation: So Jip looks everywhere and he cannot find his toy truck. Mother gets angry at Jip because he lost his truck.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Mother is mad at Joshua for losing his truck?
records.target_text: Is het eerlijk dat moeder boos is op Jip, omdat hij zijn vrachtwagen kwijt is?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that mother is angry with Jip because he lost his truck?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Is moeder boos op Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is mother angry with Isabel?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel?
records.target_text: Is Jip boos op Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Jip angry with Isabel?

records.source_text: When Isabel sees that Mother is mad at Joshua, she goes to the sandbox and digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Joshua.
records.target_text: Als Isabel ziet dat moeder boos is op Jip, gaat ze naar de zandbak, graaft de speelgoedvrachtwagen op en geeft hem terug aan Jip.
records.back_translation: When Isabel sees that mother is angry with Jip, she goes to the sandbox, digs up the toy truck, and gives it back to Jip.

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Joshua now?
records.target_text: Is moeder nu boos op Joshua?
records.back_translation: Is mother angry at Joshua now?

records.source_text: Is Mother mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Is moeder nu boos op Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Mom angry at Isabel now?

records.source_text: Is Joshua mad at Isabel now?
records.target_text: Is Jip nu boos op Isabel?
records.back_translation: Is Jip now angry at Isabel?

records.source_text: Isabel tells Joshua that she’s very sorry, and she gives him a big hug. Joshua gives her a big hug back, and Mother joins in.
records.target_text: Isabel vertelt Jip dat het haar heel erg spijt en ze geeft hem een dikke knuffel. Jip geeft haar een dikke knuffel terug en Moeder doet mee.
records.back_translation: Isabel tells Jip that she is very sorry and gives him a big hug. Jip gives her a big hug back and Mother joins in.

records.source_text: This is Katie. Earlier today, Katie's mom was cleaning the house, while Katie watched. Mom left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium sized cup on the table, and a big cup that she put away up high, on the shelf.
records.target_text: Dit is Kim. Eerder vandaag was Kims moeder het huis aan het schoonmaken, terwijl Kim toekeek. Moeder liet drie koppen in de keuken staan. Er staat een klein kopje op het aanrecht, een middelgrote beker op tafel en een grote beker die ze hoog op de plank heeft gezet.
records.back_translation: This is Kim. Earlier today, Kim's mother was cleaning the house while Kim watched. Mother left three cups in the kitchen. There is a small cup on the counter, a medium-sized mug on the table, and a large mug that she placed high on the shelf.

records.source_text: Katie and Dad just walked in and Katie asks her dad to get her a cup. Katie tells her Dad, “I want the big cup!”
records.target_text: Kim en papa komen net binnen, en Kim vraagt haar vader om een beker voor haar te halen. Kim zegt tegen haar vader: "Ik wil de grote beker!"
records.back_translation: Kim and Dad just came in, and Kim asks her father to get her a cup. Kim says to her father: "I want the big cup!"

records.source_text: Which cup will Dad give Katie?
records.target_text: Welke beker zal papa aan Kim geven?
records.back_translation: Which cup will Dad give to Kim?

records.source_text: Which cup does Katie want?
records.target_text: Welke beker wil Kim?
records.back_translation: Which cup does Kim want?

records.source_text: The small cup
records.target_text: Het kleine kopje
records.back_translation: The small cup

records.source_text: The medium sized cup
records.target_text: De middelgrote beker
records.back_translation: The medium-sized cup

records.source_text: The big cup
records.target_text: De grote beker
records.back_translation: The big cup

records.source_text: How does Katie feel about not getting the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Wat vindt Kim ervan dat ze niet de beker heeft gekregen die ze wilde?
records.back_translation: What does Kim think about not getting the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: How would Katie feel if she had received the cup she wanted?
records.target_text: Hoe zou Kim zich voelen als ze de beker had gekregen die ze wilde?
records.back_translation: How would Kim feel if she had received the cup she wanted?

records.source_text: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria tells Sam: “I am going to buy new shirts for us there,” and she walks away.
records.target_text: Sam en Maria spelen samen. Ze kijken naar buiten en zien een nieuwe winkel aan de overkant van de straat. Maria zegt tegen Sam: "Ik ga daar nieuwe T-shirts voor ons kopen," en ze loopt weg.
records.back_translation: Sam and Maria are playing together. They look outside and see a new shop across the street. Maria says to Sam: "I'm going to buy new T-shirts for us there," and she walks away.

records.source_text: Mom comes home and she tells Sam that she just walked by the shop. “Are they selling shirts?” Sam asks. “No,” Mom says, “They are only selling shoes”. “Maria will probably now get shoes at the shop,” Sam says.
records.target_text: Mama komt thuis en vertelt Sam dat ze net langs de winkel is gelopen. "Verkopen ze T-shirts?" vraagt Sam. "Nee," zegt mama, "Ze verkopen alleen schoenen." "Maria gaat nu waarschijnlijk schoenen kopen in de winkel," zegt Sam.
records.back_translation: Mom comes home and tells Sam that she just walked past the store. "Do they sell T-shirts?" asks Sam. "No," says Mom, "They only sell shoes." "Maria is probably going to buy shoes at the store now," says Sam.

records.source_text: Does Maria know that they are selling shoes in the shop?
records.target_text: Weet Maria dat er in de winkel schoenen worden verkocht?
records.back_translation: Does Maria know that shoes are sold in the shop?

records.source_text: Maria has arrived at the shop. “I would like to buy shirts,” she says. “All we have left are socks,” says the shopkeeper. Since Maria also needs socks, she decides to get some socks.
records.target_text: Maria is bij de winkel aangekomen. "Ik wil graag T-shirts kopen," zegt ze. "We hebben alleen nog sokken," zegt de winkelier. Omdat Maria ook sokken nodig heeft, besluit ze om sokken te nemen.
records.back_translation: Maria has arrived at the shop. "I would like to buy T-shirts," she says. "We only have socks left," says the shopkeeper. Because Maria also needs socks, she decides to take socks.

records.source_text: Does Sam know that Maria bought some socks?
records.target_text: Weet Sam dat Maria sokken heeft gekocht?
records.back_translation: Does Sam know that Maria bought socks?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Wat denkt Sam dat ze in de winkel verkopen?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?

records.source_text: Shoes
records.target_text: Schoenen
records.back_translation: Shoes

records.source_text: Socks
records.target_text: Sokken
records.back_translation: Socks

records.source_text: Shirts
records.target_text: T-shirts
records.back_translation: T-shirts

records.source_text:
On her way back, Maria meets her dad. She tells her dad: “I have just bought some socks. I am going to share them with my brother Sam. It is a surprise.”
“That is nice of you,” says Dad. Then he asks Maria: “Does Sam know what you bought him?”
records.target_text:
Op de terugweg ontmoet Maria haar vader. Ze vertelt haar vader: "Ik heb net wat sokken gekocht. Ik ga ze delen met mijn broer Sam. Het is een verrassing."
"Dat is aardig van je," zegt vader. Dan vraagt hij Maria: "Weet Sam wat je voor hem hebt gekocht?"
records.back_translation:
On the way back, Maria meets her father. She tells her father: "I just bought some socks. I'm going to share them with my brother Sam. It's a surprise."
"That's nice of you," says father. Then he asks Maria: "Does Sam know what you bought for him?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Wat zegt Maria tegen papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to dad?

records.source_text: Then Dad asks: “What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?”
records.target_text: Dan vraagt papa: "Wat denkt Sam dat ze in de winkel verkopen?"
records.back_translation: Then Dad asks: "What does Sam think they sell in the store?"

records.source_text: What does Maria tell Dad?
records.target_text: Wat zegt Maria tegen papa?
records.back_translation: What does Maria say to dad?

records.source_text: What does Sam think they are selling at the shop?
records.target_text: Wat denkt Sam dat ze in de winkel verkopen?
records.back_translation: What does Sam think they sell in the store?

records.source_text: Sam is very happy to get his new socks.
records.target_text: Sam is erg blij met zijn nieuwe sokken.
records.back_translation: Sam is very happy with his new socks.

records.source_text: Imagine that you are walking to school and you’re wearing your new shoes. You really like your new shoes and this is the first day you have worn them.
records.target_text: Stel je voor dat je naar school loopt en je draagt je nieuwe schoenen. Je bent echt dol op je nieuwe schoenen en dit is de eerste dag dat je ze draagt.
records.back_translation: Imagine you're walking to school and you're wearing your new shoes. You really love your new shoes and this is the first day you're wearing them.

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.
records.target_text: Opeens word je van achteren geduwd door een jongen. Je struikelt en valt in een modderplas en je nieuwe schoenen worden modderig.
records.back_translation: Suddenly you are pushed from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy bumped you on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Denk je dat de jongen je expres of per ongeluk heeft geduwd?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy pushed you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Imagine that you are on the playground. You and some other kids are having a race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.
records.target_text: Stel je voor dat je op de speelplaats bent. Jij en een paar andere kinderen doen een wedstrijdje rennen. Een jongen staat aan de kant en stuitert met een basketbal.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are on the playground. You and a few other children are having a running race. A boy is standing on the side, bouncing a basketball.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has bounced the ball and it has rolled under your feet, making you fall. You skin your knee and someone else wins the race.
records.target_text: Voor je het weet heeft de jongen de bal laten stuiteren en is de bal onder je voeten gerold, waardoor je bent gevallen. Je schaaft je knie en iemand anders wint de wedstrijd.
records.back_translation: Before you know it, the boy has bounced the ball and the ball has rolled under your feet, causing you to fall. You scrape your knee and someone else wins the match.

records.source_text: Do you think that the boy made you fall on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Denk je dat de jongen je expres liet vallen of per ongeluk?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy dropped you on purpose or by accident?

records.source_text: Now pick one of the three choices as the one you would do:
records.target_text: Kies nu een van de drie opties als datgene wat jij zou doen:
records.back_translation: Now choose one of the three options as what you would do:

records.source_text: go to another area of the playground
records.target_text: naar een ander deel van de speelplaats gaan
records.back_translation: go to another part of the playground

records.source_text: say something mean to him
records.target_text: iets gemeens tegen hem zeggen
records.back_translation: to say something mean to him

records.source_text: take care of my knee
records.target_text: voor mijn knie zorgen
records.back_translation: take care of my knee

records.source_text: Imagine that you are working on an assignment at your desk.
records.target_text: Stel je voor dat je aan je bureau aan een opdracht werkt.
records.back_translation: Imagine you are working on an assignment at your desk.

records.source_text: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk there is a boy walking just in front of you. The boy passes your desk before you get there.
records.target_text: Je gaat je potlood slijpen, en als je terugloopt naar je bureau, is er een jongen die vlak voor je loopt. De jongen loopt langs je bureau, voordat je er bent.
records.back_translation: You go to sharpen your pencil, and as you walk back to your desk, there's a boy walking right in front of you. The boy walks past your desk before you get there.

records.source_text: The next thing you know, the boy has knocked all of your papers off of your desk, and they are all over the floor.
records.target_text: Voor je het weet, heeft de jongen al je papieren van je bureau gestoten en liggen ze overal op de vloer.
records.back_translation: Before you know it, the boy has already knocked all your papers off your desk and they are everywhere on the floor.

records.source_text: Do you think the boy knocked your papers onto the floor on purpose or by accident?
records.target_text: Denk je dat de jongen jouw papieren expres of per ongeluk op de grond heeft laten vallen?
records.back_translation: Do you think the boy dropped your papers on the floor on purpose or by accident?

records.target_text: Kies nu een van de drie opties als datgene wat jij zou doen:

records.back_translation: This is the matching game. In this game, you will choose sets of cards that match each other in a certain way. Let's first look at some of the cards you will see.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see two cards that are the same in one way. Then you will see a new card that is similar to one of those cards. Your job is to choose the card that is similar to the new card.

records.back_translation: Now you will see two cards that are the same in one way. Then you will see a new card that resembles one of those cards. Your task is to choose the card that resembles the new card.

records.source_text: Now you're going to see three cards, and you're going to choose two that are the same in some way. Then you're going to see the same cards again, and pick two cards that are the same in a different way.
records.target_text: Nu ga je drie kaarten zien, en je gaat er twee kiezen die op een bepaalde manier hetzelfde zijn. Dan ga je dezelfde kaarten weer zien, en je kiest er twee die op een andere manier hetzelfde zijn.
records.back_translation: Now you're going to see three cards, and you're going to choose two that are the same in a certain way. Then you're going to see the same cards again, and you choose two that are the same in a different way.

records.source_text: Here are two cards. These cards are the same in one way. They are both circles.
records.target_text: Hier zijn twee kaarten. Iets is hetzelfde. Ze hebben allebei cirkels.
records.back_translation: Here are two cards. Something is the same. They both have circles.

records.target_text: Hier zijn twee kaarten. Iets is hetzelfde. Ze hebben allebei vierkanten.

records.source_text: This is the memory game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Dit is het geheugenspel. Zo speel je het.
records.back_translation: This is the memory game. This is how you play it.

records.source_text: You will see squares light up.
records.target_text: Je zal de vierkanten zien oplichten.
records.back_translation: You will see the squares light up.

records.source_text: You're going to choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Je gaat de vierkanten in dezelfde volgorde kiezen.
records.back_translation: You are going to choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: Watch carefully! Try to remember the order.
records.target_text: Let goed op! Probeer de volgorde te onthouden.

records.source_text: Choose the squares in the same order.
records.target_text: Kies de vierkanten in dezelfde volgorde.
records.back_translation: Choose the squares in the same order.

records.target_text: Dat is niet helemaal juist. Probeer het opnieuw. Kies de vierkanten in dezelfde volgorde.
records.back_translation: That's not entirely correct. Try again. Choose the squares in the same order.

records.source_text: This time the game won't tell you if you're right or wrong. Let’s start playing the memory game!
records.target_text: Deze keer laat het spel je niet weten of je goed of fout zit. Laten we het geheugenspel spelen!
records.back_translation: This time the game doesn't let you know if you're right or wrong. Let's play the memory game!

records.source_text: Now let's play the memory game backwards!
records.target_text: Laten we het geheugenspel nu omgekeerd spelen!

records.target_text: Laten we beginnen met het geheugenspel!
records.back_translation: Let's start with the memory game!

records.target_text: Dat is niet helemaal juist. Probeer het opnieuw. Kies de vakken in omgekeerde volgorde.
records.back_translation: That is not entirely correct. Try again. Choose the boxes in reverse order.

records.source_text: This is the heart game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Dit is het hartjesspel. Zo speel je het.
records.back_translation: This is the heart game. This is how you play it.

records.source_text: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.
records.target_text: Wanneer je een hartje ziet, druk je op de knop aan dezelfde kant.
records.back_translation: When you see a heart, press the button on the same side.

records.source_text: That's not quite right. Please try again.
records.target_text: Dat is niet helemaal juist. Probeer het opnieuw.
records.back_translation: That is not entirely correct. Try again.

records.source_text: The heart is on the right side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: Het hartje is aan de rechterkant. Druk op de juiste knop.
records.back_translation: The little heart is on the right side. Press the correct button.

records.source_text: Time to practice!
records.target_text: Tijd om te oefenen!
records.back_translation: Time to practice!

records.source_text: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on the SAME side.
records.target_text: Onthoud! Wanneer je een HARTJE ziet, druk dan op de knop aan DEZELFDE kant.
records.back_translation: Remember! When you see a HEART, press the button on THE SAME side.

records.source_text: This time the game will go faster. It won't tell you if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Deze keer gaat het spel sneller. Het laat je niet weten of je goed of fout zit. Probeer bij te blijven!
records.back_translation: This time the game goes faster. It doesn't let you know if you are right or wrong. Try to keep up!

records.source_text: Try to answer as fast as you can without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Probeer zo snel mogelijk te antwoorden zonder fouten te maken. Als je een fout maakt, ga dan gewoon door!
records.back_translation: Try to answer as quickly as possible without making mistakes. If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Time to play!
records.target_text: Tijd om te spelen!
records.back_translation: Time to play!

records.source_text: This is the flower game. Here's how you play it.
records.target_text: Dit is het bloemenspel. Zo speel je het.
records.back_translation: This is the flower game. This is how you play it.

records.source_text: When you see a flower, press the button on the other side.
records.target_text: Wanneer je een bloem ziet, druk je op de knop aan de andere kant.
records.back_translation: When you see a flower, you press the button on the other side.

records.source_text: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.
records.target_text: De bloem is aan de linkerkant. Druk op de rechterknop.
records.back_translation: The flower is on the left side. Press the right button.

records.source_text: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OTHER side.
records.target_text: Wanneer je een BLOEM ziet, druk dan op de knop aan de TEGENOVERGESTELDE kant.
records.back_translation: When you see a FLOWER, press the button on the OPPOSITE side.

records.source_text: Now, we're going to play a game with hearts and flowers.
records.target_text: Nu gaan we een spelletje doen met hartjes en bloemen.
records.back_translation: Now we are going to play a game with hearts and flowers.

records.source_text: Try to keep up!
records.target_text: Probeer bij te blijven!
records.back_translation: Try to keep up!

records.source_text: If you make a mistake, just keep going!
records.target_text: Als je een fout maakt, ga dan gewoon door!
records.back_translation: If you make a mistake, just keep going!

records.source_text: Great job! You completed the game!
records.target_text: Goed gedaan! Je hebt het spel uitgespeeld!
records.back_translation: Well done! You have finished the game!
