records.source_text: In this game, you are going to listen to words and look at different pictures. Your job is to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: In dit spel ga je naar woorden luisteren en naar verschillende plaatjes kijken. Jouw taak is om het plaatje te kiezen dat bij het woord past!
records.back_translation: In this game, you will listen to words and look at different pictures. Your task is to choose the picture that matches the word!

records.source_text: You are going to see some different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then, you'll hear a word for one of the pictures. Make sure to pick the picture that matches the word!
records.target_text: Je gaat een aantal verschillende plaatjes zien. Bijvoorbeeld een plaatje van een appel en een plaatje van een wortel. Dan hoor je een woord voor een van de plaatjes. Zorg ervoor dat je het plaatje kiest dat bij het woord past!
records.back_translation: You are going to see a number of different pictures. For example, a picture of an apple and a picture of a carrot. Then you will hear a word for one of the pictures. Make sure you choose the picture that matches the word!

records.source_text: Some words are hard, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just give your best guess!
records.target_text: Sommige woorden zijn moeilijk, en dat is oké. Als je het niet zeker weet, doe dan gewoon een gok!
records.back_translation: Some words are difficult, and that's okay. If you're not sure, just take a guess!

records.source_text: If you need to hear the word again, press the speaker button.
records.target_text: Als je het woord nogmaals wil horen, druk dan op de luidsprekerknop.
records.back_translation: If you want to hear the word again, press the speaker button.

records.source_text: You can tap on a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Try it now.
records.target_text: Je kunt op een touchscreen tikken, het touchpad gebruiken of op de pijltjestoetsen drukken voor deze activiteit. Probeer het maar.
records.back_translation: You can tap on a touchscreen, use the touchpad, or press the arrow keys for this activity. Just try it.

records.source_text: To use an arrow key to choose a picture, press the key that points the same direction as the arrow below the picture.
records.target_text: Om een pijltjestoets te gebruiken om een plaatje te kiezen, druk je op de toets die in dezelfde richting wijst als de pijl onder het plaatje.
records.back_translation: To use an arrow key to choose an image, press the key that points in the same direction as the arrow below the image.

records.source_text: You can press the replay button to hear things again. Try it now.
records.target_text: Je kunt op de herhalingsknop drukken om het nog eens te horen. Probeer het nu.
records.back_translation: You can press the repeat button to hear it again. Try it now.

records.source_text: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say, then look at the pictures carefully. Choose the picture that goes with the words you hear.
records.target_text: Dit is een matching activiteit. Luister naar wat ik zeg en bekijk de plaatjes dan aandachtig. Kies het plaatje dat bij de woorden past die je hoort.
records.back_translation: This is a matching activity. Listen to what I say and then look carefully at the pictures. Choose the picture that matches the words you hear.

records.source_text: These questions ask you about how you feel at school and some of the things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time. The first two are for practice.
records.target_text: Deze vragen gaan over hoe jij je op school voelt en over een aantal dingen die je op school doet. Er zijn geen goede of foute antwoorden. Kies het antwoord dat het beste beschrijft wat je denkt. Nee, nooit; Ja, soms; Ja, meestal; Ja, altijd. De eerste twee zijn om te oefenen.
records.back_translation: These questions are about how you feel at school and about some things you do at school. There are no right or wrong answers. Choose the answer that best describes what you think. No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, usually; Yes, always. The first two are for practice.

records.source_text: Do you like to read comic books?
records.target_text: Lees je graag stripboeken?
records.back_translation: Do you like reading comic books?

records.source_text: Are you neat and tidy at school?
records.target_text: Ben jij netjes en opgeruimd op school?
records.back_translation: Are you neat and tidy at school?

records.source_text: Is your teacher nice to you?
records.target_text: Is je leraar aardig tegen je?
records.back_translation: Is your teacher nice to you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher like you?
records.target_text: Vindt jouw leraar je aardig?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher like you?

records.source_text: Does your teacher listen to you?
records.target_text: Luistert jouw leraar naar jou?
records.back_translation: Does your teacher listen to you?

records.source_text: Is school fun?
records.target_text: Is school leuk?
records.back_translation: Is school fun?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy school?
records.target_text: Vind je school leuk?
records.back_translation: Do you like school?

records.source_text: Are you happy at school?
records.target_text: Ben je blij op school?
records.back_translation: Are you happy at school?

records.source_text: Do you feel safe at school?
records.target_text: Voel jij je veilig op school?
records.back_translation: Do you feel safe at school?

records.source_text: Do you have friends in your class?
records.target_text: Heb je vrienden in je klas?
records.back_translation: Do you have friends in your class?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class help you when you need it?
records.target_text: Helpen de kinderen in jouw klas jou als dat nodig is?
records.back_translation: Do the children in your class help you when needed?

records.source_text: Do the kids in your class play with you?
records.target_text: Spelen de kinderen in jouw klas met jou?
records.back_translation: Do the children in your class play with you?

records.source_text: Are the kids in your class nice to you?
records.target_text: Zijn de kinderen in jouw klas aardig tegen je?
records.back_translation: Are the children in your class nice to you?

records.source_text: Do you feel lonely at school?
records.target_text: Voel jij je eenzaam op school?
records.back_translation: Do you feel lonely at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at learning things in school?
records.target_text: Ben je goed in het leren op school?
records.back_translation: Are you good at learning at school?

records.source_text: When schoolwork is hard, do you give up right away?
records.target_text: Geef je meteen op als schoolwerk moeilijk is?
records.back_translation: Do you immediately give up when schoolwork is difficult?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing reading activities at school?
records.target_text: Vind je het leuk om leesactiviteiten op school te doen?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing reading activities at school?

records.source_text: Do you enjoy doing math activities at school?
records.target_text: Vind je het leuk om rekenactiviteiten op school te doen?
records.back_translation: Do you like doing math activities at school?

records.source_text: Are you good at reading?
records.target_text: Ben je goed in lezen?
records.back_translation: Are you good at reading?

records.source_text: Are you good at math?
records.target_text: Ben jij goed in rekenen?
records.back_translation: Are you good at math?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get smarter if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get smarter if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Sommige kinderen denken dat ze slimmer kunnen worden als ze heel hard werken. Denk jij dat je slimmer kunt worden als je heel hard werkt?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can become smarter if they work very hard. Do you think you can become smarter if you work very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at reading if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at reading if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Sommige kinderen denken dat ze beter kunnen worden in lezen als ze heel hard werken. Denk jij dat je beter kunt worden in lezen als je heel hard werkt?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can get better at reading if they work very hard. Do you think you can get better at reading if you work very hard?

records.source_text: Some kids think they can get better at math if they work really hard. Do you think that you can get better at math if you work really hard?
records.target_text: Sommige kinderen denken dat ze beter kunnen worden in rekenen als ze heel hard werken. Denk jij dat je beter kunt worden in rekenen als je heel hard werkt?
records.back_translation: Some children think they can get better at math if they work very hard. Do you think you can get better at math if you work very hard?

records.source_text: No, never; Yes, some of the time; Yes, most of the time; Yes, all of the time
records.target_text: Nee, nooit; Ja, soms; Ja, meestal; Ja, altijd
records.back_translation: No, never; Yes, sometimes; Yes, usually; Yes, always

records.source_text: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer, because she didn’t want anyone to find it.
records.target_text: Hier is Diana. Vanmorgen op school legde Diana haar speelgoed in deze la, omdat ze niet wilde dat iemand het zou vinden.
records.back_translation: Here is Diana. This morning at school, Diana put her toy in this drawer because she didn't want anyone to find it.

records.source_text: But while Diana was outside, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer, to inside the desk.
records.target_text: Maar terwijl Diana buiten was, vond iemand het wel! En verplaatste het van in de la naar  in het bureau.
records.back_translation: But while Diana was out, someone did find it! And moved it from inside the drawer to inside the desk.

records.source_text: So now it’s playtime and Diana wants her toy.
records.target_text: Nu is het tijd om te spelen en Diana wil haar speelgoed.
records.back_translation: Now it's time to play and Diana wants her toy.

records.source_text: Where will Diana look for her toy?
records.target_text: Waar zal Diana haar speelgoed zoeken?
records.back_translation: Where will Diana look for her toy?

records.source_text: And where is her toy really?
records.target_text: En waar is haar speelgoed eigenlijk?
records.back_translation: And where is her toy, actually?

records.source_text: In the desk
records.target_text: In het bureau
records.back_translation: In the office

records.source_text: In the drawer
records.target_text: In de la
records.back_translation: In the drawer

records.source_text: This morning when she came to school, Allie put her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.
records.target_text: Toen Anouk vanmorgen op school kwam, legde ze haar gele potlood op deze plank, boven de rugzakplank.
records.back_translation: When Anouk arrived at school this morning, she placed her yellow pencil on this shelf, above the backpack shelf.

records.source_text: And then she went outside to play, see? Here’s Allie playing outside. And while she was outside playing, Allie’s yellow pencil fell down from on top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, see?
records.target_text: En toen ging ze naar buiten om te spelen, zie je? Hier is Anouk buiten aan het spelen. En terwijl ze buiten aan het spelen was, viel Anouks gele potlood van boven op de plank naar achter de rugzakplank, zie je?
records.back_translation: And then she went outside to play, you see? Here's Anouk playing outside. And while she was playing outside, Anouk's yellow pencil fell from the top of the shelf to behind the backpack shelf, you see?

records.source_text: Then Mike comes in, and Mike puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Mike’s pencil is also yellow! But Allie is still outside playing, so she didn’t see what Mike was doing.
records.target_text: Dan komt Milan binnen, en Milan legt zijn potlood boven de rugzakkenplank. Milans potlood is ook geel! Maar Anouk is nog steeds buiten aan het spelen, dus ze zag niet wat Milan deed.
records.back_translation: Then Milan comes in, and Milan puts his pencil above the backpack shelf. Milan's pencil is also yellow! But Anouk is still playing outside, so she didn't see what Milan did.

records.source_text: Now, when Allie comes in from outside, where will she look first for her pencil?
records.target_text: Als Anouk van buiten binnenkomt, waar zal ze dan als eerste haar potlood zoeken?
records.back_translation: When Anouk comes inside from outside, where will she look for her pencil first?

records.source_text: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Bovenop de plank boven de rugzakplank
records.back_translation: On top of the shelf above the backpack shelf

records.source_text: Behind the backpack shelf
records.target_text: Achter de rugzakkenplank
records.back_translation: Behind the backpack shelf

records.source_text: Let’s see what she does. Oh look, here is Allie reaching for this pencil up on top of the shelf. And now Mike sees Allie reaching for that pencil... the pencil that is Mike's!
records.target_text: Laten we eens kijken wat ze doet. Oh kijk, hier is Anouk die dit potlood op de plank wil pakken. En nu ziet Milan dat Anouk dat potlood wil pakken... het potlood dat van Milan is!
records.back_translation: Let's see what she's doing. Oh look, here's Anouk who wants to grab this pencil from the shelf. And now Milan sees that Anouk wants to grab that pencil... the pencil that belongs to Milan!

records.source_text: How do you think Mike feels about Allie reaching for that pencil?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Milan zich voelt over dat Anouk dat potlood pakt?
records.back_translation: How do you think Milan feels about Anouk taking that pencil?

records.source_text: How do you think Mike would feel if he had not seen Allie reaching for the pencil?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Milan zich zou hebben gevoeld als hij niet had gezien dat Anouk het potlood pakte?
records.back_translation: How do you think Milan would have felt if he hadn't seen Anouk pick up the pencil?

records.source_text: Is Allie being mean and naughty for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Is Anouk gemeen en ondeugend omdat ze Milans potlood heeft gepakt?
records.back_translation: Is Anouk mean and naughty because she took Milan's pencil?

records.source_text: Should Allie get in trouble with the teacher for taking Mike’s pencil?
records.target_text: Moet Anouk op haar kop krijgen van de leraar omdat ze Milans potlood heeft gepakt?
records.back_translation: Should Anouk get a telling-off from the teacher because she took Milan's pencil?

records.source_text: Can you help Mike find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Kun je Milan helpen zijn potlood te vinden? Is het bovenop de plank of achter de rugzakkenplank?
records.back_translation: Can you help Milan find his pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: Can you help Allie find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?
records.target_text: Kun je Anouk helpen haar potlood te vinden? Is het bovenop de plank of achter de rugzakkenplank?
records.back_translation: Can you help Anouk find her pencil? Is it on top of the shelf or behind the backpack shelf?

records.source_text: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.
records.target_text: Dit is Mark. Mark speelt vandaag een heel lollig spelletje en zegt de hele dag geen woord. In plaats daarvan tekent Mark plaatjes. Mark is in de bibliotheek aan het kiezen welk boek hij wil lezen. Moeder laat Mark twee boeken zien, een boek over kopjes en een boek over heuvels.
records.back_translation: This is Mark. Mark is playing a very funny game today and won't say a word all day. Instead, Mark draws pictures. Mark is in the library choosing which book he wants to read. Mother shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.

records.source_text: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside-down, so that it looks like a cup!
records.target_text: Mark tekent een plaatje van een heuvel, om mama te vertellen dat hij het boek over heuvels wil lezen. Maar als Mark mama het plaatje geeft, houdt ze het ondersteboven, waardoor het op een kopje lijkt!
records.back_translation: Mark draws a picture of a hill, to tell Mom that he wants to read the book about hills. But when Mark gives Mom the picture, she holds it upside down, making it look like a cup!

records.source_text: What did Mark mean to draw?
records.target_text: Wat wilde Mark tekenen?
records.back_translation: What did Mark want to draw?

records.source_text: A hill
records.target_text: Een heuvel
records.back_translation: A hill

records.source_text: A cup
records.target_text: Een kopje
records.back_translation: A cup

records.source_text: When Mom sees the picture, what book will she give Mark?
records.target_text: Welk boek zal mama aan Mark geven als ze het plaatje ziet?
records.back_translation: Which book will Mom give to Mark when she sees the picture?

records.source_text: What book does Mark really want?
records.target_text: Welk boek wil Mark echt?
records.back_translation: Which book does Mark really want?

records.source_text: The book about hills
records.target_text: Het boek over heuvels
records.back_translation: The book about hills

records.source_text: The book about cups
records.target_text: Het boek over kopjes
records.back_translation: The book about cups

records.source_text: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?
records.target_text: Kijk, mama zag haar fout in en gaf Mark het boek dat hij echt wilde! Hoe denk je dat Mark zich voelt over het krijgen van het boek dat hij wilde?
records.back_translation: Look, Mom realized her mistake and gave Mark the book he really wanted! How do you think Mark feels about getting the book he wanted?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah tells all of the kids to take one storybook from the bag that she brought. There is one storybook for every kid.
records.target_text: Juf Sarah vraagt alle kinderen om een verhalenboek uit de tas te halen die ze heeft meegebracht. Er is één verhalenboek voor elk kind.
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks all the children to take a storybook from the bag she has brought. There is one storybook for each child.

records.source_text: Now there are two storybooks left, and Brian and Megan are the last two kids without storybooks. But when Brian goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows that Megan doesn’t have a storybook yet, and that everyone is only supposed to have one. Brian hides the extra storybook in his desk.
records.target_text: Nu zijn er nog twee verhalenboeken over, en Bram en Marije zijn de laatste twee kinderen zonder verhalenboeken. Maar als Bram zijn verhalenboek gaat halen, besluit hij beide verhalenboeken te nemen, ook al weet hij dat Marije nog geen verhalenboek heeft, en dat iedereen er maar één zou moeten hebben. Bram verstopt het extra verhalenboek in zijn bureau.
records.back_translation: Now there are two storybooks left, and Bram and Marije are the last two children without storybooks. But when Bram goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows Marije doesn't have a storybook yet, and that everyone should only have one. Bram hides the extra storybook in his desk.

records.source_text: How does Megan feel about being the only child without a storybook?
records.target_text: Nu zijn er nog twee verhalenboeken over, en Bram en Marije zijn de laatste twee kinderen zonder verhalenboeken. Maar als Bram zijn verhalenboek gaat halen, besluit hij beide verhalenboeken te nemen, ook al weet hij dat Marije nog geen verhalenboek heeft en dat iedereen er maar één zou moeten hebben. Bram verstopt het extra verhalenboek in zijn bureau.
records.explanation: The translation is a complete mismatch to the source text. It describes a different scenario with different characters, rather than asking about Megan's feelings.
records.suggested_fix: Hoe voelt Megan zich, omdat zij het enige kind is zonder verhalenboek?
records.back_translation: Now there are two storybooks left, and Bram and Marije are the last two children without storybooks. But when Bram goes to get his storybook, he decides to take both storybooks, even though he knows Marije doesn't have a storybook yet and that everyone should only have one. Bram hides the extra storybook in his desk.

records.source_text: How would Megan feel if she received a book?
records.target_text: Hoe zou Marije zich voelen als ze een boek zou krijgen?
records.back_translation: How would Marije feel if she received a book?

records.source_text: Teacher Sarah asks Brian, “Is there a storybook leftover, so Megan can have one?” Brian tells Teacher Sarah, “No, there is no storybook left. They are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Juf Sarah vraagt aan Bram: "Is er een nog verhalenboek over, zodat Marije er één kan hebben?" Bram vertelt aan juf Sarah: "Nee, er is geen verhalenboek over. Ze worden allemaal gebruikt op dit moment."
records.back_translation: Teacher Sarah asks Bram: "Is there a storybook left over, so Marije can have one?" Bram tells Teacher Sarah: "No, there isn't a storybook left over. They are all being used at the moment."

records.source_text: Is Brian lying?
records.target_text: Liegt Bram?
records.back_translation: Is Bram lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Is er nog een verhalenboek over dat op dit moment niet gebruikt wordt?
records.back_translation: Is there another storybook about that is not being used at the moment?

records.source_text: Megan is sad that she doesn’t have a storybook, and asks Teacher Sarah, "is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says, “I’m so sorry Megan, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used right now.”
records.target_text: Marije is verdrietig dat ze geen verhalenboek heeft en vraagt aan juf Sarah: "Is er een extra verhalenboek voor mij?" Juf Sarah zegt: "Het spijt me zo, Marije, maar er zijn geen verhalenboeken meer over, ze worden allemaal op dit moment gebruikt."
records.back_translation: Marije is sad that she doesn't have a storybook and asks Teacher Sarah: "Is there an extra storybook for me?" Teacher Sarah says: "I'm so sorry, Marije, but there are no storybooks left, they are all being used at the moment."

records.source_text: Is Teacher Sarah lying?
records.target_text: Liegt juf Sarah?
records.back_translation: Is teacher Sarah lying?

records.source_text: Is there still a storybook left, that isn’t being used right now?
records.target_text: Is er nog een verhalenboek over dat op dit moment niet gebruikt wordt?
records.back_translation: Is there another storybook about that is not currently being used?

records.source_text: This is Josh. Earlier today, Josh was tidying his room. Josh put his big basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball down on the bottom shelf.
records.target_text: Dit is Joost. Eerder vandaag was Joost zijn kamer aan het opruimen. Joost legde zijn grote basketbal op zijn bureau, zijn middelgrote voetbal op zijn tafel en zijn kleine honkbal op de onderste plank.
records.back_translation: This is Joost. Earlier today, Joost was cleaning his room. Joost placed his large basketball on his desk, his medium-sized soccer ball on his table, and his small baseball on the bottom shelf.

records.source_text: Josh’s mom just walked in and Josh asks his mom to get one of the toys. Josh tells his mom, “I want the small ball!”
records.target_text: Joost zijn moeder komt net binnen en Joost vraagt zijn moeder om iets van het speelgoed te pakken. Joost zegt tegen zijn moeder: "Ik wil de kleine bal!"
records.back_translation: Joost's mother just came in and Joost asks his mother to grab some of the toys. Joost says to his mother: "I want the small ball!"

records.source_text: Which ball will mom get for Josh?
records.target_text: Welke bal zal mama voor Joost pakken?
records.back_translation: Which ball will Mom get for Joost?

records.source_text: Which ball does Josh want?
records.target_text: Welke bal wil Joost?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Joost want?

records.source_text: The small baseball
records.target_text: De kleine honkbal
records.back_translation: The little baseball

records.source_text: The medium sized soccer ball
records.target_text: De middelgrote voetbal
records.back_translation: The medium-sized football

records.source_text: The big basketball
records.target_text: De grote basketbal
records.back_translation: The big basketball

records.source_text: Josh wanted the baseball but mom gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Josh feels about receiving the wrong toy?
records.target_text: Joost wilde de honkbal, maar zijn moeder gaf hem de voetbal! Hoe denk je dat Joost zich voelt over het krijgen van het verkeerde speelgoed?
records.back_translation: Joost wanted the baseball, but his mother gave him the soccer ball! How do you think Joost feels about getting the wrong toy?

records.source_text: How do you think Josh would feel if he had received the correct toy?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Joost zich zou voelen als hij het juiste speelgoed had gekregen?
records.back_translation: How do you think Joost would feel if he had received the right toy?

records.source_text: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she would like to take to school, and Emma told him that she would like to play with her yellow ball at recess.
records.target_text: Vanmorgen vroeg papa aan Emma welk speelgoed ze mee naar school wilde nemen, en Emma zei tegen hem dat ze tijdens de pauze met haar gele bal wilde spelen.
records.back_translation: This morning, Dad asked Emma what toy she wanted to take to school, and Emma told him that she wanted to play with her yellow ball during recess.

records.source_text: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind, so she yelled to her dad, “Actually, may I please have my red ball instead?” and kept getting ready for school. But Dad did not hear Emma ask for her red ball.
records.target_text: Toen ging Emma naar haar kamer om zich klaar te maken voor school. Terwijl ze zich aan het klaarmaken was, bedacht ze zich, dus riep ze naar haar vader: "Mag ik in plaats van mijn gele alsjeblieft mijn rode bal?" en bleef zich klaarmaken voor school. Maar vader hoorde Emma niet om haar rode bal vragen.
records.back_translation: Then Emma went to her room to get ready for school. While she was getting ready, she changed her mind, so she called out to her father: "Instead of my yellow one, may I please have my red ball?" and continued getting ready for school. But father did not hear Emma ask for her red ball.

records.source_text: Which toy does Dad think Emma wants to bring to school?
records.target_text: Welk speelgoed wil Emma volgens papa mee naar school nemen?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Dad say Emma wants to take to school?

records.source_text: Dad didn’t hear Emma say she wants her red ball. So dad thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Dad goes to pack Emma’s bag, but can’t find her yellow ball in the toy box! But dad finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.
records.target_text: Papa hoorde Emma niet zeggen dat ze haar rode bal wilde. Dus denkt papa dat Emma haar gele bal wil. Papa gaat Emma's tas inpakken, maar kan haar gele bal niet vinden in de speelgoeddoos! Maar papa vindt een blauwe bal in de speelgoeddoos, dus pakt hij in plaats daarvan de blauwe bal voor Emma in.
records.back_translation: Daddy didn't hear Emma say she wanted her red ball. So Daddy thinks Emma wants her yellow ball. Daddy is going to pack Emma's bag, but can't find her yellow ball in the toy box! But Daddy finds a blue ball in the toy box, so he packs the blue ball for Emma instead.

records.source_text: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?
records.target_text: Weet Emma dat papa de blauwe bal heeft ingepakt?
records.back_translation: Does Emma know that Dad packed the blue ball?

records.source_text: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?
records.target_text: Welke bal denkt Emma dat papa heeft ingepakt?
records.back_translation: Which ball does Emma think Dad packed?

records.source_text: The yellow ball
records.target_text: De gele bal
records.back_translation: The yellow ball

records.source_text: The red ball
records.target_text: De rode bal
records.back_translation: The red ball

records.source_text: The blue ball
records.target_text: De blauwe bal
records.back_translation: The blue ball

records.source_text: On the way to school, Dad tells Emma, “I’m so sorry, I couldn’t pack the toy that you wanted because I couldn’t find it”.
records.target_text: Op weg naar school zegt papa tegen Emma: "Het spijt me zo, maar ik kon het speelgoed dat je wilde niet inpakken, omdat ik het niet kon vinden."
records.back_translation: On the way to school, Dad says to Emma: "I'm so sorry, but I couldn't pack the toy you wanted, because I couldn't find it."

records.source_text: What toy does Emma want?
records.target_text: Welk speelgoed wil Emma?
records.back_translation: Which toy does Emma want?

records.source_text: What toy did Dad pack for Emma?
records.target_text: Welk speelgoed heeft papa voor Emma ingepakt?
records.back_translation: Which toy did Dad pack for Emma?

records.source_text: Emma is very happy to play with her ball.
records.target_text: Emma speelt graag met haar bal.
records.back_translation: Emma likes to play with her ball.

records.source_text: Here is Gabriel. This afternoon at school, Gabriel put his pencil in his pencil box.
records.target_text: Hier is Guus. Vanmiddag op school deed Guus zijn potlood in zijn pennendoos.
records.back_translation: Here is Guus. This afternoon at school, Guus put his pencil in his pencil case.

records.source_text: But while Gabriel was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Gabriel’s pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.
records.target_text: Maar terwijl Guus buiten was, gebruikte iemand zijn potlood! Nadat hij Guus' potlood had gebruikt, legde de persoon het potlood in een mandje.
records.back_translation: But while Guus was outside, someone used his pencil! After using Guus' pencil, the person put the pencil in a basket.

records.source_text: So now it’s time for class, and Gabriel wants his pencil.
records.target_text: Nu is het tijd voor de les, en Guus wil zijn potlood.
records.back_translation: Now it's time for the lesson, and Guus wants his pencil.

records.source_text: Where will Gabriel look for his pencil?
records.target_text: Waar zal Guus zijn potlood zoeken?
records.back_translation: Where will Guus look for his pencil?

records.source_text: In the box
records.target_text: In de doos
records.back_translation: In the box

records.source_text: In the basket
records.target_text: In de mand
records.back_translation: In the basket

records.source_text: And where is his pencil really?
records.target_text: En waar is zijn potlood echt?
records.back_translation: And where is his pencil really?

records.source_text: This afternoon when he came home, Bobby put his soccer ball on the table.
records.target_text: Toen Bobby vanmiddag thuiskwam, legde hij zijn voetbal op tafel.
records.back_translation: When Bobby came home this afternoon, he put his soccer ball on the table.

records.source_text: And then he went outside to play, see? Here’s Bobby playing outside. And while he was outside playing, Bobby’s soccer ball fell off the table and onto the floor.
records.target_text: En toen ging hij naar buiten om te spelen, zie je? Hier is Bobby aan het buitenspelen. En terwijl hij buiten aan het spelen was, viel Bobby's voetbal van de tafel op de grond.
records.back_translation: And then he went outside to play, you see? Here's Bobby playing outside. And while he was playing outside, Bobby's soccer ball fell from the table to the ground.

records.source_text: Then Bobby’s sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still outside playing, so he didn’t see what Anna was doing.
records.target_text: Dan komt Bobby's zus Anna binnen. Anna heeft ook een voetbal! Anna legt haar voetbal op tafel. Bobby is nog buiten aan het spelen, dus hij heeft niet gezien wat Anna aan het doen was.
records.back_translation: Then Bobby's sister Anna comes in. Anna also has a soccer ball! Anna puts her soccer ball on the table. Bobby is still playing outside, so he hasn't seen what Anna was doing.

records.source_text: Now, when Bobby comes in from outside, where will he look first for his soccer ball?
records.target_text: Als Bobby van buiten binnenkomt, waar zal hij dan als eerste naar zijn voetbal zoeken?
records.back_translation: If Bobby comes inside from outside, where will he first look for his soccer ball?

records.source_text: On the table
records.target_text: Op tafel
records.back_translation: On the table

records.source_text: On the floor
records.target_text: Op de vloer
records.back_translation: On the floor

records.source_text: Let’s see what he does. Oh look, here is Bobby reaching for the soccer ball on the table. And now Anna sees Bobby reaching for that soccer ball... the soccer ball that is Anna's!
records.target_text: Laten we eens kijken wat hij doet. Oh kijk, hier is Bobby die de voetbal wil pakken die op tafel ligt. En nu ziet Anna dat Bobby die voetbal wil pakken... de voetbal die van Anna is!
records.back_translation: Let's see what he does. Oh look, here's Bobby who wants to grab the soccer ball that's on the table. And now Anna sees that Bobby wants to grab that soccer ball... the soccer ball that belongs to Anna!

records.source_text: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby reaching for that soccer ball?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Anna zich voelt over dat Bobby de voetbal pakt?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna feels about Bobby taking the soccer ball?

records.source_text: How do you think Anna would feel if she had not seen Bobby reaching for the soccer ball?
records.target_text: Hoe denk je dat Anna zich zou voelen als ze niet had gezien dat Bobby de voetbal pakte?
records.back_translation: How do you think Anna would feel if she hadn't seen Bobby pick up the soccer ball?

records.source_text: Is Bobby being mean and naughty for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Is Bobby gemeen en ondeugend omdat hij Anna's voetbal heeft gepakt?
records.back_translation: Is Bobby mean and naughty because he took Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Should Bobby get in trouble with their mom for taking Anna’s soccer ball?
records.target_text: Moet Bobby op zijn kop krijgen van hun moeder omdat hij Anna's voetbal heeft gepakt?
records.back_translation: Should Bobby get a scolding from their mother because he took Anna's soccer ball?

records.source_text: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Kun jij Anna helpen haar voetbal te vinden? Ligt hij op tafel of op de grond?
records.back_translation: Can you help Anna find her soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?
records.target_text: Kun jij Bobby helpen zijn voetbal te vinden? Ligt hij op tafel of op de grond?
records.back_translation: Can you help Bobby find his soccer ball? Is it on the table or on the floor?

records.source_text: Alex, Beth, and Johnny are playing a game at the park. Here's how the game goes: One kid hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so the other kids can find them.
records.target_text: Alex, Brenda en Jan spelen een spelletje in het park. Zo gaat het spelletje: Eén kind verstopt zich, maar tekent een aanwijzing in de zandbak zodat de andere kinderen haar of hem kunnen vinden.
records.back_translation: Alex, Brenda, and Jan are playing a game in the park. This is how the game works: One child hides, but draws a clue in the sandbox so that the other children can find her or him.

records.source_text: Johnny decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Johnny means to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Johnny goes to hide behind the flower bush.
records.target_text: Jan besluit zich achter de bloemenstruik te verstoppen. Hij tekent een aanwijzing in het zand. Jan wil de bloemenstruik tekenen, maar de tekening lijkt in plaats daarvan op een rots! Dan gaat Jan zich achter de bloemenstruik verstoppen.
records.back_translation: Jan decides to hide behind the flower bush. He draws a clue in the sand. Jan wants to draw the flower bush, but the drawing looks like a rock instead! Then Jan goes to hide behind the flower bush.

records.source_text: What did Johnny mean to draw?
records.target_text: Wat wilde Jan tekenen?
records.back_translation: What did Jan want to draw?

records.source_text: A flower bush
records.target_text: Een bloemenstruik
records.back_translation: A flowering shrub

records.source_text: A rock
records.target_text: Een rots
records.back_translation: A rock

records.source_text: When Alex and Beth see this clue, where will they look first for Johnny? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?
records.target_text: Als Alex en Brenda deze aanwijzing zien, waar zullen ze dan als eerste naar Jan zoeken? Achter de bloemenstruik of achter de rots?
records.back_translation: If Alex and Brenda see this clue, where will they first look for Jan? Behind the flower bush or behind the rock?

records.source_text: Can you help them find where Johnny really is?
records.target_text: Kun jij ze helpen vinden waar Jan echt is?
records.back_translation: Can you help them find where Jan really is?

records.source_text: Behind the flower bush
records.target_text: Achter de bloemenstruik
records.back_translation: Behind the flower bush

records.source_text: Behind the rock
records.target_text: Achter de rots
records.back_translation: Behind the rock

records.source_text: Look, Alex and Beth found Johnny, and won the game! How do you think Alex and Beth feel about winning the game?
records.target_text: Kijk, Alex en Brenda vonden Jan en wonnen het spel! Hoe denk je dat Alex en Brenda zich voelen over het winnen van het spel?
records.back_translation: Look, Alex and Brenda found Jan and won the game! How do you think Alex and Brenda feel about winning the game?

records.source_text: Dad tells James and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad tells them to put on their shoes.
records.target_text: Papa zegt tegen Jakob en Sophie dat ze zich klaar moeten maken voor school. Papa zegt dat ze hun schoenen aan moeten trekken.
records.back_translation: Dad tells Jakob and Sophie to get ready for school. Dad says they need to put on their shoes.

records.source_text: Sophie can’t find one of her shoes! She’s looking everywhere but she can't find it.
records.target_text: Sophie kan een van haar schoenen niet vinden! Ze zoekt overal, maar ze kan hem niet vinden.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find one of her shoes! She's looking everywhere, but she can't find it.

records.source_text: How does Sophie feel about losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Hoe voelt Sophie zich over dat ze haar schoen kwijt is?
records.back_translation: How does Sophie feel about losing her shoe?

records.source_text: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?
records.target_text: Hoe zou Sophie zich voelen als ze haar schoen zou vinden?
records.back_translation: How would Sophie feel if she found her shoe?

records.source_text: Sophie can't find her shoe because earlier in the day, when no one was looking, James played a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.
records.target_text: Sophie kan haar schoen niet vinden, want eerder die dag, toen niemand keek, wilde Jakob een streek uithalen op Sophie en heeft haar schoen in de speelgoeddoos verstopt.
records.back_translation: Sophie can't find her shoe, because earlier that day, when no one was looking, Jakob wanted to play a trick on Sophie and hid her shoe in the toy box.

records.source_text: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can’t find her shoe. Dad gets mad at Sophie, because she lost her shoe and now they are late for school.
records.target_text: Dus Sophie zoekt overal en ze kan haar schoen niet vinden. Papa wordt boos op Sophie, omdat ze haar schoen kwijt is en nu komen ze te laat op school.
records.back_translation: So Sophie looks everywhere and she can't find her shoe. Dad gets angry with Sophie because she lost her shoe and now they're going to be late for school.

records.source_text: Is it fair that Dad is mad at Sophie for losing her shoe?
records.target_text: Is het eerlijk dat papa boos is op Sophie omdat ze haar schoen kwijt is?
records.back_translation: Is it fair that Dad is angry with Sophie because she lost her shoe?

records.source_text: This is Mika. Mika’s mom owns a bookshop, and sometimes Mika helps out. Earlier today, Mika was organizing books on tables and shelves. records.source_text: George and Kat are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy shop across the street. Kat decides to go buy some new toys at the toy shop. Kat asks George what toy he would like to have, and George says he would like a new basketball.

records.back_translation: Gert and Katrien are playing together. They look outside and see a new toy store across the street. Kat decides to buy some new toys at the toy store. Katrien asks Gert what toy he would like to have, and Gert says he would like a new basketball.

records.back_translation: While Katrien walks to the toy store, Gert changes his mind and calls out to Katrien: "May I please have some crayons?" But Katrien did not hear Gert ask for crayons.

records.source_text: Which toy does Kat think George wants from the toy shop?

records.back_translation: Which toy from the toy store does Katrien think Gert wants?

records.source_text: Kat didn’t hear George say that he wanted crayons. So Kat thinks George wants a basketball. Kat goes to the toy shop, but then the shop owner says that they don’t have any basketballs! But they do have storybooks, so Kat buys a storybook for George instead.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will play with numbers.

records.back_translation: Look, Rebecca chose the soccer ball. Why does Rebecca choose the soccer ball?

records.source_text: That’s a good choice! Rebecca likes the soccer ball best. She doesn’t like the basketball. What she really likes is the soccer ball.

records.back_translation: That's a good choice! Rebecca likes the soccer ball the most. She doesn't like the basketball. What she really likes is the soccer ball.

records.source_text: This is Mark. Mark is playing a really silly game today and not saying any words all day long. Instead, Mark is drawing pictures. Mark is at the library, deciding which book he would like to read. Mom shows Mark two books, a book about cups and a book about hills.

records.explanation: The translation shifts the meaning from an emotional expression of satisfaction ('I feel good') to a cognitive assessment of certainty ('I am confident'), losing the intended warmth and encouragement for the child. The phrase 'com relação a' also adds a slightly formal tone.
records.suggested_fix: Sinto-me BEM com estes dados (por exemplo, a criança entendeu claramente a tarefa, teve muito poucas (ou nenhuma) distrações/interrupções, etc.).

records.explanation: The translation 'Estou CONFIDENTE com relação a esses dados' is too formal and clinical for a child-facing prompt. It shifts the focus from the child's performance to the researcher's data assessment, losing the intended encouraging tone.
records.suggested_fix: Gostei muito de como você fez isso! (por exemplo, você entendeu claramente a tarefa, teve muito poucas (ou nenhuma) distrações/interrupções, etc.)

records.source_text: Suddenly, you are bumped from behind by a boy. You stumble and fall into a mud puddle and your new shoes get muddy.

records.explanation: The translation subtly shifts the focus from a direct count of a presented set ('is this') to a question about perception ('do you see'). This could alter the cognitive task, especially if the image contains ambiguous items.

records.source_text:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do in school and some will be a little different than what you do in school. 

Some questions might be easy for you and some might be hard. That is okay! Please try your best and take your time. Most of the questions will have four choices. You choose the one you think is right. Let’s get started!
records.target_text:
En este juego, harás algunos problemas de matemáticas. Algunos serán como los que hacés en la escuela y otros serán un poco diferentes de los que hacés en la escuela. 

Algunas preguntas te resultarán fáciles y otras difíciles. ¡No pasa nada! Esforzate al máximo y tomate tu tiempo. La mayoría de las preguntas tienen cuatro opciones. Elegí la que consideres correcta. ¡Empecemos!
records.back_translation:
In this game, you will do some math problems. Some will be like the ones you do at school and others will be a little different from the ones you do at school.

Some questions will be easy for you and others difficult. That's okay! Try your best and take your time. Most questions have four options. Choose the one you think is correct. Let's begin!

records.source_text: This time, you will choose the button with the right number!
records.target_text: Desta vez, você escolherá o botão com o número correto!
records.back_translation: This time, you will choose the button with the correct number!
